40723198.title: Experto en Automatización, IA y n8n Requerido
40723198.description: Busco un freelance especializado en automatización, IA y n8n para desarrollar y mantener un sistema para una clínica dental en Madrid. IMPORTANTE: NO necesitamos crear una web nueva. La clínica ya dispone de web. El trabajo consiste principalmente en automatización, integración de herramientas, WhatsApp, base de datos y marketing digital. OBJETIVO Crear un sistema centralizado que permita a la clínica captar, atender y reactivar pacientes automáticamente, reduciendo el trabajo manual de recepción. TRABAJO INICIAL 1. WhatsApp + IA * Integración con WhatsApp Business API. * Automatizaciones mediante n8n. * Respuestas automáticas. * Clasificación de pacientes. * Derivación a recepción cuando sea necesario. * Posibilidad de conectar agenda/citas. 2. Base de datos * La clínica dispone de aproximadamente 14.000 pacientes. * Limpieza y segmentación de la base. * Segmentación por pacientes activos/inactivos/tratamientos. * Preparación para campañas de reactivación. 3. Email + WhatsApp * Crear automatizaciones para campañas de reactivación. * Recordatorios y seguimiento. * Diferentes flujos según el tipo de paciente. 4. IA * Integración con Claude u otro modelo adecuado. * Automatización de tareas repetitivas. * Clasificación y gestión de conversaciones. * Posibilidad de utilizar voz/transcripción si técnicamente tiene sentido. 5. Google Ads * Configuración técnica. * Conversiones y tracking. * Integración con la web existente. * Preparación de campañas. * Automatización de leads cuando sea posible. 6. Instagram / Meta * Automatización de procesos relacionados con leads y mensajes. * Integraciones mediante API cuando sea necesario. 7. Reputación * Sistema de monitorización de reseñas. * Automatización de avisos y seguimiento. HERRAMIENTAS Preferiblemente experiencia con: * n8n * WhatsApp Business API * Meta API * Claude / OpenAI * Google APIs * Google Ads * CRM * APIs y webhooks * PostgreSQL / Supabase si es necesario * Email marketing * Automatización de procesos IMPORTANTE No buscamos solamente alguien que haga un chatbot. Buscamos una persona que pueda diseñar la arquitectura, desarrollar las automatizaciones, integrarlas y dejarlas funcionando en producción. El proyecto se desarrollará por fases y con hitos. FORMA DE TRABAJO Nosotros somos una agencia de IA y automatización en España y somos quienes gestionamos al cliente final. El freelance trabajará como colaborador técnico de nuestra agencia. Queremos una relación a largo plazo para futuros proyectos de clientes. PARA PRESENTAR TU PROPUESTA Indica: 1. Tu experiencia con n8n. 2. Proyectos realizados con WhatsApp + IA. 3. Si has trabajado con clínicas, salud o bases de datos grandes. 4. Qué herramientas utilizarías para este proyecto. 5. Tiempo estimado. 6. Precio para la implementación inicial. 7. Precio mensual de mantenimiento. 8. Portfolio o ejemplos reales. No envíes una propuesta genérica. Queremos ver ejemplos concretos de automatizaciones que hayas desarrollado.
40723198.decision: Проект не подходит по нескольким правилам: во-первых, требуется настройка рекламы Google Ads и веб-трекинга (рекламой и маркетингом мы не занимаемся); во-вторых, клиент ищет специалиста именно по n8n, в то время как мы пишем автоматизации исключительно на Python.

40722139.title: AI Workflow Automation Setup
40722139.description: I run a small services company and would like our routine workflows to run themselves. The core stack is Google Sheets, Google Calendar, and HubSpot; I need an expert who can connect those three tools to an LLM layer—whether that ends up being ChatGPT, Claude, Grok or a mix—so that data flows automatically and triggers happen without anyone touching a keyboard. Here’s what has to happen. • Data entry & updates: whenever a quote, lead, or status change appears in HubSpot, the relevant rows in Google Sheets should populate or refresh. • Scheduling & reminders: new jobs or follow-ups added in Sheets or HubSpot must instantly create the right Google Calendar events, complete with reminder logic that can adjust if details shift. • AI reasoning: the large-language-model layer should watch these events, interpret notes or plain-language prompts, and decide which workflow to fire—saving summaries, flagging anomalies, or nudging the team when human input is required. I’ll map out the existing process and share API keys; you translate that into stable, maintainable automations. I’m happy with low-code services (Zapier, Make/Integromat, n8n) as long as the solution is transparent and can be handed off cleanly. Acceptance criteria 1. All three platforms stay in sync in real time. 2. No duplicate or dropped records during a two-week live test. 3. Clear hand-off documentation covering triggers, endpoints, and how to swap one LLM provider for another. If this sounds straightforward to you, let’s talk about timelines and get it launched.
40722139.decision: Проект полностью соответствует услуге «ИИ-агент / чат-бот на базе Claude, GPT, Gemini, Groq» ($350, 21 день). Ниша халяльная (сервисная компания). Клиент пишет, что «будет рад» low-code инструментам, но не требует их жестко, поэтому мы можем честно предложить решение на Python. Все правила профиля и шариата соблюдены.
40722139.proposal: I can build a custom Python-based AI agent that connects HubSpot, Google Sheets, and Google Calendar via their APIs. While you mentioned low-code tools like Zapier or n8n, I specialize in custom Python scripts; this approach is highly transparent, saves you from paying monthly platform subscription fees, and is easy to maintain. The LLM layer (GPT, Claude, or Groq) will interpret your plain-language prompts and notes to dynamically trigger workflows, generate summaries, and flag anomalies. I will also provide clear hand-off documentation so you can easily swap LLM providers or adjust the prompt logic in the future. Could you share how many distinct workflow triggers you currently have mapped out? Also, do you already have developer accounts and API access set up for HubSpot and Google Workspace?

40717879.title: AI Social Media Auto Content Creation & Posting
40717879.description: I want to elevate my brand’s visibility by running an always-on social media presence powered by auto AI smart automation and high-quality creative & posting for all social media plateforms. The core objective is clear: increase brand awareness across Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, YouTube, and LinkedIn. Here’s the scope. First, a channel-specific strategy that maps audiences, voice and optimal posting cadence. I expect AI tools such as ChatGPT or Jasper for copy ideation, n8n,gemini,Canva, Adobe CC or Midjourney for visuals, and a scheduler like Hootsuite, Buffer or Later to automate publishing. If Zapier or similar workflows can streamline reporting and cross-posting, all the better. Deliverables • Strategy blueprint (PDF or Slides) outlining goals, personas, content pillars and KPIs • Automated scheduling setup, including hashtag libraries and optimal post-time settings • Performance dashboard template pulling basic metrics (reach, impressions, engagement) into one view Acceptance criteria: all assets must be brand-consistent, sized correctly for each platform, scheduled at least one week ahead, and supported by a brief rationale tying each post back to the overall awareness goal. Once everything is live, I’ll review the first performance report; tweaks can follow based on data. Let’s build a fully automated, memorable social footprint from day one.
40717879.decision: Проект включает разработку SMM-стратегии, дизайн в Canva/Adobe CC и создание шаблонов отчетов, что относится к дизайну и SMM (эти услуги я не оказываю). Также клиент запрашивает интеграцию через n8n/Zapier/Buffer вместо разработки на Python.

40712188.title: AI Automation & AI Clone Engineer
40712188.description: AI Automation & AI Clone Engineer OpenAI • OpenClaw • Hermes • n8n • AI Agents • Voice & Video Cloning Long-Term / Full-Time Opportunity | $1,250–$2,000+ USD/Month + Bonuses We are looking for an exceptional AI builder for a long-term position with our AI automation company. This is NOT a VA position. We need someone who can actually BUILD. AI agents. Automations. APIs. Workflows. Voice AI. Video AI. AI clones. Business systems. If you're the person who sees a business process and immediately starts thinking about how AI could automate 80% of it, keep reading. FIRST PROJECT: BUILD A COMPLETE AI CLONE Your first major assignment will be creating a complete, production-ready AI clone of our founder. We're not looking for a 15-second demo. We want a reusable system that allows us to provide a new script and generate convincing video content using his: Voice Face and appearance Speech characteristics Lip synchronization Natural movement Presentation style We want the highest quality possible while keeping the ongoing generation cost extremely low. This first project is also important because we already have 5–6 clients ready for AI cloning. We aren't trying to determine whether there's a market. The work is already waiting. We want someone who can help us build the process once, improve it, automate it, and then reproduce it efficiently for clients. THE BIGGER JOB AI cloning is only one part of what you'll be doing. Our company builds AI and automation systems for businesses. You may work on: AI agents and autonomous workflows OpenClaw / Hermes implementations n8n / Make automations LLM integrations OpenAI / Claude / Gemini APIs API and webhook integrations 24/7 AI workers CRM automation Lead-generation automation Sales and marketing systems AI voice agents AI video systems Client onboarding automation Internal business automation Custom client workflows We want someone who can eventually hear: "Here's the business problem." …and figure out how to build the solution. TECHNOLOGY You do NOT need experience with every technology listed below. We would rather hire someone exceptional who can learn quickly than someone who has touched 30 tools but mastered none. Strong experience with several of these is important: OpenAI / OpenAI API Claude / Anthropic Gemini OpenClaw Hermes or comparable agent frameworks n8n Make Zapier REST APIs Webhooks JSON Python and/or JavaScript AI agents / agentic workflows LLM orchestration Voice AI Voice cloning AI avatars / video cloning CRM automation Experience with tools such as ElevenLabs, HeyGen, Tavus, Synthesia, Captions or comparable technologies is valuable. But don't apply because you've watched tutorials. SHOW US WHAT YOU'VE BUILT. We care far more about demonstrated ability than degrees, certifications or buzzwords. WHO WE WANT We're looking for someone who: Experiments with new AI technology constantly Can research independently Learns new platforms extremely quickly Understands APIs and integrations Can troubleshoot when things break Thinks about cost and scalability Can turn prototypes into repeatable systems Documents what they build Communicates clearly FINISHES projects AI is changing too quickly for us to hire someone who only knows today's tools. We want someone who knows how to learn tomorrow's tools. COMPENSATION Our target range is approximately: $1,250–$2,000+ USD/month + performance bonuses We are open to international applicants. Compensation will depend heavily on your demonstrated capabilities, experience, location, availability and the quality of your work. If you're exceptional, tell us what you're worth. There will also be opportunities for performance/project bonuses as client systems are successfully completed and deployed. THIS IS LONG-TERM We aren't looking for someone to finish one automation and disappear. We already have work. We have clients. We have AI cloning projects waiting. We have automation projects waiting. And we're building significantly more. We have enough
40712188.decision: Проект требует создания полноценного ИИ-клона человека (лицо, мимика, движения, липсинк). В профиле в разделе «Чего я не делаю» прямо указан запрет на генерацию картинок и видео с людьми при помощи ИИ. По этой причине мы не можем откликнуться на данную вакансию.

40716866.title: Automate Harvest Invoice Creation
40716866.description: I need an automation specialist to recreate Harvest invoices in FreeAgent using Zapier or Make.com. The workflow must create in FreeAgent an invoice once I send one to a client via Harvest. To my understanding it's possible to do that but the invoice created in FreeAgent will be a draft. I need to move each FreeAgent invoice from Draft to Sent/Open without re-emailing the client, so invoices do not need to be raised twice for client billing and accounting reconciliation. This is an ongoing automation that runs once a month for around 20 invoices per month. I need a sensible estimated monthly cost to run it. Relevant experience includes Webhooks by Zapier or Make.com's Custom API Request module, FreeAgent API OAuth and invoice transition endpoints, and Harvest integrations. In your proposal, recommend Zapier or Make.com for this API request and explain why. Include examples of similar custom API workflows you have built. WORKFLOW REQUIREMENTS Trigger on new or submitted invoices in Harvest. Create a FreeAgent draft invoice with mapped contact information, line items, amounts, and tax rates. I am happy to manually create clients and tasks if needed in FreeAgent. Match each Harvest client to an existing FreeAgent contact ID, or create a contact when none exists. Use a secondary HTTP/API request to transition the invoice from Draft to Sent without sending an email. Test partial payments, multiple line items, and discounts. Provide a brief handover covering management of the API connection. IMPORTANT FreeAgent's native integration modules create Draft invoices only. The workflow must use the FreeAgent API transition endpoint to mark an invoice as sent silently: PUT https://api.freeagent.com/v2/invoices/:id/transitions/mark_as_sent. Please ensure before applying: - You will need to check that the above workflow is correct, because I generated it with AI. - Check that the work can be done - it is also possible that FreeAgent API wont allow for it - Provide estimate of your cost and of any ongoing cost I might need to pay for the automation - Not an urgent work
40716866.decision: Запрос требует настройки интеграции между Harvest и FreeAgent через Zapier или Make.com. Во-первых, я работаю исключительно на Python (no-code платформы не поддерживаю, если они принципиальны клиенту). Во-вторых, интеграция платежных/бухгалтерских систем и CRM отсутствует в моем жестком списке разрешенных услуг («Что я делаю»).

40725349.title: Automate Internal Operations
40725349.description: We are a refrigerated freight brokerage looking for an experienced automation developer to integrate Tai TMS with Zapier, Microsoft 365/Outlook, and AI. The goal is to automate our email-based appointment scheduling process while keeping dispatchers in control of routing and logistical decisions. Tai will remain the primary operating interface. **Project Deliverables:** * Integrate Tai TMS with Zapier and Microsoft 365/Outlook * Trigger appointment requests based on dispatcher-entered appointment times in Tai * Automatically send and monitor appointment-request emails * Use AI to interpret receiver responses, appointment times, and confirmation numbers * Automatically handle responses within predefined scheduling tolerances * Route exceptions back to dispatchers for human decisions * Write confirmed appointments and confirmation numbers back to the correct stop in Tai * Support multi-stop appointment workflows * Prevent duplicate requests and maintain basic workflow/error logging * Test, document, and hand off the completed automation **Phase 1 Acceptance Criteria:** Phase 1 will be considered complete when the system can successfully demonstrate an end-to-end appointment workflow on test shipments: * Dispatcher enters a requested appointment time for a specific stop in Tai * Automation correctly identifies the shipment and specific stop * Appointment request is automatically sent through Microsoft 365/Outlook with the correct shipment information * Receiver email response is automatically matched to the correct shipment and stop * AI accurately extracts the appointment date/time and confirmation number when provided * Appointment offers within ±60 minutes of the dispatcher-requested time can be handled automatically * Offers outside the ±60-minute tolerance are routed to the dispatcher for approval rather than automatically accepted * Ambiguous, missing, or unrecognized responses are escalated for human review * Confirmed appointment time and confirmation/reference information are written back to the correct Tai shipment/stop * Multi-stop shipments can progress through the appointment workflow without confusing stops or email threads * Duplicate appointment requests and duplicate processing are prevented * Failed automations are logged and surfaced rather than silently failing * The completed workflow is tested successfully using representative multi-stop refrigerated shipments * All Zapier workflows, integrations, documentation, and configuration are handed over to us with full ownership and administrative access The system should be designed so it can later expand into additional freight automation, including after-hours operations and payment/lumper workflows. Experience with APIs, webhooks, Zapier, Microsoft 365, AI automation, and system integrations is preferred. Transportation/logistics or TMS experience is a plus. **To Apply:** Please provide a brief description of how you would approach the integration, examples of similar API/Zapier/Microsoft 365 automation projects you have completed, your estimated timeline, and a fixed-price quote for Phase 1. Please begin your application with **“TAI AUTOMATION”** so we know you have reviewed the project requirements. We are interested in establishing an ongoing relationship with the right developer for additional automation projects after Phase 1 is successfully completed.
40725349.decision: Заказчик жестко требует реализацию именно на Zapier и передачу готовых Zapier-воркфлоу в качестве ключевого результата проекта. По правилам профиля, если клиенту принципиально нужен именно Zapier, мы отказываемся, так как пишем решения исключительно на Python.

40719849.title: E-Commerce Workflow Automation Setup
40719849.description: I run a growing e-commerce business and I’m finally ready to replace the patchwork of manual tasks slowing us down. The objective is simple: design and deploy an end-to-end automation system that keeps the store humming with as little hands-on intervention as possible. We’ll start with a discovery call so you can map my current tech stack and pain points. Customer service, inventory management, and marketing are all on the table; I’ll explain the exact priorities during that session. Whether the answer involves Shopify flow triggers, WooCommerce hooks, Magento APIs, or third-party connectors like Zapier, Make, Klaviyo, Gorgias, ShipStation, or Zendesk, I’m open to the most reliable, scalable path. Once we agree on the roadmap, I expect: • A clear architecture diagram and tool list • Configuration and integration of all chosen apps/services • Automated workflows fully tested in a staging environment • A short video or written SOP that shows my team how to monitor and tweak the automations I’ll sign off when each workflow fires correctly under real-world conditions and the documentation proves anyone on my team can maintain it. If this sounds like a challenge you’re excited to tackle, let’s talk details and get the build underway.
40719849.decision: Запрос содержит автоматизацию e-commerce через сторонние коннекторы (Zapier, Make, Klaviyo, Zendesk) и платформы (Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento), что не входит в список моих услуг (я делаю только Telegram-ботов, автопостинг, ИИ-генерацию контента, парсеры и ИИ-агентов на Python). Также клиент требует начать с созвона и рассматривает Zapier/Make, с которыми я не работаю.

40717759.title: AI-Driven Marketing Automation Bot
40717759.description: I am building an AI-powered bot devoted to digital marketing and want an expert who can take it from concept to reliable daily use. The bot must learn our brand voice, schedule and optimise Facebook, Instagram and YouTube posts, run behavioural email sequences automatically, and continuously fine-tune on-page SEO. Here is what I need delivered: • Social Media Automation – the bot should draft, A/B test and publish content on Facebook, Instagram and YouTube, pulling performance metrics back into its model for ongoing improvement. • Email Marketing Automation – set up intelligent campaigns that segment users, personalise subject lines and content, and trigger follow-ups based on real-time engagement. • SEO Optimisation – integrate keyword discovery, content gap analysis and meta-tag tuning, then push recommendations straight into our CMS. Acceptance will be based on: 1. A live demo of the bot handling a full weekly content cycle across the three platforms. 2. An automated email flow that adapts subject lines after at least two iterations. 3. A before-and-after SEO report showing measurable improvements in page speed, meta relevance and keyword ranking. Python, TensorFlow/PyTorch, GPT-based text generation, Zapier/Make or similar for workflow orchestration, plus experience with Meta and YouTube APIs are all welcome skills if you have them—the goal is a single, self-learning system that reduces manual effort and steadily improves our reach and conversion rates.
40717759.decision: Заказ включает в себя задачи по SEO-оптимизации и улучшению скорости загрузки страниц, что прямо относится к категории услуг, которые я не оказываю согласно профилю (раздел «Чего я не делаю: SEO»).

40712061.title: AI Agent for On-Page SEO
40712061.description: I want an AI-driven workflow that completely handles on-page SEO for my blog posts. The agent should: • Analyse each new draft, run keyword research, and weave primary and secondary terms naturally into the copy without hurting readability. • Generate or refine the post itself when gaps are detected, keeping tone and style consistent with my existing articles. • Produce fully optimised meta titles, meta descriptions, and alt text that stay within character limits and follow current best practices. Ideally the system runs from a single trigger—new draft uploaded to Google Docs or a CMS—and then returns the optimised version plus the meta data in a neat report or directly updates the post. I’m open to whatever stack you prefer (Python, Node, Zapier, Make, OpenAI APIs, LangChain, etc.) as long as it is reliable and easy for me to extend later. Acceptance criteria • End-to-end demo on one of my live blog posts. • Clear installation / setup instructions. • Source code or workflow diagram handed over on completion. If this sounds straightforward to you, let’s discuss the best approach and timeline.
40712061.decision: Проект напрямую связан с SEO (поисковой оптимизацией), в то время как в моем профиле в разделе «Чего я не делаю» прямо указано ограничение на любые задачи, связанные с SEO.

40726060.title: Automated Ticket Buying Desktop App
40726060.description: I’m seeking an experienced developer to complete an existing automated ticket-buying bot with a Windows desktop dashboard for Ticketmaster and SeatGeek. The developer must have already done numerous projects related to this and is skilled at anti-bot resilience. Such as fingerprint spoofing, residential proxy rotation, and CAPTCHA solving hooks. You must have extensive experience bypassing strict anti-bot protections such as, (DataDome, Cloudflare, Akamai). The main deliverable is a working purchasing engine that automatically monitors ticket availability, identifies tickets matching my criteria, reserves them, and completes checkout using assigned accounts and supported saved payment methods. The dashboard must let me configure and monitor this automation without editing code. Source files, executables, screenshots, and an improved dashboard with simulated workflows are available. The existing simulation does not fulfill the automatic purchasing requirement. Automatic Purchasing Requirements Once I configure and start a task, the bot should automatically: 1. Open the specified event using the assigned account sessions. 2. Handle supported queue workflows and begin monitoring when access becomes available. 3. Identify inventory matching my section, row, ticket-type, quantity, seating, and price requirements. 4. Reserve qualifying tickets. 5. Verify the selected tickets, final quantity, and total price, including applicable fees and taxes. 6. Complete checkout through a supported, authorized integration using the assigned purchasing profile and payment method. 7. Verify the order outcome and record the confirmation details. 8. Notify me of successful purchases, failures, or required intervention. 9. Stop when the shared ticket target or spending limit is reached. Provide two selectable operating modes: - Automatic Purchase: Starting the task authorizes purchases within its configured event, ticket criteria, quantity, and spending limits. No additional approval is required for each qualifying purchase. - Approval Required: Reserve qualifying tickets and request approval locally or through Discord before completing checkout. Any authentication, verification, or payment step that requires human involvement must be clearly identified before development. The bot must pause and notify me when intervention is required. Multiple Accounts and Purchase Controls A single task must support multiple accounts and individual purchasing profiles, with an initial configuration target of 50 accounts. This will be more. Coordinate activity across accounts so the bot does not purchase duplicate inventory or exceed shared limits. An individual account failure should not stop other eligible accounts. After a timeout or uncertain checkout response, verify whether an order succeeded before retrying. Once the task target is reached, stop outstanding purchase attempts safely. Required Live Demonstration Demonstrate the complete automatic workflow separately on each supported platform: matching inventory, reservation, final-price validation, checkout submission, and verified order confirmation. Use an agreed test environment or an explicitly authorized live purchase with a fixed spending limit. Clearly identify unsupported features and unavoidable manual steps. A simulation, cart-only demonstration, or checkout link does not satisfy the automatic purchasing requirement. Deliver and demonstrate the agreed live purchasing workflow on Ticketmaster and SeatGeek, including automatic checkout, verified order outcomes, coordinated account activity, enforced quantity/spending limits, duplicate prevention, and notifications. Acceptance requires evidence of the agreed end-to-end functionality on each platform.
40726060.decision: Проект отклонен по нескольким причинам согласно правилам профиля: 1) Требуется разработка десктопного интерфейса (Windows desktop dashboard), что выходит за рамки моих услуг. 2) Требуется обход систем защиты и блокировок платформ (DataDome, Cloudflare, Akamai, fingerprint spoofing, proxy rotation), что прямо запрещено правилами («обход блокировок платформ — это обман, харам»). 3) Требуется работа с фермой аккаунтов (от 50 штук), что также относится к запрещенным категориям («фермы ботов»).

40725827.title: Logistics Google Sheet Automation
40725827.description: I need a comprehensive Google Sheet to manage our logistics operations effectively. This sheet will help me track daily vehicle entries, expenses, and provide various reports. Key Features: - Daily vehicle entry - Driver name and client name - Daily expenses and mileage - Driver salary - Reports: - Daily vehicle utilization - Client invoices - Profit and Loss (PNL) reports (daily, weekly, monthly) Ideal Skills and Experience: - Expertise in Google Sheets - Experience in logistics management - Strong analytical skills for generating reports - Attention to detail and accuracy Looking for a freelancer who can create an organized and user-friendly sheet to streamline our logistics operations.
40725827.decision: Запрос требует создания и настройки комплексной Google Таблицы для логистики (формулы, учет поездок, расходов, генерация PNL-отчетов). Я занимаюсь исключительно разработкой автоматизаций на Python (боты, парсеры, автопостинг, ИИ-интеграции). Проектирование таблиц и ведение учета в них не входит в список моих услуг.

40727022.title: Develop AI Email Outreach Agent
40727022.description: The Goal: I am looking for an AI Automation Specialist to build a multi-agent system that automates my B2B lead generation and email drafting. We are an eventing/hire company based in South Africa. For Phase 1, I need a "human-in-the-loop" system that scrapes targeted local business contacts, researches their recent activity, and drafts highly personalized outreach emails into a Google Sheet or Drafts folder for my review.The Workflow You Will Build:Sourcing & Scraping: Target specific industries in Gauteng, South Africa (Event coordinators, Caterers, Furniture rental companies, Marketing Professionals/PAs). You will need to implement a scraper or use APIs (Apollo, Custom Search, Tavily) to find these leads.Context Gathering: The agent must briefly scan the prospect’s website or public presence to extract one personalized detail (e.g., a recent event they hosted, core service).Drafting (LLM Integration): Use an LLM (Claude 3.5 Sonnet, GPT-4o, or Gemini Pro) to write a short, conversational B2B email. The prompt will introduce our company (20 years in business), mention the personalized detail, and ask if they need assistance with upcoming year-end functions.Output (Human-in-the-Loop): Do NOT send the emails. The final output must be logged into a Google Sheet (via API) or Gmail Drafts folder containing: Contact Name, Email, Company, Personalization Context, and the Drafted Email. Preferred Tech Stack:Language: Python Framework: CrewAI, LangGraph, or AutoGen LLM: Open to your recommendation, but prefer Claude 3.5 Sonnet or GPT-4o for drafting.Automation: Open to using n8n or Make.com if it simplifies the Google Sheets/Gmail integration.Future Scope (Phase 2):If Phase 1 is successful, the contract will be extended to build out automated sending, follow-up sequences, and additional agents for competitor analysis on social media.When applying, please answer the following:Have you built an AI scraping and outreach agent before? If so, please link a case study, GitHub repo, or quick Loom video showing it working.What tool or API will you use to bypass scraping blockers for finding B2B leads?Which framework (CrewAI, LangGraph, or other) would you recommend for this specific flow and why?
40727022.decision:
Проект отклонен по следующим причинам:
1. Холодные рассылки (B2B outreach) относятся к категории спам-рассылок, что является харамом и запрещено правилами профиля.
2. Заказчик требует использовать методы обхода блокировок платформ для парсинга («bypass scraping blockers»), что прямо запрещено в разделе «Чего я не делаю».
3. Сбор персональных контактов конкретных людей (координаторов, ассистентов) нарушает запрет на парсинг личных данных.

40726821.title: AI-based Social Media Automation System

40728112.title: AI-Generated Western Pitch Video
40728112.description: I’m putting together a fast-turnaround video pitch for studio greenlighters and need an artist who can lean on generative-AI tools to bring a classic Western world to life. The final piece will be a short, tightly edited video that lets executives immediately “see” the film I’m proposing—dusty streets, tense duels, thunderous chases, and everyday town moments, all stitched into a compelling visual narrative. Here’s how I picture the flow: • We rough out a one-page treatment together so you understand tone, pacing, and the key beats I must hit. • You generate high-resolution stills or short animated loops (Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, Runway, or similar—your choice) covering the essential scenarios typical of a Western. • I’ll supply the voice-over script; you line up the visuals to match, add subtle motion, light SFX, and a cinematic music bed, then hand back a polished 90–120-second video ready for the pitch room. Acceptance criteria – Cohesive visual style across all scenes – 1080p (minimum) export, H.264 MP4 – Clear narrative flow that tracks with the provided script – All assets license-safe for investor presentation Turnaround is tight, so I’m looking for someone comfortable iterating quickly and delivering within a week of kickoff. If your portfolio already shows AI-assisted cinematic frames—especially period pieces—that’s a big plus.
40728112.decision: Проект требует генерации ИИ-видео и изображений с людьми (дуэли, жители города), что прямо запрещено правилами профиля («Картинки и видео с людьми, сгенерированные ИИ»). Кроме того, клиенту требуется выполнение работы в течение одной недели, тогда как наш минимальный срок для ИИ-генерации контента составляет 30 дней.

40727955.title: AI Novel Adaptation Video
40727955.description: I need a professional to turn my 277-page novel into a captivating AI-generated live-action video. The video should include both indoor and outdoor scenes. I can write the script myself with some help. but i need the technical expertise. I find that i am wasting a lot of credits writing scenes that don't work. i have been using chapgpt to help me but it is far from perfect.
40727955.decision: Проект требует создания ИИ-видео с людьми («live-action video»), что прямо запрещено правилами профиля в разделе «Чего я не делаю» (Картинки и видео с людьми, сгенерированные ИИ).

40727782.title: AI-Based Enterprise Ai Assistant
40727782.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot / AI Architecture Knowledge Repository Overview I am looking for an experienced Microsoft 365 Copilot / Microsoft Copilot / Azure AI developer or architect to help design and implement an AI-powered Architecture & Enterprise Knowledge Repository. The objective is to create a centralised knowledge solution where I can ask natural-language questions about our technology, architecture, systems, projects, designs and documentation, and have the AI retrieve and analyse information from multiple approved data sources. For example, I would like to be able to ask questions such as: "What is the current architecture for this system?" "What integrations does this platform have?" "What are the key risks associated with this architecture?" "Based on our existing architecture documents, what would you recommend for this new requirement?" "Compare the current and proposed architectures." "Find all documents relating to this application." "Create a High-Level Design document based on the existing architecture and requirements." "Identify gaps or inconsistencies across our architecture documentation." "What dependencies does this solution have on other systems?" "Create an architecture decision record based on the information available in the repository." The solution should be capable of searching across multiple documents and information sources, synthesising the information, and producing useful answers or documents rather than simply returning search results. Potential Data Sources I would like the solution to support, where technically and securely possible, multiple information sources such as: Microsoft SharePoint sites SharePoint document libraries OneDrive Microsoft Teams / Microsoft 365 content where appropriate Local document repositories/files GitHub repositories Architecture Repository Use Case A key part of this project is using the solution as an Architecture Knowledge Repository / Architecture Assistant. I would like the AI to understand and make connections across different types of architecture information, including: Business requirements Functional and non-functional requirements Solution architectures High-Level Designs Low-Level Designs Architecture diagrams Desired Capabilities The final solution should ideally provide capabilities such as: 1. Natural-language Q&A I should be able to ask questions in normal language and receive answers based on the approved knowledge sources. 2. Cross-document analysis The system should be able to retrieve information from multiple documents/sources and synthesise the information into a coherent answer. 3. Architecture analysis For example: "Review the existing architecture for System X and identify potential integration, security, scalability and resilience issues." 4. Recommendations Where appropriate, the system should be able to propose potential architectural options based on the information available, clearly distinguishing between information found in the repository and AI-generated recommendations. 5. Document generation The system should be capable of generating documents such as: High-Level Design documents Architecture Decision Records Technical proposals 6. Source traceability A very important requirement is that answers should identify where the information came from, ideally providing links/references back to the underlying SharePoint, Confluence, GitHub or other source documents. 7. Security and permissions The solution must respect the permissions of the underlying repositories and avoid exposing information to users who are not authorised to access it. 8. Knowledge management I would also like advice on how the repository should be structured and governed so that the AI can provide reliable answers as the volume of documentation grows. Microsoft Technology Microsoft Technology I am particularly interested in understanding what can realistically be achieved using the Microsoft ecosystem, potentially including: Microsoft 365 Copilot Copilot Studio Sh
40727782.decision: Заказчик ищет архитектора и разработчика именно в экосистеме Microsoft (Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Azure AI, Power Automate, SharePoint) и требует предоставить примеры внедрения аналогичных решений на базе технологий Microsoft. Я разрабатываю решения исключительно на Python и не имею опыта работы с enterprise-платформами Microsoft. Согласно правилу честности, я не могу выдумывать этот опыт, а предлагать здесь чистое Python-решение нецелесообразно, так как требования жестко завязаны на безопасность и права доступа внутри инфраструктуры Microsoft (MS Graph, SharePoint).

40720129.title: AI Chatbot for Sales & Lead Qualification

Core Features The AI Agent should be able to: * Chat with customers naturally using AI * Answer questions based on the company’s provided information * Collect name, phone number, email, requirements, budget, location, etc. * Ask qualification questions based on the business * Identify HOT / WARM / COLD leads * Save all leads in a database * Provide a dashboard to view and manage leads * Notify the sales team when a high-quality lead is generated * Automatically follow up with customers * Maintain conversation history * Allow admin to update AI instructions/business information * Provide basic analytics such as total leads, qualified leads, conversations and conversions Integrations The system should be designed to support: * Website chat * WhatsApp * CRM/API integrations * Email notifications * AI/LLM APIs The exact integrations can be discussed during the project. Hiring Process Please send: 1. Examples of AI agents/chatbots you have built 2. Your previous relevant projects 3. Technologies you would use for this project 4. Estimated development time 5. Your total project price 6. Your availability I am open to working with an individual freelancer or a small development team. If the first version is successful, there will be opportunities for long-term development and maintenance work.
40720129.decision: Заказчику требуется создание полноценного веб-приложения с админ-панелью (дашбордом) на React/Next.js для управления лидами и пользователями. В профиле четко указано, что мы не делаем сайты, дизайн и фронтенд-разработку, а пишем только бэкенд-автоматизации на Python.

40719417.title: Graduate Course Advisor Chatbot
40719417.description: I want to give our graduate students an always-on academic advisor that speaks their language and knows our catalog inside out. The chatbot’s single, clear purpose is course selection advice: it should listen to a student’s goals, prerequisites already met, and term-by-term availability, then recommend an optimal path through core courses, electives, and any specialized tracks we offer. Reach is critical. The same conversational experience must run on our public website, live inside the mobile app students already use for grades, and extend to at least one social channel (Messenger or similar) so they can get guidance on the go. I’m agnostic about the underlying framework—Dialogflow, Rasa, Microsoft Bot Framework, or another scalable NLP stack are all fine as long as conversation flow remains natural and easy for staff to tweak. Data you will receive includes: • An up-to-date course catalog with prerequisites, credit weight, and term availability • Sample student profiles to seed training phrases • Access rules for each specialization track Please design the dialogue, build and train the model, connect it to our catalog data source, and surface it through embeddable widgets / SDKs for web, iOS/Android, and one social platform. A lightweight admin console for non-technical staff to add new courses or adjust logic is essential. Acceptance criteria • The bot proposes a valid semester-by-semester plan covering required core courses plus chosen electives or track within policy limits • It flags conflicts (time overlaps, unmet prerequisites) and suggests alternatives in the same session • Response time under two seconds on all channels during load testing • All integrations pass end-to-end testing in staging before launch • Setup and user guides delivered in clear markdown or PDF Hand-off is complete when the bot is live in production with documentation and a brief knowledge-transfer call.
40719417.decision: Заказ требует интеграции чат-бота в мобильные приложения (через iOS/Android SDK) и создания панели администратора (admin console) для управления логикой, что относится к веб-разработке и мобильной разработке. Согласно правилам профиля, я не занимаюсь созданием сайтов и мобильных приложений.

40718729.title: AI Driven Sales Platform Setup
40718729.description: I have a finished logo and a clear product line; what I need now is an end-to-end digital sales engine that joins a smart website with an engaging Instagram presence. First, the website. It will be a single-scroll landing page that introduces the products, answers common questions, and captures visitor details. An AI chatbot should sit on every section to handle customer support in real time, while an automated lead-scoring workflow nurtures prospects in the background and reminds me whom to call next. All data flowing through these tools must be stored cleanly for future campaigns. The same AI layer will drive after-sales care. Once a purchase is logged, automated reminders and update messages have to reach customers through WhatsApp—my preferred channel—without manual intervention. On Instagram, I want a steady stream of product highlights, feature spotlights, and timely industry news or tips that funnel followers back to the site. Branded templates, short captions, and a posting calendar will help keep everything on message and on schedule. Speed matters. I would like to see the first live version of the site, chatbot, and lead workflow quickly, then continue working together on iterations, new content, and routine maintenance over the long term. Key deliverables: • Responsive landing page with AI chatbot, lead scoring, and connected forms • WhatsApp automation for post-purchase reminders and updates • Initial set of Instagram visuals and captions covering product features and industry tips • Clean data storage with easy export for marketing use Completion of each milestone will be verified by live tests of the chatbot responses, lead capture accuracy, and WhatsApp message flow.
40718729.decision: Проект требует создания одностраничного сайта (landing page) и разработки дизайна/визуалов для Instagram. Согласно разделу «Чего я не делаю», разработка сайтов и дизайн строго исключены из перечня услуг.

40717261.title: Unitree R1 Edu embodied AI
40717261.description: Task: Replace Existing Onboard LLM with Local GPT-2B Hardware * Unitree R1 EDU * Onboard NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX / onboard GPU compute platform (~100 TOPS) * Existing robot software and motor-control system are already working. * The robot currently has a built-in Chinese AI chatbot / LLM. The exact model is not yet confirmed and is not Qwen. Main Objective Replace the robot’s existing onboard LLM/chatbot with a local GPT-2B-class language model running directly on the robot’s onboard GPU. The new local model must perform the same high-level conversational / command-understanding function as the existing chatbot, while the existing robot control and motor-control system must remain unchanged. In other words: Existing system: User Voice/Text → Existing Chinese LLM → Existing Robot Control Interface → Motors Target system: User Voice/Text → Local GPT-2B → Existing Robot Control Interface → Motors The GPT-2B model should effectively replace the existing LLM layer, not the robot’s control layer. What the freelancer needs to do 1. Identify the current AI/LLM architecture * Determine what model currently powers the onboard Chinese chatbot. * Identify how the current LLM communicates with the robot’s existing control system. * Identify the existing API, SDK, ROS interface, middleware, or function-calling mechanism used between the LLM and robot control. 2. Deploy a local GPT-2B model * Select an appropriate ~2B parameter model suitable for local inference. * Deploy it on the robot’s onboard NVIDIA GPU. * Use GPU-accelerated inference (TensorRT-LLM, llama.cpp CUDA, vLLM, or another appropriate optimized runtime). * Optimize the model for low latency and reasonable memory/compute usage. 3. Connect GPT-2B to the existing robot interface * Do NOT rewrite the existing motor-control system. * Do NOT develop new low-level motor drivers. * Do NOT replace the existing Unitree SDK / motion-control implementation. * Instead, make the new LLM communicate with the existing high-level robot-control interface in the same way the current chatbot does. 4. Function / command calling The local GPT-2B should be able to interpret natural-language commands and generate structured commands/functions that are already supported by the robot. For example: "Stand up and walk forward" → GPT-2B interprets intent → calls existing robot functions such as: stand() walk_forward() The exact available functions/interfaces should be determined from the existing R1 EDU software. 5. Voice interface If the existing system already provides speech recognition, preserve it. If necessary, the architecture should support: Microphone → Local STT → GPT-2B → Existing Robot Functions The primary task is LLM replacement, not development of a new speech-recognition system. Important constraint The freelancer must reuse the existing robot-control stack. The project is NOT: * rewriting robot locomotion * rewriting motor control * developing a new Unitree SDK layer * developing a new walking controller * developing a new ROS control architecture The project IS: Replacing the existing onboard Chinese LLM with a locally running GPT-2B model and connecting the new model to the existing robot-control interface. Expected final architecture Microphone / Text Input ↓ Existing or Local STT ↓ Local GPT-2B running on onboard NVIDIA GPU ↓ Structured command / function call ↓ Existing R1 EDU Robot API / ROS / SDK ↓ Existing Motion & Motor Control ↓ Robot Deliverables 1. Local GPT-2B model running on R1 EDU onboard computer. 2. GPU-accelerated inference. 3. Integration with the existing robot-control interface. 4. Natural-language command → structured robot function execution. 5. Source code for the integration layer. 6. Installation/deployment instructions. 7. Ability to run the system autonomously on the robot without cloud LLM/API dependency. 8. Basic demonstration showing that the new GPT-2B successfully replaces the existing chatbot while the existing robot-control system continues to operate un
40717261.decision: Запрос относится к сфере робототехники (Embodied AI), требует интеграции с ROS/ROS2, работы с платой NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX и низкоуровневым кодом управления роботом Unitree R1. Этих услуг и опыта нет в моем профиле, а правила (включая правила шариата о честности) строго запрещают выдумывать опыт или брать невыполнимые проекты.

40728005.title: Zoho CRM Implementation and training
40728005.description: I need Zoho CRM configured so I can finally see, at a glance, where every deal sits in our pipeline. The single most important outcome is reliable sales tracking built around strong lead management. I want new enquiries entered manually by my team to flow cleanly from Lead through to Contact, Account and Deal without duplicated effort or data loss. Here is what success looks like to me: • Lead Management Optimised – custom fields, stage pick-lists, assignment rules and conversion mapping that match our current process yet remain easy to tweak as we grow. • Streamlined Manual Entry – simplified page layouts and mandatory-field validation so a rep can add a lead in seconds while we maintain data integrity. • Sales Visibility – dashboards and standard reports that tell me lead volume, ageing and conversion rates in real time. Please set everything up directly inside our Zoho CRM instance, test it with sample records, and then walk me through the configuration in a short hand-over session (recorded is fine). If you can leave a brief SOP or cheat-sheet for the team, even better. The build should be future-proof; I may add web forms, imports or forecasting later, so keep that flexibility in mind as you structure modules and workflows.
40728005.decision: Проект требует внутренней настройки интерфейса Zoho CRM (кастомные поля, макеты страниц, дашборды) и обучения сотрудников. Я занимаюсь исключительно разработкой на Python и интеграцией CRM с внешними сервисами через API. Данная задача не входит в перечень моих услуг.

40728380.title: Advanced Retail Automation Bot Developer Required
40728380.description: Looking for an experienced developer to build a high-speed, fully automated retail checkout bot for Australian retailers. The bot needs to support Kmart, Target, Big W, JB Hi-Fi, EB Games and Myer. Requirements include multiple checkout profiles, simultaneous product monitoring, instant add-to-cart, pre-carting where supported, one-click operation, automatic delivery selection, saved payment details and complete checkout automation. Looking for someone experienced with HTTP/GraphQL APIs, browser automation, concurrent tasks and low-latency checkout systems. Please provide your experience, estimated timeframe and quote. Budget negotiable
40728380.decision: Проект требует создания бота для автоматического выкупа товаров (checkout bot) с обходом систем защиты от ботов, очередей и капч (Cloudflare, anti-bot challenges). Это прямо относится к запрещенной в профиле категории «обход блокировок платформ» (харам/обман). Кроме того, разработка подобных высоконагруженных систем выкупа отсутствует в списке разрешенных услуг.

40728595.title: AI-Enhanced Lead Scoring Integration

В нашем профиле заявлены только интеграция CRM по API и ИИ-агенты на базе готовых LLM (GPT, Claude и др.). Мы не занимаемся классическим анализом данных и обучением ML-моделей с нуля, поэтому отказываемся от проекта из соображений честности (правило шариата) и соответствия списку услуг.

40729259.title: n8n Automation Engineer Needed to Build Recruitment Operations Workflow
40729259.description: We are looking for an experienced Workflow Automation Engineer to build the core automation infrastructure for a recruitment/staffing operations system. The system will automate repetitive recruitment workflows while keeping recruiters involved in important decisions. This project is primarily about workflow orchestration, integrations and business logic. AI models and AI-specific logic will be handled separately by another specialist. Another developer will provide AI components/endpoints that your workflow will call. 40729060.title: Automated AI Newsletter Pipeline Creation
40729060.description: Job Title: Build a Fully Automated Daily AI Newsletter Pipeline (n8n / Make.com + LLM + ESP) Project Overview We are seeking an experienced automation specialist to design, build, and deploy an end-to-end, fully automated daily newsletter system. The system must run autonomously on a scheduled daily trigger, pull or receive input topics, generate a high-quality newsletter using an LLM based on our strict style and brand instructions, format it into a responsive HTML email, and dispatch it to an audience of ~1,000 subscribers via a dedicated Email Service Provider (ESP). Key Deliverables & Scope of Work 1. Workflow Automation Setup (n8n or Make.com) * Build a scheduled daily workflow (e.g., triggered every morning at a specified time). * Configure data input mechanisms (e.g., pulling daily topics from a Google Sheet, Airtable, RSS feed, or webhook trigger). * Implement error handling, alerting (e.g., Slack or Telegram notification if the run fails), and automatic retries. 2. AI Content Generation Engine * Integrate an LLM API (OpenAI GPT-4o, Anthropic Claude, or similar). * Structure robust system prompts reflecting our fixed brand guidelines, tone of voice, structure, and audience positioning. * Ensure output is cleanly structured, hallucination-resistant, and formatted automatically into clean, email-safe HTML/Markdown. 3. Email Infrastructure & ESP Integration * Connect the workflow to a scalable bulk/transactional email provider (e.g., Resend, Brevo, MailerLite, or Amazon SES). * Set up list management for ~1,000 active subscribers, including automated bounce and unsubscribe handling. * Ensure the email template includes required compliance elements (one-click unsubscribe link, physical address footer) adhering to CAN-SPAM and GDPR guidelines. 4. Domain Deliverability & DNS Verification * Audit and configure our sending domain’s DNS records: SPF, DKIM, and DMARC to ensure 99%+ primary inbox placement and prevent spam filtering under Gmail/Yahoo sender rules. * Advise on a brief warm-up strategy if using a fresh sending domain or dedicated IP. 5. Review Mode & Handover * Create an optional switch/toggle for a "Human-in-the-Loop" mode (e.g., workflow generates a draft and waits for approval / saves as a scheduled draft in the ESP) before going 100% autonomous. * Provide a brief Loom video or documentation explaining how to adjust prompt parameters, manage the subscriber list, and monitor workflow health. Required Skills & Experience * Proven track record building production automation workflows with Make.com or n8n (self-hosted or cloud). * Hands-on experience with LLM API prompt engineering and automated content pipelines. * Deep knowledge of email infrastructure, deliverability standards (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, BIMI), and ESP APIs (Resend, Brevo, SendGrid, MailerLite). * Ability to write clean, mobile-responsive HTML email templates compatible across Apple Mail, Gmail, and Outlook. Application Instructions To be considered, please reply with: * A brief 2–3 sentence overview of a similar automated email/content pipeline you have built. * Your recommended stack for this project (e.g., n8n vs. Make, which ESP, which LLM) and why. * Your estimated timeline and fixed fee for this setup. * The word "PIPELINE" at the top of your proposal to confirm you’ve read the full scope.

40730259.title: Python , AI Automation , LLM , Cloude Code Writer
40730259.description: I want a single, well-structured codebase that lets me spin up my own AI-driven bot. The core language must be Python, and the engine behind it should rely on a modern large-language-model stack (OpenAI, Llama 2, or anything comparable you are comfortable fine-tuning). Primary goals • The bot must answer natural-language questions drawn from my private knowledge base just as a customer-service agent would. • It should also trigger or carry out repetitive tasks I specify—think updating a sheet, generating a quick summary, or pushing a notification—so that day-to-day busywork is removed from my plate. Context of use This is for my own personal workflows, not a public website, so I do not need a glossy front end. A clean CLI, a lightweight desktop window, or a simple local web panel is enough as long as I can extend it later. Key expectations • Modular Python code with clear separation between the LLM interface, the prompt/knowledge-base retrieval logic, and the task-automation hooks. • Ability to load my documents (PDF, DOCX, plain text) or scrape a folder and create embeddings so the bot replies with accurate, citation-backed answers. • Reusable functions or an event queue where I can drop in new “automation snippets” (for instance, write entry to Google Sheet, rename files, send a pre-written email). • Config file or environment variables for all API keys and model options—no secrets hard-coded. • A concise README that lets me install dependencies, run the bot locally, and add new tasks in under 10 minutes on a fresh machine. Acceptance criteria 1. I can type a question in the interface and receive a context-aware answer sourced from my documents. 2. When a trigger phrase or slash-command is used, the relevant automation runs and returns a confirmation message. 3. All functions are covered by basic unit tests and pass with one command (pytest preferred). If you have demonstrable experience combining Python automation with LLMs, I’d love to see a quick outline of how you would structure this and which open-source libraries you’d lean on (LangChain, llama-cpp-python, etc.). I’m ready to start as soon as the approach is clear.
40730259.decision: Это комбинированный заказ: ИИ-агент на базе LLM (Claude/GPT) + автоматизация задач. Полностью покрывается услугой 'ИИ-агент/чат-бот' ($140) + элементами интеграции и доработки. Бюджет заказчика (12500–37500 INR ≈ $150–450) позволяет. Проект на Python, модульный код, загрузка документов, встроенные автоматизации — всё в моём стеке.
40730259.proposal:
I'll build you a modular Python codebase that combines an LLM-powered knowledge-base agent with task automation. Here's my approach:

**Architecture:** I'll use LangChain or Llama-cpp-python to interface with Claude or Groq (depending on your preference), connect it to a vector database for your document embeddings (PDFs, DOCX, text), and layer on an event-driven automation system for your repetitive tasks (Google Sheets updates, file operations, notifications via Telegram).

**What you'll get:**
- CLI or lightweight web interface (Flask-based) to chat with your bot and trigger automations
- Document loader that creates embeddings and retrieves context for accurate, cited answers
- Reusable automation hooks (functions you can extend easily)
- Config.yaml for all API keys and model settings—no hardcoded secrets
- Unit tests with pytest, plus a README that gets you running in <10 minutes

**Timeline:** 42 days. This includes time for me to test edge cases, refine prompt logic, and document everything properly.

Quick questions: 1) Do you prefer OpenAI, Claude, or a local Llama model? 2) Which automation tasks are your top 3 priorities to start with?

40731036.title: # Senior C#/.NET Developer Needed, Production-Grade Multi-LDPlayer Automation Control Center

Begin processing the task queue. The application must never launch more instances than the selected limit. The selected worker count should be configurable without changing source code. ## 2. LDPlayer Management Use appropriate LDPlayer management mechanisms such as ldconsole.exe and ADB, where applicable. Features: - Auto-detect LDPlayer installation - Manual executable-path configuration - Discover emulator instances - Display instance ID/name - Start - Stop - Restart - Health monitoring - Crash detection - Unresponsive-instance detection - Automatic recovery - Per-instance locking - Prevent two workers from controlling the same instance The software must not rely on hard-coded machine-specific paths. ## 3. TXT Task Queue The operator will import a .txt file containing one authorized task/number per line. Example: Task/Number 001 Task/Number 002 Task/Number 003 Task/Number 004 Task/Number 005 Processing pipeline: Import → Validate → Normalize → Deduplicate → Persistent Queue → Worker Assignment The queue must maintain task order while allowing multiple workers to process different queue items concurrently. Each task must have a unique internal ID. The same task must never be assigned to two workers simultaneously. Dashboard statistics: - Total - Valid - Invalid - Duplicate - Pending - Running - Completed - Failed - Retry - Manual Action Required Persist all task states using SQLite. If the application crashes or closes unexpectedly, unfinished tasks must be recoverable after restart without duplicate execution. ## 4. Multi-Worker Engine Implement a proper bounded worker-pool architecture. Example: Worker 01 → LDPlayer 01 Worker 02 → LDPlayer 02 Worker 03 → LDPlayer 03 ... Worker 10 → LDPlayer 10 Requirements: - Thread-safe queue - Configurable concurrency - Per-instance locking - No duplicate task assignment - Pause/resume - Cancellation - Graceful shutdown - Worker health monitoring - Automatic worker recovery - Persistent worker/task state One failed emulator or worker must never crash the entire application. ## 5. Browser-Based Workflow Inside each assigned LDPlayer instance: 1. Wait for Android readiness. 2. Verify the configured browser exists. 3. Launch the browser. 4. Navigate to the configured authorized account-recovery workflow. 5. Retrieve the next task from the queue. 6. Enter the task data into the appropriate workflow field. 7. Continue through the normal authorized recovery process. 8. Detect the current workflow state. 9. Determine the result/state. 10. Record the result. 11. Release the worker. 12. Automatically obtain the next queued task. The workflow must use reliable UI/state detection rather than depending primarily on fixed coordinates or arbitrary delays. Browser path and configuration must be configurable. ## 6. Workflow Engine Build a reusable state-machine workflow engine. Each workflow step must support: - UI/state detection - Timeout - Retry - Cancellation - Er

40728532.decision: Этот заказ — SEO и линк-билдинг, это не входит в мой профиль услуг. Я делаю Python-автоматизации (боты, парсеры, генерацию контента, интеграции). SEO, построение ссылок и цифровой PR — совсем другая специальность, требующая опыта в инструментах типа Ahrefs, Semrush, опыта аутрича и знания SEO-стратегии. Я честно не смогу это делать.

40729915.title: Full-Stack SaaS Automation Build
40729915.description: I have an existing SaaS concept that needs to evolve into a production-ready platform with heavy automation. The stack I want to consolidate around is: • Next.js for the customer-facing frontend and dashboard • Node.js and Python side-by-side on the backend (Node for real-time API endpoints, Python for data crunching and AI tasks) • PostgreSQL (with room for MySQL where legacy data requires it) • n8n as the primary workflow engine Your first milestone will be to map the current manual workflows—lead capture, CRM hand-off, email/WhatsApp notifications—and recreate them in n8n with robust error handling and webhook triggers. From there we’ll layer in OpenAI-powered actions such as auto-enrichment of leads and summarised notifications. On the application side, I need clean Next.js pages wired to a freshly structured REST/GraphQL layer in Node, with Python micro-services spun up where the AI jobs live. Role-based access, an admin console, and scheduled background jobs are part of the scope. Key deliverables 1. Source-controlled Next.js frontend with responsive UI components 2. Dual-language backend (Node + Python) with documented APIs 3. n8n flows covering lead intake, CRM sync, messaging, and scheduled reports 4. Database schema migration scripts for PostgreSQL 5. Test suite (unit + integration) and CI/CD pipeline to our cloud environment 6. 40729915.decision: Проект требует полнофункциональную разработку SaaS-платформы с Next.js фронтендом, Node.js/GraphQL бэкендом, дизайном UI, CI/CD пайплайном и развёртыванием. Это выходит за рамки моих услуг (я делаю только Python-автоматизации). Кроме того, заказчик настаивает на n8n как основной платформе для workflows, а я работаю только на Python. Бюджет $30–250 не покрывает даже одну из этих задач в полном объёме.

40728664.title: Autonomous AI Marketing Agent Creation
40728664.description: Here is a complete, copy-pasteable job description tailored specifically for Freelancer.com.It uses precise technical terminology (like multi-agent workflows, RAG, and API integrations) while leaving room for you to fill in your specific target channels. 40728664.decision: Проект полностью совпадает с профилем: это Python-автоматизация контента (тексты, шортсы) + интеграции с API (LinkedIn, Instagram, Email, Slack/Telegram) + мониторинг результатов. Я делаю ровно это — ИИ-генерацию контента и автопостинг по расписанию. Бюджет заказчика 750–1500 USD позволяет собрать комплект: генерация + мультиканальный постинг + дашборд уведомлений + аналитика. 40728664.proposal:

40727562.title: AI Sales Chatbot for Business Website
40727562.description: I need an experienced AI Automation Developer to build and integrate a sales chatbot automation into an existing business website. The website is already built. Human handoff functionality 7. Testing and bug fixes 8. Source/workflow files 9. Basic setup documentation 10. Short handover walkthrough Budget: Fixed $90 USD Please apply only if you have real experience with AI chatbots, APIs, webhooks, n8n/Make, and business automation. When applying, please send: - 1–3 examples of similar work - Which tools you recommend for this project - Estimated delivery time - Confirmation that you can complete the entire project within the fixed budget
40727562.decision: Проект требует встроить чатбот на существующий веб-сайт.
