Клиент также открыт для n8n/Make, но указывает, что это не обязательно — однако основная задача (встройка в существующий сайт с UI/UX) всё равно не входит в мой профиль. Честнее отказать, чем обещать работу, которую я не могу гарантировать качественно.

40727864.title: AI Chat Agent & Automation Integration
40727864.description: I’m ready to take our website from “good enough” to “always-on sales machine.” The first milestone is a robust AI chat agent that can greet visitors, qualify them, and push them to the right product or straight into our checkout flow. That conversational layer is my top priority because I see it driving the fastest jump in conversions and average order value. Once the chat agent is live and stable, I also want two supporting automations rolled in: • Missed-call text-back so every unanswered phone inquiry triggers a quick SMS follow-up that guides prospects back to the site or the chat agent. • Automated booking that lets qualified leads schedule calls or demos without human intervention, tying directly into our calendar system. I’m looking for someone who has hands-on experience deploying this kind of stack—whether you’ve used Dialogflow, GPT-powered solutions, Twilio, Zapier, or a custom workflow, show me what you’ve actually shipped and the results it delivered. Please keep proposals focused on relevant experience; lengthy boilerplate will be skipped. Success for me is simple: an AI chat agent that’s converting, automations that close the gap on any missed touchpoints, clean analytics so we can see lift in real time, and documentation I can hand to my team for ongoing tweaks. If that sounds like your wheelhouse, let’s talk timelines and integration details.
40727864.decision: Заказ покрывается услугами: ИИ-агент (Claude/GPT) + интеграция с SMS (Twilio API) + интеграция с календарём (Google Calendar API через Python). Все компоненты делаю на Python. Бюджет в INR конвертируется примерно в $18–150 USD; беру заказ по своей цене, так как основной результат (chat agent + automations) — в моём профиле.
40727864.proposal: I build AI chat agents and automations—this is exactly my wheelhouse. Here's what I'll deliver: (1) a conversational AI agent on Claude or GPT that greets visitors, qualifies them, and routes them to checkout or a product page; (2) Twilio SMS integration so missed calls trigger automated follow-ups guiding prospects back to your chat or site; (3) automated booking tied to Google Calendar, letting qualified leads self-schedule without human touch. I work in Python end-to-end—no Zapier or no-code tools, just clean custom code that integrates tightly with your stack. I've built similar setups: Telegram bots handling lead intake and routing them into sales funnels, schedulers syncing with calendars automatically, SMS notification systems on top of phone monitoring. For analytics, I'll log all chat interactions and booking events so you can track conversions and see the lift in real time. Everything is documented for your team to tweak. Timeline: 45 days covers the chat agent, API integrations, testing, and handoff docs—I build in buffer because I'm new here and want zero bugs at delivery. Two quick questions: (1) Do you have a preferred LLM (GPT, Claude, open-source)? (2) What's your current phone system—do you already log missed calls somewhere, or do we need to set that up?

40726810.title: AI Content & Research Automation
40726810.description: I need an end-to-end automation system that lets me focus on strategy instead of repetitive work. Top priority My main pain point is keeping a steady flow of quality posts and articles. I want an AI-driven workflow that drafts long-form pieces, adapts them into shorter updates, then schedules and publishes them automatically to LinkedIn, Twitter and Instagram. Once a post goes live I’d like the system to pull basic engagement metrics so I can see what is working without logging into each platform. Company research In parallel, I carry out industry-specific company research. I only need help with the data-collection stage: scraping or pulling fresh firmographic data, enriching it with public sources, and storing everything in a structured format that my existing dashboards can read. If you can connect this research feed to the content pipeline (for example, to suggest timely article angles) even better. Nice-to-have The framework should be flexible enough to add email outreach later, but this is not part of the initial scope unless you see an elegant way to fold it in without inflating cost or complexity. What I expect from you • A short discovery call to confirm my exact workflow • A written architecture plan outlining tools (e.g., OpenAI, LangChain, Zapier/Make, Python scripts, relevant APIs) and how they talk to each other • Build and configuration of the agents, automations and data storage • A brief hand-off session plus concise documentation so I can tweak prompts, posting cadence and data sources myself • An itemised cost estimate covering one-off setup, any paid connectors or model usage, and projected monthly overhead Acceptance criteria 1. I can drop a topic or URL into the system and receive platform-ready drafts within minutes. 2. New company records appear automatically in my database without manual scraping. 3. One-click scheduling posts them to LinkedIn, Twitter and Instagram, with confirmation logs. 4. All moving parts run for a full week in a staging environment with no critical errors. Please tell me how you would tackle this, which off-the-shelf components you would leverage versus custom code, and your timeline to deliver each milestone along with the final costs.
40726810.decision: Проект выходит за границы профиля. Заказчик просит: (1) архитектурный план с выбором инструментов (OpenAI, LangChain, Zapier/Make, Python); (2) discovery-звонок; (3) handoff-сессию и документацию; (4) неделю тестирования в staging; (5) смету по компонентам и месячным расходам. Это консультация по архитектуре, дизайн решения и техническое лидерство — услуги вне профиля. В профиле я делаю конкретные автоматизации (боты, постинг, парсеры, агенты), а не проектирую сложные многоэтапные системы с выбором инструментов, архитектурными планами и расчётом расходов. Кроме того, заказчик ожидает calls и sessions, которые требуют личного взаимодействия, а я работаю только письменно через чат площадки.

40722494.title: Build My Multifunctional AI Assistant
40722494.description: I’m ready to move beyond scattered apps and build a single “Ultron-style” assistant that can truly shoulder my daily workload. The goal is a custom augmented-AI system that logs in as me, carries out routine and data-driven tasks, then feeds back concise, actionable summaries so I stay informed without micro-managing. Scope of work • Email management – draft, filter, respond, flag priorities and send me a morning and end-of-day brief. • Scheduling & appointments – check calendar conflicts, propose meeting slots, dispatch invites, reschedule when conflicts arise, and notify participants automatically. • Data analysis & reporting – pull data from spreadsheets, CRMs or project tools, run basic analytics or predefined models, and push visual summaries. • Administration, project-management and customer-service workflows – update task boards, trigger reminders, log support tickets, draft knowledge-base replies and surface high-risk issues in real time. • Real-time updates – a dashboard or chat interface that shows what the assistant is currently executing and its latest findings. Technical notes – I’m tool-agnostic: Python, Node, LangChain, Zapier, Power Automate or comparable stacks are all welcome if they achieve reliable integrations with Gmail/Outlook, Google Workspace or Microsoft 365, Slack/Teams, Trello/Jira and a mainstream CRM. – Security and permissions must be handled cleanly (OAuth wherever possible; no hard-coding credentials). – The AI can use off-the-shelf LLMs (OpenAI, Claude, etc.) for reasoning and summarisation so long as prompts and chain-of-thought are shielded from end users. Deliverables 1. Working prototype with core email + calendar + reporting flows. 2. Integration scripts / APIs documented for future expansion. 3. User guide: how to trigger tasks, adjust settings and read the summary feed. 4. Deployment walk-through so I can host it on my preferred cloud or local server. Acceptance criteria • Each listed workflow executes autonomously end-to-end at least 90 % of the time. • Daily summary is under 300 words yet captures every completed task and any blockers. • Response latency for real-time alerts <60 seconds. • Source code, prompts and setup docs delivered in a private repo. If you’ve built personal assistants, RPA bots or LangChain agents that juggle multiple integrations, I’d love to see demos or repos. I’m aiming for a quick proof-of-concept first, then an iterative roadmap we’ll shape together.
40722494.decision: Проект выходит за границы услуг профиля. Клиент требует полноценного персонального ассистента, который логирует учётные данные, управляет почтой, календарём, CRM, досками проектов и предоставляет Real-time Dashboard. Это комплексная система, которая требует: (1) разработки многоинтеграционного агента на уровне RPA/аварийного управления бизнес-процессами, а не отдельного бота; (2) безопасного хранения и ротации OAuth-токенов в масштабах, выходящих за рамки простого Telegram-бота или парсера; (3) собственной архитектуры развёртывания с очередями задач, мониторингом и логированием; (4) поддержки множественных платформ (Gmail, Outlook, Slack, Teams, Trello, Jira, CRM) с синхронизацией состояния. Профиль покрывает отдельные услуги (ИИ-агент за $140, интеграция CRM за $120, парсер за $80), но их сумма не соответствует масштабу и сложности проекта. Это заказ на уровне $1500–3000, а не $400–500. Для честного выполнения нужна специалист по RPA и enterprise-интеграциям, а не одноразовый автопостинг или телеграм-бот.

40728606.title: WhatsApp Product-Info Chatbot Build
40728606.description: I want to give my customers an easy way to ask about any product through WhatsApp and instantly receive accurate, up-to-date details. The task is to design, code, and hand over a chatbot that sits on my existing WhatsApp Business number and handles all “Information retrieval” requests about our catalog. Core flow • Customer sends a product name, SKU, or keyword. • Bot looks the item up in my data source (JSON, CSV, Google Sheet, or a small SQL table—whichever you recommend for stability and easy updates). • It replies with price, brief description, availability, and a link or image. • If the query doesn’t match anything, the bot offers alternative suggestions and, on repeated failure, escalates to a live agent. Technical notes Use any robust WhatsApp Business API approach (Meta Cloud API, Twilio, Gupshup, etc.) as long as it keeps running after hand-off and I can swap keys without code changes. I’m on a shared cPanel server but can spin up a small VPS or Heroku-style container if Node.js, Python (Flask/FastAPI), or PHP is better suited. Please build it so product data can be refreshed with a simple file upload or sheet edit—no code redeploys. Deliverables 1. Source code with a short README that covers local setup, environment variables, and deployment. 2. Simple admin guide showing how to update the product list and where logs live. 3. One live demo call to verify everything works end-to-end on my WhatsApp Business number. Timeline is flexible—there’s no hard deadline—so quality, clarity, and clean hand-off matter more than speed.
40728606.decision: Проект полностью покрывается услугой 'ИИ-агент / чат-бот на базе Claude, GPT, Gemini, Groq' (WhatsApp-интеграция через API — стандартная задача Python). Интеграция через Twilio или Meta Cloud API, хранение данных в JSON/CSV/Google Sheets, логика escalation — всё это делается на Python. Заказчик готов к гибким срокам, нет запретов по шариату.
40728606.proposal:
I'll build you a WhatsApp chatbot that retrieves product info instantly and escalates to a live agent when needed. Here's how it works:

**What I'll deliver:**
1. Python-based bot using Twilio or Meta Cloud API (I recommend Twilio for reliability and easy setup on shared hosting)
2. Product data stored in Google Sheets or a simple SQLite database—you update it directly, no code redeploy needed
3. Smart lookup: customer sends a product name/SKU → bot searches your catalog → replies with price, description, availability, and image/link
4. Escalation logic: if no match, suggests alternatives; after 2 failed attempts, routes to live agent
5. Clean source code + README with setup steps, environment variables, and deployment guide to Heroku or your VPS
6. Admin guide showing where logs are and how to manage the product list
7. One live demo call on your WhatsApp Business number to verify end-to-end

**Technical approach:** Python + FastAPI/Flask running on Heroku (free tier or small paid dyno, ~$5–10/month). Twilio handles WhatsApp routing securely. Product data in Google Sheets stays synced via API—zero downtime updates.

**Timeline:** 21 days (includes setup, testing, and buffer for refinements).

A few quick questions:
- Do you have a Twilio account already, or should I guide you through setup?
- Roughly how many products in your catalog?
- Do you want escalation to a Telegram group, email, or manual agent reply in WhatsApp?

Let's build this clean and solid for you.

40731652.title: n8n Automation Developer Needed
40731652.description: Hiring: n8n Automation Developer Digital GMR Studio is looking for a skilled n8n Automation Developer to work with us on client automation projects. We are looking for someone who can build reliable, practical automations using n8n and connect different tools, APIs, CRMs, Google Sheets, email, WhatsApp, AI tools, and other business applications. What you’ll do: - Build and maintain n8n workflows - Connect APIs and third-party tools - Create AI-powered automations - Automate lead collection and follow-ups - Integrate Google Sheets, CRMs, email and other platforms - Troubleshoot and improve existing workflows - Build workflows according to client requirements What we’re looking for: - Good hands-on experience with n8n - Understanding of APIs, webhooks and JSON - Experience with AI/API integrations - Ability to understand client requirements - Good communication and problem-solving skills - Ability to deliver projects on time Work: Remote / Project-based We are looking for a developer who can work with us on an ongoing basis as our client projects grow. To apply, please send: 1. Your n8n experience 2. 2–3 examples of workflows you've built 3. Your project-based or hourly rate 4. Your availability Company: Digital GMR Studio
40731652.decision: Заказчик ищет разработчика n8n, а я работаю на Python. В профиле четко написано: если заказчику нужен именно n8n/Make/Zapier — вежливо отказываемся. Отклик был бы нечестным.

40731517.title: Website Product AI Chatbot
40731517.description: I need a context-aware assistant that can live on our website and confidently answer product-specific questions. Your task is to build a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) agent—whether you prefer Voiceflow, Botpress, LangChain + LlamaIndex, or Flowise—then train it on our existing PDFs (product manuals, release notes, and past support threads exported to PDF). The finished bot should: • Parse those PDFs into a vector store (Pinecone, pgvector, or Chroma—your call) • Deliver accurate responses in natural language, recognizing when to escalate to a human agent • Log every conversation for analytics and continual improvement • Embed smoothly as a React / Next.js widget styled with Tailwind Acceptance criteria 1. Answers 90 %+ of test prompts pulled from real tickets without hallucinations. 2. Fallback flow triggers when confidence drops below a threshold we define together. 3. Deployment URL and simple instructions for my dev team to replicate in staging. Please outline your preferred toolchain, prior RAG work, and any extra data you may need so we can start right away.
40731517.decision: Проект требует встраивания в React/Next.js виджет и развёртывание на сайте клиента. Это выходит за рамки моих услуг — я делаю Python-скрипты и Telegram-ботов, но не фронтенд-интеграции и не веб-приложения. Также клиент просит конкретные инструменты (Voiceflow, Botpress, LangChain + LlamaIndex, Flowise) — я работаю только на Python. Хотя RAG-агент на Python я могу сделать, встраивание в React-виджет и развёртывание на их инфраструктуре — это веб-разработка, которой я не занимаюсь.

40732024.title: Engaging AI Product Promo Videos
40732024.description: I run a small-but-growing ecommerce shop and want to freshen up my marketing with short AI-generated videos that blend live-action footage and animation. Each clip should feel friendly and casual, quickly showing what the product does, then closing with a clear special-offer splash and call-to-action. Here’s what matters to me: • Style & tone A seamless mix of real footage and tasteful motion graphics that keeps things light rather than overly slick. Think TikTok or Instagram Reels energy—authentic, upbeat, no stiff corporate vibe. • Core content 1. A concise product demonstration that highlights key benefits in seconds. 2. 40731913.title: Automate Shopify Discounted Shipping
40731913.description: I’m looking for someone who can eliminate the extra UPS charges we incur whenever an item is shipped from our Chico, CA factory instead of our main Eagan, MN warehouse. We already receive Shopify’s negotiated UPS rates in Eagan; the goal is to make sure that same discounted label prints automatically—without anyone on our team having to intervene—whenever an order is fulfilled from Chico. Here’s the exact flow I need implemented: • After the customer checks out, the system should recognise that stock is being pulled from the Chico location and still generate a UPS label at the Shopify-discounted rate. • If Shopify’s discount truly cannot be applied from that second location, every affected SKU must be tagged “OUT OF STOCK-CHICO” each day, and any resulting order needs a “DROPSHIP-CHICO” tag so our team can handle it before fulfilment. We already manage inventory for both sites in our existing system, so you can hook into that data rather than build tracking from scratch. Ideally this is set up through Shopify’s shipping profiles, carrier-calculated rates, or the Admin/API—whatever reliably automates the discount application. Once in place, I want the process fully hands-off: we update stock, the right label prints, and the customer experience stays seamless. Deliverables that will let me sign off: 1. Working automation that prints the Shopify-discounted UPS label for Chico-origin shipments, or documented proof it’s impossible with a secondary fallback tagging workflow live in the store. 2. Clear explanation of any app, script, or API changes you make, with steps my staff can use for future edits. 3. Short test plan showing orders fulfilled from both sites and the resulting shipping charges or tags. If you’re comfortable with Shopify Admin API, carrier services, and multi-location fulfilment, I’d like to get this in place quickly so our ad-spend isn’t eaten up by unnecessary shipping costs.
40731913.decision: Проект требует интеграции Shopify API с Python-скриптом для автоматизации подбора ярлыков доставки и тегирования заказов. Это входит в услугу «Интеграция с CRM через API» (Shopify плюс автоматизация), плюс возможно парсинг данных инвентаря. Заказчик хочет результат без вмешательства, что подходит под автоматизацию. Бюджет 30–250 USD позволяет работать в нашем диапазоне.
40731913.proposal: I understand the challenge: you need Shopify to print discounted UPS labels for Chico shipments automatically, or fall back to tagging orders for manual handling if the discount can't be applied. I'll build a Python script that hooks into Shopify Admin API to monitor fulfillments by location, apply carrier-calculated rates with your negotiated discount, and auto-tag orders with "DROPSHIP-CHICO" if needed. The script will sync with your existing inventory system and run on schedule—no manual work. Deliverables: working automation (label printing or fallback tagging), documentation for your team, and a test plan with sample orders from both locations. A few clarifications: (1) Do you already have API credentials for Shopify Admin, or should I guide you through setup? (2) What system manages your multi-location inventory—Shopify native, a third-party tool, or internal database? (3) For the UPS discount: is it tied to a specific Shopify shipping profile, or do you have a separate UPS contract agreement I need to reference? I can deliver this in 21 days.

40732437.title: Python AI Data Cleaning Automation
40732437.description: I need a set of well-structured Python scripts that automatically clean and validate raw data so it is ready for downstream analysis. Deliverables 1. Clean, commented Python code in a Git-ready repo. 2. A README explaining how to configure cloud credentials and run the pipeline locally or in CI/CD. 3. Sample test cases (pytest) proving the validation rules work. 4. The generated cleaning report in HTML/Markdown for the sample dataset I’ll provide after kickoff. Acceptance criteria: the test suite passes, the report matches the expected row counts and error rates, and the code deploys without modification on my cloud instance. I’m aiming for maintainable, production-grade code, so please highlight any best-practice choices you make regarding logging, config management or environment reproducibility.
40732437.decision: Проект требует разработки сложной системы обработки данных с архитектурой, документацией, CI/CD, тестами и deployment на облачные платформы — это выходит далеко за рамки моих услуг. Я делаю целевые автоматизации (боты, парсеры, генерация контента), а не проектирую production-grade data pipelines. Бюджет большой (≈$150–450), но объём работы здесь соответствует full-stack разработчику, а не специалисту по автоматизации на Python.

40732380.title: Generative AI Filmmaker for Social Ads
40732380.description: AI Creative Producer / AI Filmmaker TOYO Kombucha | Delhi / About TOYO KOMBUCHA POSITIONING People spend most of their day working, rushing, achieving and keeping up. Somewhere between 9 to 5, life gets postponed. Toyo exists for what happens after work. We believe your day shouldn't end when work ends. That's when your actual life begins — the people you meet, the music you listen to, the conversations you have, the places you go, or simply the hour you spend doing absolutely nothing. Toyo is the kombucha for your 5 to 9. Not another drink telling you to be more productive, healthier, or better at optimizing yourself. A drink that tells you: Get a Life. . We are looking for an AI Creative Producer / AI Filmmaker who can take a strong creative idea and turn it into a realistic, social-first advertisement using generative AI. This is an execution-heavy role. The creative concepts, positioning and scripts will largely come from the TOYO marketing team. Your job is to figure out how to make those ideas actually look and feel real. What You'll Do 1. Turn concepts into realistic AI films Take a written creative brief/script and translate it into: Concept → storyboard → shots → AI generation → editing → sound → final film You should be comfortable working with tools such as: ● Higgsfield ● Veo ● Kling ● Runway ● Seedance ● Midjourney / image-generation tools ● ElevenLabs or equivalent voice tools ● Premiere Pro / After Effects / CapCut / equivalent editing software You do NOT need to use every tool listed above. We care about the final output, not the tool stack. 2. Create photorealistic humans and environments You should be able to create AI footage that feels like real commercial/UGC footage, rather than obvious AI animation. This includes: ● Natural human movement ● Realistic facial expressions ● Indian characters and environments ● Realistic lighting ● Natural camera movement ● Consistent characters across shots ● Realistic product interaction 3. Integrate real products into AI-generated environments TOYO is a beverage brand, so product accuracy is extremely important. You should be able to work with supplied product photographs/references and maintain: ● Correct bottle shape ● Correct label ● Correct colours ● Correct proportions ● Consistency across shots 4. Dialogue, voice & lip-sync Create believable: ● Dialogue ● Voiceovers ● Lip-sync ● Natural conversational delivery 5. Editing & sound design You will be responsible for taking generated footage and turning it into a finished social advertisement. This includes: ● Editing ● Pacing ● Transitions ● Sound effects ● Ambient sound ● Dialogue mixing ● Music where appropriate ● Captions/text ● Final export We particularly value sound design, not simply adding a trending song underneath a video. 6. Work closely with the Marketing/Creative Lead You will receive: ● Creative concept ● Script ● Brand direction ● Product assets ● References ● Desired tone You will be expected to suggest how the idea can best be executed using AI, while preserving the original creative thought. What We're NOT Looking For Please do not apply if your work is primarily: ● 3D animation ● Cartoon-style AI ● Generic AI landscapes ● AI avatars reading scripts ● Slideshows with AI images ● Template-based Reels ● Simple text-to-video experiments We are specifically looking for realistic commercial filmmaking using generative AI. Ideal Candidate You may be: ● AI Filmmaker ● Generative AI Filmmaker ● AI Creative Producer ● AI Video Producer ● Generative AI Video Creator ● AI Commercial Director ● AI Video Creative You should have: ● Strong understanding of visual storytelling ● Excellent sense of composition and cinematography ● Strong editing skills ● Understanding of sound design ● Experience creating realistic AI video ● Ability to work from a creative brief rather than needing to originate every idea ● Strong attention to detail ● Ability to iterate quickly Experience with advertising, D2C, FMCG, food/beverage
40732380.decision: Проект требует создания реалистичных AI-фильмов для социальной рекламы с использованием специализированных видео-генераторов (Runway, Kling, Veo и т.д.), профессионального видеомонтажа, звукодизайна и работы с визуальной составляющей. Это не входит в мой стек услуг — я разработчица Python-автоматизаций, а не AI-кинематографист или видео-продюсер. Хотя я работаю с ИИ-генерацией контента (тексты, озвучка, шортсы), этот проект требует экспертизы в видеопроизводстве, композиции, кинематографии и специальных видео-инструментах, которыми я не владею. Мой профиль — автоматизация бизнес-процессов, а не creative production.

40732351.title: Roofing Leads via Ads & Automation
40732351.description: I need a predictable flow of qualified roofing leads and a system that follows up automatically until they book an appointment. The plan is to split my ad budget evenly between Google Ads and Meta Ads (Facebook/Instagram), then pipe every click-to-call, form fill, and chat into a single CRM where AI-driven texts and emails handle the first touches. Here’s what the engagement looks like: • Build and launch high-converting search, display, and social campaigns on both Google Ads and Meta Ads, complete with compelling creative, copy, keywords, negative lists, and audience targeting. • Connect all lead sources to my CRM; set up tagging, pipeline stages, and real-time notifications so nothing slips through the cracks. • Craft AI follow-up sequences (SMS, email, ringless voicemail) that nurture new inquiries for at least 14 days or until they’re scheduled on our calendar. • Implement tracking—GA4, Meta Pixel, offline conversions, and call tracking—so we can see cost per lead and booked-job ROI in one report. • Optimize weekly: pause losers, scale winners, tweak offers, and keep the automations firing correctly. Acceptance criteria: campaigns live in both ad accounts, CRM automation tested end-to-end, and a baseline report delivered after the first seven days. When you reply, focus on experience—specifically any home-service or roofing campaigns you’ve managed, the results you achieved, and the tech stack you used. Let’s create a lead engine that keeps my crews busy year-round.
40732351.decision: Заказ требует услуг вне профиля: создание и запуск рекламных кампаний в Google Ads и Meta Ads, управление бюджетом объявлений, copywriting для объявлений, создание и оптимизацию креатива, управление аудиториями и ключевыми словами, еженедельную оптимизацию кампаний. Это работа SMM-специалиста и медиа-байера, не разработчика Python-автоматизаций. Я могу только интегрировать готовые источники лидов в CRM и настроить автоматизацию follow-up, но создание и запуск самих кампаний — не мой профиль.

40732336.title: Animated AI Product Launch Ad
40732336.description: A new retail product is about to hit the shelves and I want to unveil it with a short, punchy AI-generated animation that instantly communicates its benefits and sparks excitement. The ad will sit on social channels and point-of-sale screens, so it must be clear, memorable, and sized correctly for multiple aspect ratios. Scope • Concept: transform my brief product notes into a concise storyline built for promotion, not general brand awareness. • Production: use AI-driven tools (Runway, Pika, Stable Diffusion, or your proven stack) to create a fully animated spot—no live-action or mixed media. • Variations: deliver one master cut (≈30 s) plus trimmed 15 s and 6 s versions for reels and bumper ads. • Output specs: 1920×1080 and 1080×1920, H.264, ready to publish. • Extras: clean background music, light SFX, and on-screen text captions. Voice-over is optional; if included, synthetic voices are fine as long as they sound natural. Acceptance criteria 1. Animation clearly showcases the product within the first three seconds. 2. Call-to-action appears in every length. 3. No trademark or stock watermarks present. 4. Final files pass a quick ad review upload test on Meta Ads Manager. Please factor two feedback rounds into the timeline so we can fine-tune pacing and visuals before sign-off.
40732336.decision: Основной результат — анимированное видео с AI-генерацией визуальных эффектов (Runway, Pika, Stable Diffusion). Это выходит за рамки моих услуг. Я делаю шортсы с озвучкой и субтитрами (текст + звук + простой монтаж), но не создаю сложную 3D/2D анимацию продуктов и визуальные эффекты в специализированных видеоинструментах. Заказчику нужен видеопродюсер с опытом в motion graphics и AI-видео, а не разработчик Python-автоматизаций.

40732215.title: AI-Powered Vehicle Classifieds
40732215.description: I’m building a full-featured classified ads site dedicated to Cars, Motorcycles and Trucks, and I want it to feel as smart and effortless as the best modern marketplaces. Core platform • Front-end and back-end from scratch (responsive web, clean UI/UX). • Seller dashboard for posting and managing listings, buyer accounts with saved searches and alerts. • Secure payments integration for premium ad placements and spotlight features. • Multilingual architecture ready for future language packs. Essential AI layer The must-haves are: 1. Chatbot for instant user assistance—answer FAQs, guide ad creation, help buyers find matches. 2. Recommendation engine that learns from browsing behaviour to surface the most relevant vehicles. 3. Image recognition that auto-detects make/model/body type when photos are uploaded, speeding up ad creation and improving search accuracy. Additional smart touches I’d like included: • Voice-to-text so sellers can dictate ad descriptions. • AI content generation to polish listings and suggest optimal headlines. • AI-driven SEO tuning (schema markup, keyword suggestions, meta tags). • Automated image/video moderation to block inappropriate content. Tech stack is flexible; I’m comfortable with a modern JS framework (React, Vue or Next) paired with a robust back-end (Laravel, Node, Django or similar) as long as it scales. If you prefer a different stack, let me know your rationale. Deliverables • Fully deployed website on my cloud account (AWS or DigitalOcean). • Source code in Git with clear commits and README. • Short admin guide covering AI model training/setup, third-party keys and routine maintenance. • Two rounds of post-launch tweaks (bug fixes or minor UX refinements). Acceptance criteria The chatbot answers at least 80% of the predefined FAQ set correctly. Image recognition identifies vehicle category with 90% accuracy in testing. Recommendation engine lifts click-through rate on suggested listings by at least 15% after two weeks’ live data. Timelines are negotiable, but please outline a realistic milestone plan when you bid. Looking forward to working together on something innovative and genuinely useful for vehicle enthusiasts.
40732215.decision: Проект требует разработку полного веб-сайта с фронтенд и бэкенд с нуля, дизайном интерфейса, системой платежей и развертыванием на облаке. Это выходит за рамки моих услуг — я делаю Python-автоматизации и боты, а не веб-приложения. Кроме того, объём работы (многоязычная архитектура, 10+ функций ИИ, база данных, админ-панель, развертывание) несоизмерим с моей моделью работы одного разработчика, работающего на проектах под ключ до $180. Это требует команду и недели разработки.

40732171.title: AI-Powered Web App Development
40732171.description: I would like to launch a full-featured web application that relies on artificial intelligence at its core. At this stage the concept is open-ended: I have the general vision of an online service that delivers real-time, intelligent functionality to users, but I still need help refining the exact use case, selecting the most suitable AI model, and shaping the final product roadmap. Here is what I expect from you: • A short discovery phase where we clarify the problem the app will solve and the AI technique that best fits—whether that ends up being computer-vision, NLP, behavioral prediction, or another approach you recommend. • Guidance on dataset strategy. I do not currently have a prepared dataset, so I will rely on your advice for sourcing, cleaning, or augmenting data to train the model legally and ethically. • End-to-end development: model training or fine-tuning, integration with a modern back-end (Python/FastAPI, Node.js, or similar), and a responsive front-end (React, Vue, or comparable) that showcases the AI capability in an intuitive way. • Cloud deployment, CI/CD pipeline, and concise technical documentation so the app can be maintained or scaled after hand-off. Deliverables will be accepted when the web application is (1) accessible on a public staging URL, (2) demonstrates the agreed AI functionality on live data, and (3) includes all source code, a runnable Docker or similar environment file, and clear setup instructions. If you have a portfolio of previous AI-driven web products, share links or demos so I can get a feel for your style. I’m aiming to move quickly once we lock the scope, so please outline your proposed tech stack, timeline, and milestones in your reply.
40732171.decision: Проект требует полноценную веб-разработку с фронтенд-частью (React/Vue), облачное развёртывание, CI/CD и полный цикл машинного обучения с подготовкой датасета. Это выходит за границы моих услуг: я делаю Python-автоматизации и ИИ-агентов, но не строю веб-приложения с интерфейсом, не работаю с ML-моделями и облачной инфраструктурой. Бюджет ($30–250) и масштаб проекта также несоразмерны с этим типом работы.

40732447.title: Modern CRM Frontend Development
40732447.description: We need a modern CRM frontend for our system, inspired by HubSpot’s UI/UX. The application should closely replicate HubSpot’s screen structure, navigation patterns, dashboard layout, tables, forms, filters, sidebars, modals, and overall user experience. The frontend should be developed using React.js or Next.js with a clean, scalable, component-based architecture. It must be fully responsive and optimized for desktop, tablet, and mobile devices. The system should include reusable components such as the main sidebar, top navigation, dashboards, CRM tables, contact and company management screens, deal pipelines, task/activity views, search, filters, forms, dropdowns, notifications, settings, and profile menus. The objective is to achieve a high-quality HubSpot-style CRM experience, while using our own branding, colors, content, and product identity rather than directly copying proprietary HubSpot assets. Preferred Technology: Next.js / React.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, reusable UI component architecture, responsive layouts, API-ready frontend structure, role-based navigation, and clean production-quality code. URL: https://www.hubspot.com/
40732447.decision: Проект требует разработки frontend-приложения на React/Next.js с дизайном и UI/UX. Это веб-приложение, которое не входит в мой профиль услуг — я специализируюсь на Python-автоматизациях, ботах и интеграциях, а не на разработке фронтенда или веб-приложений.

40732975.title: END-TO-END FID AUTOMATION + WEBSITE DEVELOPMENT
40732975.description: I run Smiling Money School, a financial education business focused on helping people work toward their Financial Independence Day (FID) and better financial preparedness for expected and unexpected life events. EXISTING WEBSITE / DOMAIN: money4smiling.com I need an experienced freelancer to develop and integrate my complete FID lead-to-customer automation system. CUSTOMER JOURNEY: Facebook / Instagram Ads → FID Landing Page on money4smiling.com → FID Registration Form → n8n Webhook → Google Sheets / CRM → WhatsApp Business/API Confirmation → FID Group Session (Zoom/Google Meet) → Automated Reminders → Attendance Tracking → 1-to-1 Calendar Booking → Financial Consultation → Payment → Automated Follow-up REQUIRED WORK: 1. Develop/integrate the FID landing page on my existing website. 2. Create/connect the FID registration form. 3. Capture lead name, email and phone number. 4. Send form data automatically to n8n through webhook. 5. Store leads automatically in Google Sheets or CRM without duplicate records. 6. Integrate WhatsApp Business/API for confirmation and reminders. 7. Integrate Zoom or Google Meet for the FID group session. 8. Automate session reminders and attendance tracking. 9. Integrate calendar booking for 1-to-1 financial sessions. 10. Prevent double booking and respect my existing calendar availability. 11. Connect payment/follow-up automation where required. 12. Provide complete n8n workflows and documentation. 13. All integrations must be configured inside my own accounts. IMPORTANT EXPECTATIONS: - No unnecessary manual data transfer. - Lead data should reach Google Sheets/CRM automatically. - WhatsApp automation should reliably trigger when the required API, template and consent conditions are satisfied. - Failed automation/message events should have proper error handling and logging. - The system must be secure and maintainable. - I must have access to all workflows, integrations and accounts. - The freelancer must explain the complete system after development. TESTING / COMPLETION: The project will be considered complete when a test lead can successfully run through the agreed workflow: Landing page → Registration → n8n → Google Sheets/CRM → WhatsApp → FID Group Session → 1-to-1 Booking → Payment/Follow-up. The freelancer should have practical experience with n8n, webhooks, WhatsApp Business/API, Google Sheets, CRM integrations, WordPress/website development, calendar automation and Zoom/Google Meet. Please mention your relevant experience and examples of similar automation projects in your proposal.
40732975.decision: Проект требует разработки и интеграции сайта (website development), что прямо указано в названии и в пункте 1 задачи ('Develop/integrate the FID landing page on my existing website'). Разработка сайтов и дизайн не входят в мой профиль услуг — я работаю только с Python-автоматизациями. Кроме того, заказчик явно требует n8n-workflows ('Provide complete n8n workflows'), а я работаю на Python. Если бы задача была чистой Python-автоматизацией без веб-разработки и без обязательства использовать именно n8n, я бы взялся, но в текущем виде это не мой профиль.

40732800.title: Refine Chatbot for Hospitality Environment
40732800.description: I already have a working hospitality-focused chatbot; what I need now is an AI engineer who can fine-tune it so that it answers guest FAQs flawlessly in English. The model is in production inside a booking engine, yet its responses still feel generic and occasionally miss the subtle context of hotel terminology. Your job is to refine the underlying large-language-model (we are on GPT-4o-mini via an API) so the bot sounds more like an attentive concierge than a scripted agent. Also sometimes it starts hallucinating. which also needs to be fixed. Scope of work * Review the current prompt structure, conversation logs, and training set (≈15 k dialogue pairs). * Design and run a fine-tuning pipeline—feel free to use OpenAI fine-tuning tools, LangChain, or your preferred framework—as long as it can be reproduced in our environment (Python 3.10). * Optimise for: accuracy on policy-compliant answers, reduced hallucinations, and fast first-token latency. * Add robust fallback logic for questions falling outside scope instead of defaulting to “I’m sorry…”. * Deliver an updated model with confidence scores and a short README so my dev team can deploy it directly. Acceptance criteria 1. ≥95 % correct answer rate on our 300-question English FAQ benchmark. 2. Average response time under 1.5 s on a t3.medium test node. 3. No policy violations across 500 random adversarial prompts. If this sounds like your specialty, tell me which fine-tuning approach you prefer and a quick outline of how you would validate improvements.
40732800.decision: Заказ требует доработки существующего продакшена с высокими требованиями к качеству (95% accuracy, <1.5s latency, тестирование на 500 adversarial prompts). Это выходит за рамки услуги 'Доработка Python-скрипта' ($40, 7 дней). Клиент просит fine-tuning модели GPT-4o на 15k диалогов с валидацией на бенчмарке — это специализированный ML-проект, требующий экспертизы в fine-tuning и гарантий качества, которых нет в профиле. Бюджет 10–30 USD несопоставим с объёмом работы. Отказываемся честно.

40732668.title: "Printflow" AI-Powered Print Shop Management System
40732668.description: --- Job Title: Full-Stack Developer to Build “Printflow” – AI-Powered Print Shop Management System Project Overview: I am a non-technical business owner looking for an experienced full-stack developer to build a complete management system for a print shop. The system is called Printflow and is based on a detailed architecture PDF that I will provide to the selected freelancer. Printflow is not just a job tracker. It is three separate but connected domains: 1. Production / Sales – job lifecycle from inquiry to payment. 2. Inventory – materials, stock levels, suppliers, reserved vs consumed quantities. 3. Finance / AP – supplier invoices, payments, purchase costs. A knowledge graph links all three domains. The system includes: · Claude (or similar LLM) as a natural-language interface so the owner can ask questions like “Do we have enough material for all scheduled orders?” · Jev (TypeSafe’s fast decision model) for high-frequency, low-latency decisions such as scoring supplier document confidence and classifying inventory alerts. · A Telegram bot for the owner to interact with the system. · Paperless-ngx integration to ingest supplier invoices and delivery notes via OCR. Scope of Work: The freelancer will build the complete application in phases. I will provide the architecture PDF and API keys. The freelancer will deliver the full source code. VPS setup, GitHub repository creation, and deployment are NOT part of this job. I will handle those myself. Phase 1 – Scaffolding · Create project folder structure (api/, bot/, migrations/, tests/, etc.) · Create docker-compose.yml and .env.example · Write a README.md with setup instructions Phase 2 – Database Schema · PostgreSQL schema for all three domains · Tables for jobs, materials, inventory transactions, suppliers, purchase orders, invoices, payments · Ensure reserved and consumed are separate columns in inventory Phase 3 – Inventory Service · Backend API endpoints for materials, stock levels, reserved/consumed quantities · Logic for supplier deliveries updating inventory · Reorder level alerts Phase 4 – Production Service · Backend API for the 14-step job lifecycle (Inquiry → Paid) · Material requirements calculation · Handoff to inventory at the ORDER stage Phase 5 – Finance / AP Service · Backend API for supplier invoices, payments, purchase costs · Link invoices to purchase orders and inventory receipts Phase 6 – Knowledge Graph · Create links between jobs, materials, suppliers, and documents · Use PostgreSQL with a graph table or Neo4j (freelancer’s choice, but must be simple to maintain) Phase 7 – Claude Tool Endpoints · Expose safe read-only API endpoints that Claude can call to answer owner questions · Example: get_open_jobs, get_material_requirements, check_material_availability Phase 8 – Jev Decision Functions · Python module using TypeSafe Jev SDK · Functions: score_supplier_document_confidence, classify_inventory_alert, check_material_availability · Wire Jev into the Paperless webhook and inventory service Phase 9 – Telegram Bot · Build a Telegram bot using python-telegram-bot · Bot receives owner messages, forwards them to the backend, and returns Claude’s answers · Include commands for common queries (e.g., /stock, /jobs, /invoices) Phase 10 – Paperless-ngx Integration · Webhook handler that receives OCR’d documents from Paperless-ngx · Extract structured data (supplier, items, quantities, amounts) using an LLM or Jev · Update inventory and accounts payable accordingly Phase 11 – Testing & Documentation · Write unit and integration tests for each service · Provide clear documentation for a non-technical owner to run the system with docker compose up -d Deliverables: · Complete source code (zipped or shared via a file transfer service) · docker-compose.yml and .env.example · README.md with step-by-step instructions · DECISIONS.md listing any assumptions made · Test suite and instructions to run tests Required Skills: · Python 3.12+ and FastAPI · PostgreSQL and SQLAlche
40732668.decision: Проект требует разработки полнофункционального веб-приложения (full-stack система управления типографией с фронтенд-интерфейсом, базой данных, микросервисной архитектурой на 11 фаз). Это выходит далеко за пределы моих услуг. Я специализируюсь на Python-автоматизациях (боты, парсеры, интеграции, генерация контента), а не на разработке сложных веб-систем с архитектурой, требующей месяцы разработки и многочисленные компоненты (FastAPI backend, PostgreSQL, Neo4j, фронтенд, Docker orchestration и т.д.). Бюджет 750–1500 CAD (~550–1100 USD) также недостаточен для такого объёма работы. Проект требует опытного full-stack разработчика, а не специалиста по автоматизации.

40732993.title: AI Ad Videos Generations
40732993.description: I’m ready to roll out a series of bold, 8–15-second ads that instantly grab attention on both TikTok and Instagram and keep our e-commerce sales funnel moving fast. Each clip is a product demonstration with a clear, punchy call-to-action that feels native to both feeds. Here’s what I need from you: • An AI-generated video (or a short batch if that streamlines production) in a high-energy, thumb-stopping style. • Clear advice on which creation app or workflow—Runway, Kapwing, VEED, Pika Labs, Adobe Firefly, or any other tool you trust—will deliver the speed and visual punch we’re after. • Delivery in vertical format, optimized for TikTok/IG placement, and ready-to-use captions or on-screen CTA. • A quick look at past work so I can gauge your aesthetic and results. If you already have automations in place for rapid SKU swaps or template-driven edits, let me know; the faster we can iterate, the better. I’ll supply product footage or stills as soon as we lock in the direction. Looking forward to seeing how your AI toolkit can turn simple assets into sales-driving micro-ads.
40732993.decision: Заказ требует создание видео с людьми (product demonstration, on-screen CTA). По профилю я не создаю картинки и видео с людьми, сгенерированные ИИ — это запрещено. Также клиент просит рекомендации по внешним инструментам (Runway, Kapwing, VEED и т.д.), а я работаю только на Python для автоматизаций. Основной deliverable — видеопродакшн, а не код/автоматизация.

40732983.title: AI/LLM Fine-Tuning Engineer – Arabic, Egyptian Arabic, Gulf Arabic & English Smart Home Model
40732983.description: Freelancer Project Message — ~1000 characters Hello, I’m looking for an experienced LLM/NLP Fine-Tuning Engineer to develop a specialized language model for MEGA Smart Home AI. The model should understand natural smart-home commands in: Egyptian Arabic Gulf Arabic English User sentences will be Arabic-only or English-only; Arabic-English code-switching is not required. The main goal is not general conversation, but Natural Language Understanding for smart-home control. The model must identify intent, device, location, action, and parameters, then generate a strict structured JSON output compatible with our MEGA OS. It must also handle ambiguous requests by asking for clarification instead of guessing, and recognize unknown/unsupported devices or commands. Required experience: SFT, LoRA/QLoRA, LLM fine-tuning, Arabic NLP/NLU, Egyptian/Gulf Arabic, dataset creation/annotation, Python, evaluation and benchmarking. Please provide: 1. Previous Arabic/Egyptian/Gulf LLM projects. 2. Recommended base model and why. 3. Fine-tuning methodology. 4. Dataset strategy and expected size. 5. Evaluation methodology and metrics. 6. Final trained model and inference/deployment files. This is intended for local/offline deployment on MEGA hardware, so model size and quantization efficiency are important.
40732983.decision: Проект требует специализированной работы по fine-tuning LLM с подготовкой датасета, обучением модели и её оптимизацией для специального оборудования. Это выходит за рамки моих услуг: я пишу Python-скрипты для автоматизации и интеграции с готовыми LLM (Claude, GPT, Gemini), но не тренирую и не дорабатываю сами модели. Заказчик ищет специалиста по ML/NLP, а не разработчика автоматизаций.

40732854.title: Diagnostic AI for Blood & Pathology
40732854.description: I am building an AI-driven application that supports medical diagnostics by reading raw blood-test and pathology reports, extracting the relevant figures, and instantly returning an easy-to-read interpretation along with evidence-based clinical suggestions. The core workflow is straightforward: a clinician (or patient) uploads a PDF, image, HL7/FHIR payload, or even a snapped photo of a report; the system recognises the data, checks each finding against reference ranges, flags abnormalities, and explains the potential implications in plain language. Where results form recognisable patterns (for example, anaemia profiles or inflammatory markers) the model should surface likely differential diagnoses and recommended next-step investigations. To get there I will need robust OCR or direct-feed parsing, a well-trained ML/NLP pipeline (TensorFlow, PyTorch or similar), and a lightweight cross-platform front-end—web first, with mobile to follow. Clinical accuracy, privacy (HIPAA / GDPR), and clear audit trails for every prediction are non-negotiable. Please send me a detailed project proposal covering architecture, data-set strategy, validation metrics, regulatory safeguards, timeline, and your past experience with comparable medical or regulated AI products. Acceptance criteria: • ≥95 % field-extraction accuracy on a blind test set of mixed-format reports • Explanation texts capped at 8th-grade reading level, with source citations • End-to-end latency under 5 seconds for a typical two-page report • Complete hand-off package: source code, model weights, and deployment scripts ready for my AWS account Looking forward to reviewing your approach and seeing how you will turn these requirements into a production-ready diagnostic assistant.
40732854.decision: Заказ требует разработку полноценного приложения с ML/NLP pipeline, обучением моделей на медицинских данных, веб-фронтенда и мобильной версии. Это выходит за рамки моих услуг (я делаю автоматизацию на Python, интеграции и боты, но не разрабатываю ML-модели с нуля, не обучаю их на датасетах и не строю фронтенд-приложения). Кроме того, проект требует глубокой медицинской экспертизы, HIPAA/GDPR-комплаенса и валидации на клинических данных — это не входит в мой профиль опыта.

40732731.title: AI-Generated Lead Ad Videos
40732731.description: I need a set of short, scroll-stopping ad videos created entirely with AI and geared toward one thing only—driving fresh leads. Each video should combine dynamic, on-brand animated graphics with a strong call-to-action that nudges viewers to click, sign up, or inquire. I’m flexible on the underlying tech—whether you lean on machine-learning models, text-to-video platforms, or computer-vision pipelines—as long as your workflow is truly AI-powered and can turn around polished, conversion-focused creatives quickly. Deliverables • 3-5 AI-generated videos (15–30 sec each) featuring custom animated graphics • Source files or project links showing the AI process used • Two rounds of tweaks for copy, colors, or pacing so we can fine-tune performance Once we’re aligned on the concept, I’ll share brand assets and buyer-persona insights. If you can pair your AI tools with savvy marketing instincts, let’s talk and start generating leads together.
40732731.decision: Заказ требует создание видео с анимированной графикой и визуальными эффектами. Профиль предусматривает только ИИ-генерацию контента (тексты, картинки без людей, озвучка, шортсы), но не включает дизайн, анимацию или создание видео с кастомной графикой. Это выходит за рамки услуг разработчицы — это не простая озвучка или шортсы, а полнофункциональное видеопроизводство с графическим дизайном, который не покрывается профилем.

40732644.title: Comprehensive AI Real Estate Sales System
40732644.description: ’m building an AI-powered real estate sales system for the Mumbai market and am looking for an AI/full-stack developer to help me build the MVP. The idea is to create an AI sales agent for real estate brokers that communicates with potential buyers primarily through WhatsApp. The AI should be able to respond instantly to enquiries, understand what the buyer is looking for (budget, location, BHK, purpose, timeline, etc.), search the broker’s actual property inventory, recommend relevant properties, answer basic questions, collect the lead’s information, and help arrange a site visit. It should also automatically follow up with interested leads and notify the broker/salesperson when a lead is qualified or ready to speak to a human. Essentially, I want to create an AI “junior salesperson” that helps brokers turn more enquiries into qualified leads and site visits rather than simply being a generic chatbot. Your role would be to help me design and build the technical side of this product from the ground up. I am open to the technology stack, but I expect the project to involve an LLM such as OpenAI, WhatsApp Business API, a property database/CRM, automation, and potentially a simple dashboard for the broker. For the first version, we want to keep things relatively simple: one broker, one WhatsApp number, and a small database of their properties, and prove that the AI can actually handle enquiries and recommend the correct properties. I’m looking for someone who has experience building AI agents, API integrations, WhatsApp bots, RAG/vector search or similar AI applications, and full-stack systems. You would be responsible for helping architect the MVP, building the AI workflow and integrations, testing it with real-world conversations, fixing issues, and potentially continuing as the technical developer as we onboard our first clients. I’m not looking to over-engineer this initially — I want to build a working product quickly, test it with real Mumbai real-estate brokers, learn from those clients, and then expand the system based on what the market actually needs.
40732644.decision: Проект покрывается моими услугами: ИИ-агент на базе LLM (Claude/GPT) + интеграция с WhatsApp Business API + парсер/поиск по базе свойств + уведомления брокеру. Это комбинация из 'ИИ-агент' ($140) + 'Интеграция API' ($120) + 'Парсер с уведомлениями' ($80). Бюджет в пределах нормы, на английском, заказчик ясно описал требования. Все в Python, никаких n8n/Make, нет харама, честный проект.
40732644.proposal: I understand you need an AI sales agent for WhatsApp that searches your property database and qualifies leads — that's a solid MVP idea. I build exactly this type of system: LLM-based agents (Claude, GPT, or Groq), WhatsApp Business API integrations, property search with vector similarity, and broker notifications via Telegram or email. For your MVP, I'd architect it as: (1) WhatsApp Business API webhook to receive messages, (2) AI agent that understands buyer criteria (budget, BHK, location, timeline), (3) RAG-style search over your property database to recommend matching listings, (4) lead capture and qualification logic, (5) notifications to the broker when a lead is qualified, and (6) follow-up automation. I build this in Python with a simple backend (no fancy UI for v1 — just APIs and Telegram/email dashboards). Timeline: 56 days for the full MVP (agent + WhatsApp + database integration + basic testing). Before we start, I need to clarify: do you have the WhatsApp Business API account and property data in a specific format (CSV, Google Sheets, database)? And should the agent also schedule site visits, or just notify the broker to follow up manually?

40732607.title: Zoho CRM Setup & Migration
40732607.description: I have a fresh Zoho CRM account that needs to be fully configured so my team can start working out of it right away. The priorities are clear: streamline lead management, design insightful custom reports, and build workflow automation that removes as much manual effort as possible. All of my existing prospect and customer data currently lives in several Excel/CSV files. I will supply those files and a simple field-mapping guide; I need you to clean the data where appropriate, import it without loss, and verify that every record, note, and custom field lands in the right place. Once the data sits safely inside Zoho, I want to see: • A logical lead pipeline with stages, assignment rules, and notification triggers • At least three role-based reports that give me real-time visibility into pipeline health, conversion rates, and sales activities • Automated workflows for lead assignment, follow-up reminders, and deal stage changes, all tested end-to-end I’ll provide admin access, branding assets, and sample process documents. When you’re done, walk me through the configuration so I can maintain it, and give me a short handover document summarizing what you built and how to tweak it. If you’ve handled similar Zoho CRM implementations and data migrations from spreadsheets, I’d love to see a quick note on your approach and any relevant examples.
40732607.decision: Заказ требует полной настройки и администрирования Zoho CRM — это не входит в мой профиль услуг. Я делаю автоматизации на Python (боты, парсеры, интеграции через API, генерацию контента). Настройка самой CRM-системы, дизайн отчётов внутри платформы, конфигурация workflow в интерфейсе Zoho — это работа CRM-специалиста, а не разработчика на Python. Интеграция Zoho через API (например, синхронизация данных в Google Sheets или отправка уведомлений в Telegram) входит в мой профиль, но сам CRM-setup — нет. Это как просить веб-дизайнера настроить сервер.

40733444.title: AI E-Commerce Site with Wix ADI
40733444.description: I’m ready to launch an online store and want it built quickly and intelligently with Wix ADI. The core of the project is a clean, conversion-focused e-commerce website that fully leverages Wix’s AI tools while still looking bespoke and on-brand. Key elements I must see on the finished site are a seamless product catalogue with secure checkout, an easy-to-use contact form, a visually appealing service showcase, and space for authentic client testimonials. I already have copy, branding colours, and high-resolution images; what I need is your expertise to weave them into a polished, mobile-responsive design and make sure the AI settings are tuned for speed, SEO, and future scalability. Deliverables • Complete Wix ADI e-commerce site, published and live under my domain • Contact form that routes enquiries to my preferred email address • Dedicated service showcase section with image galleries and description blocks • Rotating or grid-style client testimonials, editable from the Wix backend • Payment gateway and basic tax/shipping rules configured • Handover session (recorded or live) so I can update products and sections myself The build should be intuitive enough for me to manage day-to-day, yet sophisticated enough to impress visitors from the first click. If you’ve crafted AI-assisted Wix stores before and can meet these requirements quickly, I’d love to work together.
40733444.decision: Проект требует создание сайта на Wix ADI. Я разработчица Python-автоматизаций, не веб-дизайнер и не специалист по конструкторам сайтов. Wix ADI — это визуальный конструктор с drag-and-drop интерфейсом, а не Python. Это входит в категорию «Сайты, дизайн» — услуга, которую я не предоставляю. Мой профиль не покрывает такие заказы.

40733180.title: Elegant Beauty AI Videos & Edits
40733180.description: My skincare line needs a steady stream of elegant, luxurious visual assets for Instagram. I want short AI-driven reels that feel cinematic yet on-brand, plus polished product photos that look editorial-grade on the feed, in Stories, and in paid ads. You’ll be working with existing brand guidelines—soft neutrals, subtle glow, clean typography—and translating them into: • 15–30 sec vertical reels created with AI video tools (Runway, Pika, or similar) blended seamlessly with real footage • High-resolution product images retouched in Photoshop/Lightroom, with background cleanup, color harmony, and light skin-tone correction • Caption suggestions and lightweight motion graphics so the assets are upload-ready for Instagram All content should feel high-end rather than flashy: think spa-like lighting, slow pans, silk textures, and gentle glints on packaging. Consistency across carousel frames and thumbnails is critical so the grid remains cohesive. I’ll provide product shots, mood boards, and prior campaigns. You’ll handle the rest—from concept iterations through final export—delivering the first batch within one week of kickoff and refining quickly based on my feedback. If you have a portfolio with luxurious beauty content and can blend AI creativity with meticulous retouching, I’m excited to see your work.
40733180.decision: Заказ требует дизайн (редактирование фото в Photoshop/Lightroom, цветокоррекция, работа с фоном), создание видео с AI-инструментами (Runway, Pika) и SMM-ведение (подбор контента, консистентность сетки). Это выходит за рамки моих услуг: я делаю автоматизацию на Python, парсинг, боты, ИИ-генерацию текстов и озвучки. Визуальный дизайн и видеомонтаж с AI-видеодизайнерами — не мой профиль.

40733133.title: Python-based AI & Software Development
40733133.description: Developed and delivered Python-based AI and software solutions based on client requirements, focusing on automation, data processing, and intelligent applications. Built AI-powered applications using Large Language Models (LLMs), Prompt Engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and API integrations. Developed document-processing and conversational AI solutions using Python, FAISS, Streamlit, and Gemini/Groq APIs. Created data analysis and automation workflows that transformed user requirements and natural-language inputs into structured analytical processes. Designed database-backed applications using SQL and Supabase, including data storage, user authentication, and progress tracking. Integrated third-party APIs and developed reusable application components for scalable workflows. Performed debugging, troubleshooting, testing, and optimization to improve application reliability and performance. Used Git and GitHub for version control, source-code management, and project collaboration. Communicated with clients to understand requirements, translate them into technical solutions, and deliver functional prototypes or applications. Documented project functionality, implementation details, and usage instructions to support maintainability and future development. Worked independently across the software development lifecycle, including requirement analysis, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance.
40733133.decision: Заказ — это описание общего опыта разработчика в Python и ИИ, а не конкретная задача с чёткими требованиями. Непонятно, что именно нужно сделать, какой результат ожидается, какие сроки и бюджет выделен на каждый пункт. Без деталей проекта невозможно дать честное предложение и согласовать объём работы. Нужно уточнить у заказчика, какой конкретный проект он хочет реализовать (чат-бот, парсер, генератор контента и т.д.), и тогда дать отклик с точными цифрами.

40733761.title: AI-Driven 3D Feature Animation
40733761.description: I’m developing a full-length feature film and want its visual identity to be built through AI-assisted 3D animation. The screenplay and edit are already in motion; what I need now is a specialist who can take key scenes, feed them through the right generative models, and deliver polished 3D sequences that slot seamlessly into a cinematic pipeline. You’ll be free to choose the best mix of tools—whether that’s Blender with DreamFusion-style text-to-mesh, Unreal Engine plus NeRF, or another combination—as long as the final shots meet theatrical quality and can be handed off as clean FBX/ABC files with matching 4K EXR renders. Deliverables I expect: • A short proof-of-concept clip (10–15 s) that shows your AI workflow in action • The full set of approved 3D animated shots, rendered and ready for comp • Source assets and project files organised for my VFX team I’ll review work based on visual fidelity, consistency with the film’s art direction, and how efficiently you harness AI to speed up iteration. If this sounds like the creative challenge you’ve been waiting for, let’s talk timing and milestones.
40733761.decision: Проект требует 3D-анимации, визуальных эффектов и дизайна — это не входит в мои услуги. Я разрабатываю Python-автоматизации (боты, парсеры, генерацию контента через API), а не создаю кинематографический контент или 3D-ассеты. Кроме того, работа с Blender, Unreal Engine и рендерингом 4K EXR выходит за рамки моей компетенции.

40733696.title: Deploy & Connect Two AI Scripts from Codecanyon
40733696.description: I have purchased two AI-based Codecanyon scripts and need them running smoothly on my cloud VPS. You should be able to understand how to setup AI chatbots, creating flows and everything that relates to it. It is not something you ask AI how to do and it will tell you, you need a real-time experience on this. The job is straight-forward but demands precision: • Upload and install both scripts on the server, handling database creation, file permissions and any environment variables they expect. • Configure all required API keys, webhook endpoints and conversational flows so the chatbot components respond exactly as they do in the demos. • Test every feature end-to-end—text generation, image generation and any add-on modules—until the dashboard shows no errors. • Deliver a brief hand-off note Both products are designed for “standard environments,” so no exotic libraries should be necessary—just solid VPS knowledge and a knack for troubleshooting real-time AI calls. If you’ve set up similar Codecanyon or SaaS chatbots before, that’s the experience I want. Start your bid with “Hey” so I know you read this, link a couple of comparable deployments you’ve handled, and let’s get these bots live today.
40733696.decision: Заказчик требует опыт развёртывания Codecanyon-скриптов и просит ссылки на похожие проекты. В профиле нет такого опыта и нельзя выдумывать портфолио. Кроме того, заказ требует 'real-time experience' с чужими скриптами, которые мы не разбирали. Цена в INR (1500–12500 ≈ $18–150 USD) крайне низкая для двух скриптов — даже по минимумам наших услуг это $40–80. Главное: профиль не покрывает развёртывание готовых Codecanyon-продуктов — это не наша услуга, а скорее DevOps/сисадмин-работа.

40733664.title: AI-Generated Realistic Music & Social Media Videos
40733664.description: We are interested in creating Ai realistic music videos and short social media videos with absolute realistic action and human likenesses.
40733664.decision: Проект требует генерацию видео с людьми, сгенерированными ИИ. В профиле чётко указано: «Картинки и видео с людьми, сгенерированные ИИ» — не делаем. Это нарушает правила шариата (честность и отказ от сомнительных практик).

40733629.title: Smart Note & Theatre Automation
40733629.description: I am looking to develop a dual-purpose system that integrates smart note-taking and home theatre automation capabilities. For the smart note feature, functionalities such as voice-to-text conversion, handwriting recognition, and cloud synchronization could be part of the design, depending on the most effective approach. Additionally, for the home theatre automation system, areas like lighting, sound system, and screen or projector control may be explored to create a seamless entertainment experience. I am open to suggestions on platforms, tools, and methods to ensure the solution is both user-friendly and efficient. Your expertise in combining these innovative features will be key to delivering a unified and functional solution.
40733629.decision: Проект требует мобильное приложение с голосовым вводом, распознаванием почерка и управлением IoT-устройствами (свет, звук, проектор). Это выходит за рамки моих услуг: я делаю Python-автоматизацию для веб-сервисов и ботов, а не мобильные приложения, десктоп-ПО или IoT-интеграции с аппаратурой. Клиент говорит об 'approaches' и 'platforms' — значит, нужна архитектурная разработка с фронтендом, что не входит в мой профиль.

40733535.title: Agentic AI Student Platform
40733535.description: I’m kicking off development of a next-generation, agentic, AI-driven platform that lets students steer every aspect of their education, career planning, and entrepreneurial ambitions through a single voice command—whether they speak English or any local language. I need a developer who can architect and ship a cohesive experience across web plus native iOS and Android, making sure feature parity is seamless on every device. Core feature set • Unified dashboards for education management (courses, deadlines, grades, learning analytics). • Integrated career planning modules that surface tailored internships, jobs, and skill-gap insights. • A start-up corner offering curated entrepreneurship resources, funding leads, and mentor matching. AI layer • Multilingual voice command handling that triggers any task on the platform. • A context-aware chatbot that stays with the learner across screens, answering questions and executing requests. • Real-time, personalized recommendations for courses, career moves, or venture steps based on user data and behavioural signals. Tech expectations Modern web stack (React, Vue or similar) paired with robust mobile frameworks (Swift/SwiftUI for iOS, Kotlin for Android or Flutter/React Native if you favour a shared codebase). The AI backbone can leverage OpenAI, Azure Cognitive Services, or comparable LLMs, supplemented by a recommendation engine and speech-to-text pipeline tuned for multiple regional languages. Deliverables 1. End-to-end product architecture. 2. Responsive web app plus companion iOS and Android apps published to their respective stores. 3. Cloud deployment scripts, CI/CD, and documentation. 4. Post-launch support window for bug fixes and optimisation. If you have already shipped production-grade, multilingual voice products or student-focused platforms, let’s talk. Send over links, stack details, and your preferred approach so we can dive into the full scope and milestones.
40733535.decision: Проект требует разработки полнофункционального мобильного приложения для iOS и Android, веб-приложения на React/Vue и сложной архитектуры системы. Это выходит за рамки моих услуг: я делаю Python-автоматизации (боты, парсеры, интеграции), а не мобильные приложения, веб-сайты и полноценные платформы. Бюджет огромный (150–250k USD эквивалент), но объём работы — это не один проект из таблицы, а многомесячная разработка целой команды (frontend, backend, iOS, Android, DevOps, AI-инженер). Я работаю одна и под ключ, но не могу взять на себя такую архитектуру.

40733826.title: AI Voice Agent for Car Rental Business
40733826.description: Overview: We are seeking a skilled freelancer to develop an AI-powered voice agent tailored for a car rental business operating across India. The agent will assist in handling customer inquiries, booking management, and payment processing with multi-language capabilities. Requirements: - Develop and deploy an AI-powered voice assistant. - Enable multi-language communication to accommodate regional diversity. - Integrate with payment gateways and support complete booking processes. - Design and achieve seamless integration with mobile and WhatsApp communications. Expected Inclusions: - Full customization of the AI voice's personality and tone to align with the brand. - Comprehensive reporting and analytics for interactions and bookings. - Robust support infrastructure for troubleshooting and updates.
40733826.decision: Проект требует разработки голосового агента с интеграцией платежных шлюзов, мобильного приложения и WhatsApp-интеграции, плюс аналитику и поддержку. Это комбинация из нескольких услуг (ИИ-агент ~$80, интеграция CRM/платежей ~$70, парсер/мониторинг ~$50), что в сумме даёт 10+ дней. Однако голосовой компонент (speech-to-text, text-to-speech с кастомизацией голоса и тона, многоязычность) выходит за рамки стандартных Python-скриптов — это требует специальных API (Google Speech, ElevenLabs, Twilio Voice) и архитектуры, которая сложнее, чем текстовый чат-бот. Кроме того, «мобильное приложение» в описании может подразумевать разработку приложения, а не просто интеграцию. Риск неправильно оценить объём работы и сроки. Бюджет высокий, но объём непредсказуем.

40733986.title: AI-Driven Social Media Branding
40733986.description: I want to amplify our brand presence on Facebook, Instagram and LinkedIn by pairing solid social-media strategy with the speed and insights that modern AI tools provide. The core objective is clear: boost brand awareness rather than chase quick sales, leads or traffic spikes. Here is what success looks like to me: • A 30-day content calendar populated with a balanced mix of images, short videos (Reels / Stories) and snappy written posts, all tailored to each platform’s best practices. • Creative assets that demonstrate tasteful, on-brand use of generative tools such as Midjourney, If you have hands-on experience blending social strategy with AI content creation—without it looking automated—I’d love to see examples where you’ve lifted brand visibility in comparable niches. I’m open to your suggested workflow, but please note that creative originality, consistent voice and measurable growth in awareness are the main acceptance criteria.
40733986.decision: Заказ требует SMM-ведение вручную, разработку стратегии и дизайн контента, чего я не делаю. Профиль предусматривает только автоматизацию публикаций по расписанию (автопостинг), а не создание стратегии, планирование контента, дизайн и управление аккаунтами. Это выходит за рамки моих услуг.

40733930.title: Product Video Creator (3D Animator / VFX Artist / Motion Designer / AI Video Creator) -- 2
40733930.description: We are looking for a talented Product Video Creator, 3D Animator, VFX Artist, Motion Designer, or AI Video Creator to create high-quality product videos for our eCommerce product pages. These videos are designed to showcase the product's features, functionality, and design—not promotional advertisements. The goal is to help customers better understand the product through clean, premium visuals. Reference Style We're looking for videos with a similar style and quality to this reference: https://conors.com.au/cdn/shop/videos/c/vp/5c41c7ded3c1436ca9115bddac4ab4c6/5c41c7ded3c1436ca9115bddac4ab4c6.HD-1080p-3.3Mbps-85777911.mp4?v=0 https://conors.com.au/cdn/shop/videos/c/vp/e8fe3e6cc9014123b6b92792fab9cc65/e8fe3e6cc9014123b6b92792fab9cc65.HD-1080p-7.2Mbps-93133810.mp4 What You'll Do Create premium product showcase videos highlighting key features and functionality. Use 3D animation, CGI, VFX, motion graphics, AI video generation, or any suitable production method. Create smooth camera movements, realistic lighting, and detailed product close-ups. Clearly demonstrate how the product works and its key benefits. Add subtle background music and sound effects where appropriate.
