40733921.title: AI Reddit-Style Bulletin Board
40733921.description: I want to launch a compact, Reddit-inspired bulletin board that accepts plain-text submissions and lets the community decide what matters through a straightforward upvote / downvote system. No images, videos, comments, or elaborate profile pages—just clean threads of text ranked in real time by score. It is a Membership Only site @ $10usd/year via Stripe. We have integrated a very strict policy and click box to avoid ANTAGONISTIC persons With a 3 strike rule for disqualification for up to 3 months at a time and / or a LIFETIME BAN if they persist to disrupt other membership... And a strong emphasis on litigious persons as they must sign a strong and personal gurantee to avoid false claims etc etc P L E A S E Do not A P P L Y If you dont know ai Because moderation can’t be an after-thought, I’d like the core to be built with hooks for basic NLP-driven checks (profanity filtering, spam detection) so the board stays readable without manual policing. Frameworks such as Python-FastAPI, Node-Express, or Django are fine—as long as the code is clearly structured and easy to extend. What I need you to deliver: • A responsive web front-end that lists posts by score and exposes a “submit text” flow. • A back-end API that stores posts, records each vote once per user / IP, recalculates scores instantly, and exposes simple admin endpoints for moderation. • AI moderation stubs (language model or rule-based filter) wired into the post-submission pipeline so content that fails checks is flagged or blocked. • Deployment instructions (Docker or similar) so I can spin the service up on my own server and run acceptance tests. Clean, well-commented source code and a short README are the key acceptance criteria. Once the MVP is running smoothly, we can discuss adding richer features, but for this phase the spotlight is firmly on text posts and the voting mechanic.
40733921.decision: Это заказ на разработку веб-приложения (сайт с фронтенд-бэкенд архитектурой, базой данных, аутентификацией через Stripe, развёртыванием на сервер). Я делаю автоматизации на Python — парсеры, боты, интеграции с API и контент-генерацию. Веб-приложения, сайты и мобильные приложения — не в моём профиле. Это совсем другой класс работ, требующий фронтенд-разработки, DevOps и поддержки инфраструктуры. Отказываемся вежливо.

40734331.title: AI Video: Mbappé Dictator Parody

40734104.title: Modernise AI-Based Image Editing Platform
40734104.description: Build and Modernise a Scalable Web-Based AI Image Editing Platform We are seeking an experienced developer, multidisciplinary freelance team or software company to modernise our existing Python/Flask image-enhancement and editing platform and build a unified, responsive **Image Studio**. The engagement will include: * Consolidating existing image tools into a canvas-based Studio while retaining existing SEO landing pages. * Implementing agreed Phase 1 editing features, including enhancement, adjustments, crop and transform, background editing, effects, artistic styles, text and elements, frames, resize and export. * Building sequential, non-destructive editing with previews, history, undo/redo and before/after comparison. * Evaluating suitable APIs, libraries and AI models based on quality, processing time, licensing and cost. * Implementing user accounts, subscriptions, credits, usage limits and administration. * Modernising the architecture, deployment, security and processing workflow so the platform can scale reliably as usage grows. * Migrating the existing application and functionality without avoidable SEO or production disruption. **Expected technical direction** * Modular Python/Flask backend instead of extending the existing monolithic `app.py`. * Responsive frontend with Fabric.js or another justified canvas framework. * PostgreSQL for users, subscriptions, credits, jobs and audit records. * Redis-backed asynchronous processing using Celery or an equivalent. * Private object storage with secure, expiring downloads. * Reusable local-processing and external AI-provider wrappers. * Secure anonymous and authenticated sessions. * Rate limiting, quotas, upload validation, image sanitisation and abuse protection. * Testing, monitoring, backups, rollback and separate environment practices. * Cost-conscious architecture with a clear future scaling and high-availability path, without unnecessary overengineering. **Who should apply** Applicants should demonstrate relevant experience in image-processing applications, interactive canvas editors, Python/Flask, OpenCV/Pillow/ONNX, AI API integration, asynchronous workers, SaaS subscriptions and secure production deployment. Please provide: 1. Relevant image-editing, canvas or AI-platform examples. 2. Recommended technical approach. 3. Key assumptions, dependencies and risks. 4. Details of ongoing warranty and support. A complete PRD/FRD, TRD/NFR, architecture specification and commercial-response template will be shared with shortlisted candidates after an initial discussion and confidentiality acknowledgement. Separate quotations will be requested for mandatory Phase 1 scope and optional advanced AI features.
40734104.decision: Проект требует разработки полноценной веб-платформы с фронтенд-интерфейсом, базой данных, системой подписок и сложной инфраструктурой. 40734759.title: Marketing AI Videos & Images

40734721.title: Simple Web-Based CRM Development
40734721.description: I want to build a clean, professional and easy-to-use CRM for my company, Laxmi Agro Power, a Biomass Pellet Manufacturing business in Parbhani, Maharashtra, India. The CRM should focus primarily on managing biomass pellet sales leads, customers and follow-ups. The system must: * Run in any modern web browser * Be mobile-friendly and responsive * Be hosted on my own server * Be fast, simple and reliable * Have a clean interface that my team can learn within a short walkthrough CORE MODULES 1. CUSTOMER DATABASE Users should be able to easily: * Add customers * Edit customers * Search customers * Filter customers * Delete/archive customers * Import customers from Excel/CSV * Export customer data to Excel/CSV Customer fields should include: * Company Name * Industry * Contact Person * Designation * Mobile Number * WhatsApp Number * Email * Website * Address * City * District * State * Lead Source * Current Fuel Used * Boiler Type * Boiler Capacity * Estimated Biomass Pellet Requirement (MT/month) * Current Fuel Price * Required GCV * Moisture Requirement * Customer Status * Assigned Sales User * Remarks 2. LEAD MANAGEMENT Create a simple sales pipeline: New Lead → Contacted → Interested → Sample Required → Sample Sent → Trial Required → Trial Completed → Quotation Sent → Negotiation → Order Received → Regular Customer → Not Interested Users should be able to move leads between stages easily. Show the pipeline visually so we can immediately understand how many leads are at each stage. 3. FOLLOW-UP / CONTACT HISTORY Every customer/lead should have a complete contact history. Log: * Phone Call * WhatsApp * Email * Meeting * Sample Discussion * Trial * Quotation Discussion * Other Each activity should contain: * Date * Time * Activity Type * Notes * Next Follow-up Date * Assigned User The customer profile should show the complete history in chronological order. 4. FOLLOW-UP DASHBOARD The dashboard should clearly show: * Today's Follow-ups * Overdue Follow-ups * Upcoming Follow-ups * New Leads * Interested Leads * Quotations Pending * Trials Pending * Orders Received * Active Customers 5. CUSTOMER PROFILE When I open a customer, I should see everything in one place: * Company information * Contact information * Lead status * Assigned salesperson * Estimated monthly pellet requirement * Current fuel * Boiler information * All previous calls * WhatsApp/contact history * Meetings * Samples * Trials * Quotations * Orders * Payment/remarks * Next follow-up 6. SEARCH AND FILTER I need fast search and filters for: * Company Name * Contact Person * Mobile Number * City * District * Industry * Lead Status * Salesperson * Follow-up Date * Customer Type 7. DASHBOARD Create a simple professional dashboard showing: * Total Leads * New Leads * Interested Leads * Active Customers * Today's Follow-ups * Overdue Follow-ups * Trials Pending * Quotations Pending * Orders * Monthly Sales Leads * Lead Conversion Keep the dashboard simple and easy to understand. 8. USER LOGIN Only two roles are required initially: ADMIN * Full access * Add/edit/delete users * View all customers and leads * Import/export data * Manage pipeline STANDARD USER / SALES EXECUTIVE * View assigned leads/customers * Add leads * Update lead status * Add contact history * Add follow-ups * Update customer information 9. EXCEL IMPORT This is very important. I already plan to maintain a large database of potential biomass pellet customers. During import: * Detect duplicate companies * Show import errors * Map Excel columns to CRM fields * Do not create duplicate records unnecessarily 10. EXPORT Admin should be able to export: * All customers * All leads * Filtered leads * Follow-ups * Customer data into Excel/CSV. 11. COMMUNICATION Where technically possible, provide quick buttons for: * Call * WhatsApp * Email For example, clicking WhatsApp should open WhatsApp with the customer'

Это выходит за границы услуг в профиле: я делаю специализированные Python-автоматизации (боты, интеграции, парсеры, генерация контента), а не разработку веб-приложений с собственным дизайном, фронтенд-фреймворком и архитектурой. CRM — это сайт, а не автоматизация. Бюджет в INR (~18–150 USD) при таком объёме работ тоже нереалистичен для полноценного CRM.

40734585.title: AI Stylist App Development
40734585.description: I’m building a stylist app whose heart is an AI engine that delivers Style recommendations based on body measurements. Once that milestone is met, we’ll wrap with a quick knowledge-transfer call and handover of source code and assets.

Проект слишком большой и требует специалистов по мобильной разработке и ML-инженерии.

40735092.title: AI Badge Avatar PCB completion — ESP32-S3, LCD, mic, LiPo
40735092.description: We have an AI-assisted KiCad A1 draft for a wearable character badge. It has schematic sheets and provisional placement, but no copper routing; several circuits and connector choices are unfinished. The product requirements have expanded to voice AI from the cloud over Wi-Fi, while character images/animations stay on the device. The A1 draft has no microphone, so that is a new circuit to design. This project is for hardware/PCB engineering; application firmware and the cloud AI service are separate work. Remote engineering is fine. We will share the review files privately. Hardware and user experience - ESP32-S3-WROOM-1-N16R8 with built-in 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi. Check antenna placement/keep-out; do not add a second Wi-Fi modem. - 4.3-inch 800 x 480 parallel RGB LCD candidate SZCLX043J-G-1000-IPS-16-X, 3.3 V logic and about 24 V / 40 mA LED backlight. Recheck the draft TPS61165 backlight circuit for this panel. - 3.7 V / 2,000 mAh LiPo, USB-C charging/programming, 4 GB permanently soldered storage for local characters and animations. Choose/verify the exact storage part and interface. - Add an onboard microphone suitable for push-to-talk voice input to the ESP32-S3. Keep the existing MAX98357A speaker amplifier provision and provide a verified connector/output for a small speaker. Check speaker rating, volume, microphone placement and electrical/acoustic noise. - No touch UI is assumed. Propose a usable physical control scheme: ideally Talk/Select, Previous and Next user buttons, with a long press to open an on-screen settings menu for avatar selection, volume and Wi-Fi status/setup. If two user buttons are preferable, explain the short/long-press navigation before fixing the PCB. Keep power and recovery controls accessible. Review GPIO allocation and add an expander if needed. - Draft four-layer PCB is about 60 x 111 mm with a 52 x 40 mm battery opening. Verify buttons, speaker/mic ports, display flex, connectors, RF clearance and essential case fit. Engineering scope 1. Independently review/correct the draft schematic. Complete microphone and controls, storage/GPIO allocation, battery cutoff/protection, charging while the main switch is off, USB source-current/suspend behavior, power budget and connector choices. 2. Qualify or revise the LCD/backlight interface. Identify missing panel timing, FPC and battery information to confirm with the supplier or owner. 3. Select components with JLCPCB/LCSC availability in mind before final layout; recheck before any order. Provide part numbers and approved alternatives; flag items that require separate sourcing or hand assembly. No purchases without our approval. 4. Finish PCB placement/routing and run ERC, DRC and manufacturing checks. Resolve issues or document remaining limitations clearly. Deliverables: editable KiCad schematic/PCB, BOM with manufacturer and JLCPCB/LCSC numbers, Gerber/drill and placement files, assembly notes, power and pin-map notes, and a bring-up plan. Provide remote help with the first assembled prototype and one correction pass if it reveals a PCB design error. Target engineering budget: $350 USD fixed, with the added microphone/control scope to be confirmed before award. Target schedule: 10–14 days for the design package after scope agreement. Fabrication, parts and shipping need separate approval. The first prototype must be physically tested before production release.
40735092.decision: Проект требует проектирования печатной платы (PCB design, schematic completion, layout, routing) — это аппаратная инженерия, а не автоматизация на Python. Я разрабатываю ИИ-автоматизации (боты, парсеры, генерацию контента, интеграции), а не электронику и схемы в KiCad. Это вне моих услуг.

40734936.title: AI-Generated Fashion Video Reels for Modish

When we provide the original product photograph, the following must remain faithful: * Dress colour * Silhouette * Neckline * Sleeves * Embroidery * Prints * Embellishments * Fabric appearance * Layers * Length * Waistline * Overall construction * Any distinctive design elements The AI should create the environment, model movement, camera movement and cinematic presentation, while preserving the actual product. 40736171.title: AI Food Donation Matching System -- 2
40736171.description: Project Title: AI-Powered Food Donation Matching Platform One-liner: An intelligent last-mile logistics system that converts free-text food donation descriptions into structured data and matches them to the most suitable shelter using a rule-based feasibility filter and multi-criteria ranking engine. Role: ML Engineer / Full-Stack Developer (end-to-end design & build) What it does: Donors describe a donation in plain language (e.g. "20 packets of fresh sandwiches, good for 3 hours"). The system extracts structured intent, filters out shelters that can't realistically accept it, then ranks the remaining candidates by real-world urgency and fit — not just distance. Architecture (3-stage pipeline): Extraction layer — LLM-based NLP parses free text into structured JSON (food type, quantity, unit, condition, time window). No decision-making here, purely language → structured data. Feasibility layer — Deterministic rule engine + PostgreSQL/PostGIS filters shelters by acceptance policy, capacity, geofenced distance, and operating hours. No ML used here by design — rules are more reliable and auditable for hard constraints. Ranking layer — Weighted multi-criteria scoring engine (urgency, capacity-match ratio, distance, pickup deadline, compatibility) to prioritize among feasible matches. Tech stack: Python, LangChain (LLM orchestration + structured extraction), PostgreSQL + PostGIS (geospatial feasibility filtering), FastAPI, MLOps-style modular architecture (component → entity → config → pipeline → app.py) Key engineering decisions / talking points (for interviews): Deliberately kept LLM scope narrow (extraction only) instead of letting it make matching decisions — improves reliability, auditability, and cuts inference cost. Separated deterministic constraints (rules/SQL) from probabilistic ranking (weighted scoring) — a hybrid system rather than "throw an LLM at everything." Designed the ranking layer to be upgradable to a learned model later once labeled outcome data is available, without touching the extraction or feasibility layers.
40736171.decision: Проект — это Python-автоматизация на основе ИИ (LLM-парсинг + логика маршрутизации). Входит в услугу 'ИИ-агент / чат-бот на базе Claude, GPT, Gemini, Groq' плюс 'Парсер / мониторинг с уведомлениями'. Стек (Python, LangChain, FastAPI, PostgreSQL) — стандартный для моих проектов. Никаких харам-ниш. Никаких веб-сайтов или мобильных приложений в описании. Задача честная, социально полезная.
40736171.proposal:
I understand the project: a 3-stage pipeline that parses donation descriptions with an LLM, filters shelters by deterministic rules (PostgreSQL + PostGIS), then ranks matches by weighted criteria. Smart approach — keeping the LLM scope narrow and separating constraints from scoring.

I'll build the full end-to-end system in Python using LangChain for structured extraction, FastAPI for the API layer, and PostgreSQL with PostGIS for geospatial filtering. The ranking engine will be modular so you can later swap in a learned model if you have outcome data.

Delivery: 21 days (complex pipeline with 3 layers, database design, testing). Price: $180 (or we can discuss if your budget is tighter).

A few clarifications before we start: 1) Do you have the shelter database ready (locations, policies, capacity), or do I build a sample schema? 2) Which LLM do you prefer (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini)? 3) Should the ranking weights be hardcoded or configurable in a config file?

Start your proposal with: ## **"I CAN BUILD KAK"** Then answer these 5 questions: **1. What is the most similar AI project you have built?** **2. Have you built an AI Agent that can call APIs / perform actions? Give an example.** **3. Have you worked with Shopify, WooCommerce, WhatsApp, Amazon or Noon APIs?** **4. What architecture would you recommend for KAK and why?** **5. The project is expected to evolve through multiple development phases, including additional integrations, AI capabilities, automation, and enterprise features. 40736933.title: Slot Availability Alert Automation
40736933.description: I need a small, resilient Python service that checks a protected “slot” page every few seconds and pushes a Telegram message the very moment the page flips from “no slots” to “slots available” (and again when they vanish). The job breaks down into three clear parts: 1. Stealth requests The target site sits behind a fairly strict WAF and fingerprints browsers. I want the HTTP layer written with curl_cffi and/or TLS-impersonation so the traffic looks like a real browser session, not a basic requests/urllib call. Whichever approach proves more stable in practice is fine; feel free to combine both. 2. Zero-to-low-cost IP rotation Please wire the scraper through an IP solution that does not rely on costly residential proxy subscriptions. A self-hosted Linux VPS proxy chain, dynamic IP switching, or an open-source proxy aggregator are all on the table—I’m open to whichever option you judge most reliable. 3. Telegram push alerts On every state change (“available” ➜ “unavailable” or the reverse) the service must instantly send a concise message to a Telegram chat I specify. No duplicates, no polling spam—only real changes trigger messages. Deliverables • Python source with clear config variables (target URL, check interval, Telegram token/chat ID). • Bash/Ansible or README steps to spin up any supporting proxy components on an Ubuntu VPS. • A short test script or instructions that demonstrate the alert firing on a mocked state change. If you’ve built stealth scrapers before and know your way around curl_cffi, TLS signatures, and basic proxy routing, this should be a quick, satisfying build.
40736933.decision: Проект требует специализированные навыки обхода WAF (Web Application Firewall) и сложной настройки прокси-цепочек с IP-ротацией, которые выходят за рамки моих стандартных услуг. Хотя я работаю на Python и могу делать парсеры с мониторингом, этот заказ предполагает: (1) инженерию обхода защиты сайта (curl_cffi, TLS-impersonation, WAF-bypass), (2) развёртывание и настройку инфраструктуры прокси на VPS клиента, (3) тестирование против реального целевого сайта с защитой. Это не укладывается в мою услугу 'Парсер/мониторинг сайтов' (базовый скрейпинг открытых источников), а также может нарушить Terms of Service целевого сайта и его WAF-правила. Рекомендую найти специалиста с опытом именно в anti-bot-инженерии и инфраструктуре прокси.

40737281.title: AI Crypto Research Desktop App
40737281.description: I’ve built a working Windows desktop application called Crypto Intelligence, and I’m looking for an experienced developer who is interested in helping take it to the next level. Natural-language querying of structured market data, reliable grounding of AI responses in calculated data, and architecture that can eventually support a SaaS version are particularly interesting areas. This is not an automated trading bot or trading-signal project. The goal is to create research tools that allow users to investigate market conditions, analyze historical behavior, test ideas, understand portfolio exposure, and make their own decisions. The Windows application is the starting point. My longer-term vision is to evolve Crypto Intelligence into a broader AI-powered crypto research and analytics SaaS platform. For the right developer, this could therefore become an ongoing collaboration rather than a one-off development task. Experience with Python, Windows desktop development, SQLite, cryptocurrency APIs, financial/time-series data, technical indicators, REST APIs, WebSockets, data visualization, LLM integration, RAG, AI agents, or structured-data querying would be valuable. In your proposal, please tell me: 1. What part of the application interests you most? 2. What would you improve first? 3. How would you approach AI-powered market research while keeping responses grounded in real market data? 4. What relevant experience do you have with financial data, crypto, desktop applications, time-series an
40737281.decision: Проект требует разработки desktop-приложения (Windows), расширения существующей архитектуры и долгосрочного сотрудничества. Это выходит за рамки моих услуг: я делаю Python-скрипты автоматизации и Telegram-боты, а не desktop-приложения. Кроме того, клиент просит глубокий код-ревью, архитектурный консалтинг и стратегическое планирование продукта — это не входит в мой профиль. 40737151.title: Event Management, Google Business & Trello Automation

Follow-up tasks should ideally connect to Trello. Management should be a
40737151.decision: Проект выходит за рамки услуг профиля. Хотя есть элементы, которые я могу делать (интеграции Google Sheets/Trello через API, скрипты, парсеры), основной результат — это архитектура, рекомендации по структуре, переход между системами и обучение команды. Это требует стратегического совета, анализа существующих процессов и дизайна системы, а не просто написания кода автоматизации. Объём (аудит + дизайн + реализация + обучение + поддержка) превышает 21 день и мои возможности как одного разработчика. 40736033.title: AI-Generated Fitness Video Production

The camera movement can be adapted where necessary depending on the exercise, but the overall visual language and structure should remain consistent across all 170 videos. CHARACTER / ATHLETE CONSISTENCY — ALL 170 VIDEOS Character/athlete consistency is extremely important. The clothing, studio environment, lighting, camera quality, and overall visual style should also remain consistent so that all 170 videos look like one professionally produced goVervo Studio fitness library. Это выходит за рамки моих услуг. Я делаю автоматизацию на Python: боты, парсеры, постинг по расписанию, генерацию контента через API (текст, озвучка, простые шортсы). Заказ требует профессионального видеопроизводства с использованием специализированных AI-видеотулов и монтажа — это отдельная профессия, не Python-автоматизация.

40738672.title: Cartoonish AI Avatar Intro Video
40738672.description: I'm looking for a professional-grade intro video featuring AI-generated cartoonish avatars of myself and my colleagues. Requirements: - Cartoonish, yet professional-looking avatars - Office environment as the background setting - Professional tone throughout the video Ideal Skills and Experience: - Expertise in AI avatar creation - Experience in video production and editing - Ability to integrate avatars into realistic office background - Strong portfolio showcasing similar projects
40738672.decision: Заказ требует создание AI-видео с людьми (картонные аватары клиента и его коллег). Профиль запрещает генерировать картинки и видео с людьми через ИИ — это не входит в мой функционал. Кроме того, это скорее видеопродакшн и дизайн, чем автоматизация на Python.

40738622.title: Smart Home Automation Setup
40738622.description: I need help setting up home automation for my smart thermostat, Alexa devices and security systems. 40738622.decision: Это не входит в мои услуги. Я разработчица ИИ-автоматизаций на Python — делаю боты, парсеры, генераторы контента и интеграции через API. Настройка физических смарт-устройств (термостатов, камер, Alexa), их конфигурация и локальная интеграция — это IoT/аппаратная инженерия, а не разработка программного обеспечения. Это требует физического доступа к устройствам и опыта с облачными платформами Amazon, что выходит за рамки моего профиля.

40738515.title: AI Entertainment Video on Higgsfield
40738515.description: I want to publish an engaging, easy-to-follow video that uses AI-driven visuals and narration to explain the Higgs field in a light, entertaining way for the general public. The goal is to spark curiosity, not deliver a dense physics lecture, so I’m picturing eye-catching generative art, smooth motion graphics, and a friendly voice-over that turns complex ideas into an enjoyable story. I’m open to whichever AI tools you prefer—Runway, Stable Diffusion, Midjourney, Pika, D-ID, or any custom pipeline—as long as the final result feels polished and keeps viewers watching through to the end. Length can be flexible (somewhere in the 2–4 minute range works for most platforms), but pacing should stay brisk and fun. Please include in your offer: • A short outline of how you’ll translate the Higgs field concept into visuals • The AI or post-production software you intend to use • How many revision cycles you’re comfortable with before final delivery Deliverable: a finished HD video file ready for YouTube or social media, plus any project files I might need for future tweaks. If you can also supply subtitles and a clean audio mix, all the better. I’ll supply any reference links or fact-checking notes once we begin, and I’m happy to record a quick intro or cameo if that helps the flow. Looking forward to seeing how you can make particle physics feel cinematic!
40738515.decision: Проект требует создание видео с motion graphics и generative art, что выходит за рамки услуг профиля. Профиль покрывает только ИИ-генерацию контента (тексты, картинки без людей, озвучка, шортсы) — то есть отдельные компоненты. Но здесь нужна полная видеопродакшн с визуальным дизайном, монтажом, цветокоррекцией и post-production, что является услугой видеомонтажа/дизайна, а не автоматизацией на Python. Это ближе к веб-дизайну и видеопроизводству, чем к ИИ-автоматизации, которой занимается фрилансер.

40738160.title: END-TO-END FID WEBSITE + AUTOMATION DEVELOPMENT
40738160.description: END-TO-END FID AUTOMATION + WEBSITE DEVELOPMENT I run Smiling Money School, a financial education business focused on helping people work toward their Financial Independence Day (FID) and better financial preparedness for expected and unexpected life events. Website/Domain: money4smiling.com I need an experienced freelancer to build a complete FID website + lead generation + automation system. MAIN REQUIREMENTS: • WordPress website / FID landing page • Registration form with Name, Email, Phone and WhatsApp consent • Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, Telegram, WhatsApp Business/API and Google Business Profile integration • UTM/source tracking • n8n automation and webhooks • Google Sheets / CRM lead management and duplicate prevention • WhatsApp confirmation and automated reminders • Zoom/Google Meet integration for FID group sessions • YouTube Live option • Attendance and no-show follow-up automation • 1-to-1 consultation calendar booking with no double booking • Payment integration • Automated follow-up and customer journey • Dashboard/reporting • Error handling, notifications, backups and documentation • System should be scalable for future AI automation FID LANDING PAGE: The landing page will include the agreed 16 FID education/planning topics, including: 1. Goal & Life Clarity / Scientific Goal Test 2. Digital Locker 3. Smiling Money vs Crying Money 4. Master of Money vs Slave of Money 5. Money Personality 6. Income & Saving 7. 6 Money Hats 8. Money Tree Formation 9. Financial Freedom 10. Life Mapping 11. Real Wealth Mapping 12. Capital Need Analysis 13. Liability Test 14. Save & Create vs Create & Save 15. Children Education Planning 16. Retirement Planning IMPORTANT OWNERSHIP & HANDOVER: All production accounts, domain, hosting, WordPress, n8n, Google, Meta, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, Telegram, WhatsApp/API, CRM, calendar, payment and other project accounts must remain under the Client's ownership and control. Freelancer must provide complete handover of workflows, source files, configurations, documentation and backups. The Freelancer must not retain exclusive control over any critical production component. FREE SUPPORT: The project will include 12 months free bug-fix/technical support after final acceptance and complete handover. SOCIAL MEDIA ADVERTISING: The Freelancer will handle technical social-media integration, tracking and automation. Paid advertising campaign creation, funding, management and ad-spend are NOT included unless separately agreed in writing. No automatic advertising commission or percentage of ad spend will apply. FUTURE FREEDOM: The Client remains free to hire and pay any other developer, freelancer, agency or service provider in the future. REQUIRED EXPERIENCE: Please apply only if you have proven experience with: • n8n • Webhooks • WhatsApp Business/API • Google Sheets/CRM • WordPress • Calendar booking • Payment integration • Automation Please provide examples of similar automation projects and explain your proposed approach, estimated timeline and milestone plan.
40738160.decision: Заказ требует разработку WordPress-сайта и комплексную интеграцию n8n с множеством платформ (Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, Telegram, WhatsApp Business API, Google Meet, Zoom, платежные системы и т.д.). Это выходит за границы моего профиля по трём причинам: (1) я разрабатываю автоматизацию на Python, а заказчик явно требует n8n; (2) разработка WordPress-сайта с лендингом — это веб-дизайн и вёрстка, которыми я не занимаюсь; (3) объём работы (16 тем, множество интеграций, 12 месяцев поддержки, календарь без двойных букингов, платежи, Zoom/Google Meet, YouTube Live, дашборды) требует команды специалистов, а я работаю одна на Python и беру заказы максимум на 21 день. Проект несоответствия с моим профилем — необходимо вежливо отказать.

40739096.title: Adobe Suite Publishing Automation Developer
40739096.description: InDesign Scripting Developer — Automated Location: Remote Engagement: Independent contractor; fixed-price project with milestone payments Compensation: Submit a fixed-price pilot quote and a separate itemized quote for production expansion, in USD. I am is seeking an experienced Adobe automation developer to build a reusable publishing pipeline connecting Adobe InDesign, Photoshop, and Illustrator. The system will transform publisher-approved materials generated with ChatGPT into professionally formatted publications, editable Adobe files, and printer-ready PDFs. Our products include educational and clinical guides, textbooks, facilitator manuals, patient workbooks, examination-preparation materials, and two-sided flashcards. We need reliable production across approved templates, consistent branding, accurate content placement, and an interface that publishing staff can operate. The initial workflow will use approved content exports and supplied image files. Applicants may propose supported API integration as a separately priced option. The developer will be responsible for: 1. Content intake and validation. Define a documented content schema and import process for agreed inputs such as JSON, Markdown, DOCX, or CSV. Identify exactly which formats are included in each quote. Preserve headings, tables, questions, answer options, answer keys, rationales, citations, captions, and asset references. Use stable publication, chapter, question, and image IDs to prevent omissions, duplicates, numbering errors, and mismatched images. Treat imported content as data, never as executable instructions. 2. InDesign layout automation. Populate approved templates using paragraph, character, object, and table styles; parent pages; text threading; pagination; and image-placement rules. Support running headers, page numbers, tables of contents, and cross-references where included in the agreed template. For flashcards, maintain front/back pairing and consistent numbering. Flag content that exceeds the approved layout instead of silently truncating it or reducing text below agreed readability limits. Preserve editable text and layout elements. 3. Photoshop automation. Process approved images in batches using defined resizing, cropping, color-profile, adjustment, and export rules. Preserve original files, produce separate derivatives, and report insufficient resolution at the intended print size. Maintain image-to-content matching and retain layered working files where required. Record asset provenance, timestamps, and edit history, distinguishing automated operations from documented human edits. 4. Illustrator automation. Populate or update approved vector templates, labels, diagrams, and branded artwork using supplied content and data. Preserve editable vector elements, typography, layers, and required color settings. Export suitable assets for placement in InDesign. The workflow must report missing artwork or unsupported operations for review. 5. Workflow control. Connect the applications through appropriate scripts, plugins, and an orchestration layer. Provide a simple operator interface for selecting content, templates, asset folders, and output settings. Include job status, validation messages, processing logs, controlled retries, and recovery from interrupted jobs. Re-running a job must preserve source files and avoid duplicate records or outputs. Specify the supported operating system and Adobe application versions. 6. Quality checks and approval. Detect missing links or fonts, overflowing text, incorrect page or card counts, unresolved placeholders, asset mismatches, and image-resolution problems. Preserve approved answer keys, rationales, and references without silent rewriting. Generate a review proof and a readable issue report. Require designated publisher approval before final production release; clinical and editorial judgments remain with our reviewers. Changes to approved content must trigger a new review. 7. Print and delivery outp
40739096.decision: Проект требует разработки на JavaScript/ExtendScript для Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Photoshop, Illustrator), а также глубокие знания типографии, предпечатной подготовки, PDF/X-4 и publish-workflow. Это специализированная разработка на экосистеме Adobe, а не Python-автоматизация. Мой профиль — разработка ИИ-автоматизаций на Python (боты, парсеры, интеграции API, генерация контента). У меня нет опыта с Adobe scripting, ExtendScript, UXP, INDD-манипуляциями и сложной предпечатной логикой. Обещать выполнение без уверенности — нарушить честность (шариат запрещает). Проект заслуживает разработчика с реальным портфолио Adobe-проектов.

40739058.title: AI Documentary on Fictional Biographies
40739058.description: I am building a short-form documentary series that profiles entirely fictional characters, yet treats their lives with the same informative, educational depth you would expect from a traditional biography. Each episode will be produced with AI tools end-to-end—from script generation and voice-over to B-roll creation and final editing—so I need someone comfortable orchestrating the whole pipeline. Here is what I have in mind: the script must read like a well-researched mini-lecture, peppered with faux archival quotes, dates, and “historical” context that feel authentic without ever misleading the viewer about its fictional nature. Visuals can be assembled through text-to-video or stock footage blends; the goal is a cohesive five-to-eight-minute video that a viewer could mistake for a genuine documentary segment until the final disclaimer. Deliverables I will review for each episode: • A complete AI-generated script (≈1,000 words) • Synthetic or human-polished narration track (wav) • Edited 1080p video with subtitles (mp4) • Source project file showing your AI workflow (Premiere, DaVinci, or similar) I will supply the character outlines; you bring the creative AI stack—ChatGPT or comparable LLMs for scripting, ElevenLabs or similar for voice, and any preferred generative video or motion-graphics tools for visuals. Quality, clarity, and an educational narrative tone are non-negotiable. If this sounds like an exciting challenge, let’s discuss your approach and a sample timeline for the first episode.
40739058.decision: Проект требует видеомонтажа и работы с Premiere/DaVinci — это выходит за рамки моих услуг. Я делаю автоматизации на Python (генерация контента, озвучка, постинг), но не занимаюсь профессиональным видеомонтажом и работой со специализированным видеоредакторским ПО. Заказчик явно ищет видеопродюсера с опытом в Premiere/DaVinci, а не разработчика ИИ-автоматизаций.

40738948.title: GoHighLevel Automation Expert Required
40738948.description: Expert GoHighLevel Automation VA Needed (7-Day Build, Fixed Price) We're a growth systems agency building a full automation setup in GoHighLevel for a client: a membership platform with three paid tiers, a TV show program and live events. We need an experienced automation expert to build the workflows with us. We handle strategy, copy and the client. You handle the build. What you'll build: New member workflows for 3 tiers: team alert, tasks with owners, tags, added to the pipeline Onboarding email sequences for each tier (we give you the copy) Profile completion reminders at day 3, 7, 14 and 30, with a task for the team if still not done A benefit delivery calendar: each member benefit set up as a dated task with an owner across the year TV show onboarding: intake form, auto email, call booking, production stages in a pipeline Inquiry routing: forms and chat tagged, auto reply, assigned to a person, follow-up if they go quiet Renewal reminders at 60, 30 and 7 days before expiry, plus a win-back sequence Review and testimonial request automations One clean pipeline and simple views showing what's overdue Tag cleanup and one unified inquiry form Skills required: GoHighLevel: workflows, pipelines, forms, calendars, tags, custom fields n8n and webhooks (connecting an outside platform to GHL) ClickUp and Slack Funnel design and automation Please don't apply if: You're new to GHL or automation You can't share a portfolio of real builds Details: Fixed price: ₹15,000 for the full project Timeline: 7 days Clear updates without being chased, and everything tested before handover This is our first project together. 40738948.decision: Заказ требует работы в GoHighLevel (SaaS-платформе с визуальным конструктором), а не на Python. Профиль указывает: 'Я работаю на Python. GoHighLevel — это тот же класс инструментов, требующий экспертизы в самой платформе, а не в программировании. Клиент явно просит портфель реальных GHL-проектов и опыт именно в этой системе. Python-автоматизация не заменит специалиста по GHL-воркфлоам и пайплайнам. Это не наша услуга.

40739336.title: Photorealistic AI Screenplay Promo
40739336.description: I have a finished screenplay and a complete voice track produced in ElevenLabs, each character already separated with clean, ready-to-sync dialogue. The goal is to turn the opening and key climax moments into a 10-minute photorealistic promo that I can show to potential investors for a full-length feature. Your first task will be a three-minute proof segment drawn from those same opening and climax beats. I’ll supply the screenplay pages, the timed audio, and several AI-generated reference images for the main characters. I need you to bring them to life with a lifelike AI-driven video pipeline—think Stable Diffusion/SDXL, Pika, Runway Gen-2, Wonder Studio, Kinematica, or a comparable toolset—while matching lip-sync and facial performance to the voices I provide. I don’t yet have background music, so I’ll count on you to recommend or license a score that fits the tone. All music must be cleared for investor use. Deliverables • Three-minute photorealistic proof clip (4K preferred, 24 fps, synced to supplied audio) • Draft and final cut of the full 10-minute promo once the proof is approved • Music options (at least two) with usage terms • Source project files or reproducible workflows so I can update later if needed Acceptance criteria • Characters stay visually consistent across shots and scenes • Lip-sync accuracy within two frames of dialogue • Minimal visual artifacts or uncanny movement; animation must feel cinematic, not slideshow • Final export ready for investor screening (clean titles, no watermarks) Please respond with: 1. A link to previous photorealistic AI video work (not animation or cartoon). 2. Your proposed tool chain. 3. A fixed price or clear hourly estimate for the initial three-minute segment and your typical turnaround time. 4. Any questions you need answered before we kick off—target start is within the next two weeks. I look forward to seeing how you can elevate this story on screen.
40739336.decision: Проект требует создания фотореалистичных видео с синхронизацией губ и специальными эффектами. Это выходит за рамки моих услуг. Я специализируюсь на Python-автоматизации (боты, парсеры, генерация контента, постинг), а не на видеопроизводстве, работе с видеоредакторами и инструментами типа Pika, Runway, Wonder Studio. Клиент просит также портфолио фотореалистичных видео и фиксированную цену с гарантиями по качеству синхронизации, чего я не могу обеспечить в этой нише. Заказ требует навыков видеопродакшена, которых у меня нет.

40739337.title: Creation of a hyper-realistic corporate group photo from scratch using AI (Zero artificial look).
40739337.description: We are looking for a digital artist and advanced AI expert (Midjourney v6, Stable Diffusion, ControlNet) with solid post-production skills in Photoshop. The goal is to create from scratch a corporate group photo of a team that does not yet exist, but must look 100% real. Important note about resources: The image must be generated completely from scratch. We will NOT provide a base photo for you to edit. We will only provide: 1. A "sample" photo for you to understand the composition, structure, and the type of formal pose we are looking for. 2. A "sample" photo of the type of office building in Florida upon which the team should appear (you must generate or provide the final background based on this style). Exact Image & Composition Requirements: - Team Composition: 12 to 15 people posing for the camera, organized in at least two rows (the front row kneeling or with one knee on the ground, the back row standing) to ensure all faces are clearly visible. - Genuine & Varied Gestures: We are looking for an enthusiastic yet natural corporate style. People should have different poses: some with crossed arms, others with their hands in their pockets, and only a few (not all) doing a "thumbs up" gesture. Everyone must look directly at the lens and smile naturally. - Diversity: Men and women of different ages, races, and physical characteristics to reflect a global, genuine, and modern team. - Attire & Logo: Everyone must wear the same clothing (t-shirt). The corporate color is purple or dark navy blue; you can choose whichever looks better and integrates more naturally with the composition. Our company logo must be placed in the center of the chest, large enough to be seen with total clarity. We know that pure AI does not generate perfect logos, so we require you to integrate the logo using Photoshop, respecting the wrinkles, the curvature of the body, shadows, and the fabric texture of each person. Quality Level & Delivery Conditions: - Zero AI artifacts: The anatomy of all visible hands must be flawless. Teeth, gazes, and hair cannot have deformities. The correction of these "AI errors" (extra fingers, weird eyes, poor background integration) is an inherent obligation of the final delivery and will not be counted as a round of revision. - Included Revisions: In addition to cleaning up AI errors, the budget must include at least 3 revision rounds to make improvements or slight conceptual modifications at our request. - Final Deliverables: Final image in High Resolution (suitable for print/web). It is not necessary to deliver the source files (PSD). Workflow & Deadlines: - Total Delivery Time: 3 days. - Mandatory Daily Reports: This work requires constant communication. We require daily progress reports and premise checks (Day 1, Day 2, and Day 3) to review sketches, composition, and progress before the final rendering and cleanup. To Apply for this Job: Please include in your proposal: - The word "PHOTOREALISM" at the beginning of your message so we know you read until the end. - Your portfolio: Only examples of people and groups generated with AI that reach a photorealistic level. - Your Workflow: Briefly explain how you will solve the realistic integration of the logo in the center of the t-shirts and how you will correct AI-generated hands. - Confirmation that you agree with the daily reporting scheme, the 3 conceptual revisions, and the established budget.
40739337.decision: Основная услуга — генерация фотореалистичного корпоративного портрета с людьми (15 человек) с использованием Midjourney/Stable Diffusion и постобработкой в Photoshop. В профиле указано: «Картинки и видео с людьми, сгенерированные ИИ» — это услуга, которую я НЕ делаю (правило шариата и профиля). Генерация контента в таблице означает картинки БЕЗ людей (иконки, иллюстрации, абстракции). Этот проект требует создания реалистичных человеческих лиц и тел, что выходит за границы моих услуг.

40739915.title: SEO, GEO & AEO Specialist for AI Consumer Startup
40739915.description: We are looking for an experienced SEO/GEO/AEO specialist to help improve the organic visibility of an early-stage AI consumer platform across Google, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Bing and other AI-powered search and answer engines. This is not a traditional SEO-only project. We are specifically looking for someone who understands how search is changing and can help us build visibility across: - Google Search - ChatGPT - Perplexity - Google AI Overviews - Bing/Copilot - Other AI answer and discovery platforms ## What we need We want someone who can help us build the complete organic search and AI-discovery strategy from the ground up. The project will include: ### 1. SEO Strategy - Keyword research - Search intent analysis - Competitor analysis - Category and positioning research - Identification of high-intent search opportunities - Long-tail keyword strategy - Content cluster strategy - Internal linking strategy - Landing page recommendations These are examples only. We expect the specialist to conduct independent research and challenge our assumptions. ### 2. GEO / AI Search Optimisation We want us to be discoverable when users ask AI tools questions related to our offerings. You should understand how brands and websites become sources referenced or cited by AI systems. We need recommendations covering: - Content structure for AI retrieval - Entity optimisation - Brand consistency across the web - Citation opportunities - Authority building - Answer-friendly content - Structured factual content - Third-party mentions - Digital PR opportunities - AI crawler accessibility ### 3. AEO Create an Answer Engine Optimisation framework including: - FAQ architecture - Question-based content - Concise answer sections - Featured snippet opportunities - Conversational search queries - "Can AI..." and "How do I..." queries - Product comparison opportunities - Educational content Content should be designed for both humans and machines. ### 4. Technical SEO Audit and recommend improvements covering: - Site architecture - Indexability - Sitemap - Robots.txt - Canonical URLs - Page speed - Core Web Vitals - Metadata - Heading structure - Internal linking - Schema / structured data - Organisation schema - SoftwareApplication schema - Breadcrumb schema - Article schema where relevant Also ensure the website can be appropriately crawled by major search and AI discovery systems. ### 5. Content Architecture We do NOT want hundreds of low-quality AI-generated blog posts. We prefer a smaller number of high-quality pages built around real user problems. We want you to recommend the correct structure based on research rather than simply following these examples. ### 6. Measurement We want a clear framework for measuring progress including: - Organic impressions - Organic clicks - Search rankings - Branded search growth - Non-branded search growth - Pages generating organic traffic - AI referral traffic - AI citations/mentions where measurable - Domain authority / referring domains - Conversion from organic traffic - Search Console performance - Bing Webmaster performance ## Deliverables We expect the initial project to include: 1. Full SEO audit 2. GEO/AEO audit 3. Competitor analysis 4. Keyword research 5. Search opportunity map 6. Recommended site architecture 7. Recommended landing pages 8. Content strategy 9. Technical SEO recommendations 10. Schema recommendations 11. Internal linking strategy 12. AI-search visibility strategy 13. 90-day execution plan 14. KPI and reporting framework We would also be open to continuing with the same person for implementation if the initial strategy is strong. ## Who we are looking for You should ideally have experience with: - SaaS or consumer technology products - AI startups - SEO strategy - Technical SEO - GEO / Generative Engine Optimisation - AEO / Answer Engine Optimisation - Google Search Console - Bing Webmaster Tools - Schema markup
40739915.decision: Проект требует SEO-стратегию, аудит, исследование конкурентов, архитектуру контента и рекомендации — это консультационная и стратегическая работа, не входящая в мой список услуг. 40739610.title: Automate 8M Product Image Population
40739610.description: We have approximately **8 million products already uploaded to our website/database**, and all products currently do not have images. We are looking for an experienced developer/automation engineer to build a **scalable automated product image sourcing, generation, matching and upload system**. The preferred image hierarchy is: 1. Find and use an accurate manufacturer/official product image where available. 2. If a suitable real image cannot be found, use AI-generated product-only images where appropriate. 3. Products with uncertain image matches should be flagged for review rather than automatically uploading an incorrect image. The system should use available product information such as product name, part number/SKU, manufacturer, brand, category and description to identify the correct image. ### Required Workflow The system should automatically: - Read products from our database/API. - Find or generate an appropriate product image. - Match and validate the image against the correct product/SKU/part number. - Detect duplicate or potentially incorrect images. - Optimize/compress images for web delivery. - Upload images to our server/cloud storage/CDN. - Update the correct product record with the image URL. - Skip products that have already been successfully processed. - Maintain processing status and logs. - Retry failed processing automatically. - Flag uncertain matches for manual review. ### Scale The complete database contains approximately **8 million products**. We do NOT expect all 8 million products to be processed immediately. The first phase should be a **Proof of Concept (POC)** using a smaller dataset. After validating image accuracy, matching accuracy, processing speed, infrastructure requirements and cost, the system should be capable of scaling to millions of products. ### Important This is **NOT a manual data-entry or manual image-upload project**. We need an automated and scalable technical solution. ### When Applying, Please Answer 1. How would you architect this system for 8 million products? 2. How would you verify that an image belongs to the correct product/part number? 3. How would you source manufacturer/official product images? 4. When would you use AI-generated images? 5. How would you detect duplicate or incorrect images? 6. What technology stack would you use? 7. How would you handle failures, retries and uncertain matches? 8. What cloud storage/CDN architecture would you recommend? 9. What would be the estimated processing cost per 100,000 or 1 million products? 10. Have you previously built a large-scale image/data-processing system? Please avoid generic proposals. Explain the architecture you would recommend specifically for this project. If the POC is successful, this can become a significantly larger long-term project.
40739610.decision: Проект выходит за рамки услуг профиля. Хотя он включает парсинг, ИИ-генерацию и интеграцию с API (всё это я делаю), основная задача — архитектура и разработка масштабируемой системы обработки 8 млн продуктов с поиском изображений, валидацией, дедупликацией, оптимизацией и загрузкой в облако. Это требует проектирования сложной инфраструктуры, работы с большими объёмами данных (Big Data), управления облачными ресурсами, настройки CDN, оценки затрат на масштабирование — то есть консультирование и системное проектирование на уровне senior-архитектора, а не просто написание скрипта автоматизации. Кроме того, клиент просит ответы на 10 архитектурных вопросов перед началом работы, что указывает на потребность в предварительном консалтинге и подробном техническом плане, выходящем за пределы моего стандартного предложения услуг. Если клиент захочет просто разработать POC на Python (парсер + ИИ-генерация + API интеграция) на меньшем датасете, я готова откликнуться на уточнённый заказ.

Every clip must include: • A coherent look that keeps my characters on-model across all scenes • On-screen text where indicated in the script • Full sound design—music cleared for commercial social-media use plus subtle effects and ambience • Delivery of the first finished video for approval, followed by the remaining four once we confirm we’re in sync Kindly send me links to comparable hand-drawn or AI-assisted 2D shorts you have produced and quote one fixed price covering all five videos, including any software or licensing fees. If this collaboration flows smoothly, there’s scope for 8–10 similar videos each month.
40741049.decision: Проект требует создания визуального контента (анимация, дизайн персонажей, artstyle) — это не входит в мой профиль. Я делаю ИИ-автоматизации и генерацию контента (тексты, озвучка, шортсы из готовых материалов), но не занимаюсь анимацией, дизайном, постпродакшеном видео или звука. Заказчик ищет профессионального аниматора/видеографа, а не разработчика автоматизаций.

40740951.title: Adobe Publishing Automation Script
40740951.description: I have a working proof-of-concept script that batch-places JPGs into InDesign and exports a PDF, but I need it polished into a dependable, time-saving tool. The goal is simple: eliminate the repetitive steps I perform whenever I build headshot catalogs. What I already have • A short ExtendScript snippet (shown in the brief) that loops through images, adds pages, places each photo, and exports a PDF. • Finished InDesign templates that define page size, margins, paragraph styles, master pages, etc. • Folders full of headshot JPGs. What I want the finished script to do 1. Optional Photoshop pre-processing: run a defined batch action to crop, resize, or colour-correct every image before they reach InDesign. 2. Smart placement: place each processed headshot into the correct placeholder frames of my template instead of creating blank pages one by one. 3. Overflow handling: automatically add new pages based on the master page when the template frames are filled. 4. Consistent fitting: apply Fit Options (fill proportionally, centre content) and preserve frame/object styles. 5. Output automation: save the InDesign file, export a press-ready PDF to a chosen folder, and show a summary alert of pages/images processed. 6. Basic UI: allow me to pick the image folder, the destination folder, and toggle the Photoshop step on/off. 7. Reliability extras: simple error handling, progress bar, comments in the code so I can tweak variables later. Deliverables • A clean, fully-commented .jsx (or .js) script ready to run from InDesign Scripts panel. • Any Photoshop action file if you create one. • A short read-me (or screen-recorded walk-through) showing how to install, run, and adjust the script. If you have experience writing ExtendScript for both Photoshop and InDesign and can turn my rough draft into a production-ready automation, I’d love to hear how you would approach the task and your expected turnaround.
40740951.decision: Проект требует разработки на ExtendScript (JavaScript для Adobe) и работу с Adobe InDesign/Photoshop API. Я работаю только на Python. Хотя это автоматизация, но её нельзя реализовать на моём стеке. Заказчику нужен именно скрипт для InDesign, а не Python-решение — отказываемся вежливо.

40740911.title: AI-Driven Military History Videos
40740911.description: I’m producing a short-form educational video series covering key battles and conflicts throughout military history. Each episode will run approximately 2–5 minutes and should feel authoritative, visually polished, and engaging for a broad online audience. I’m looking for someone who can handle the full production workflow from research through final delivery, with the potential for a long-term collaboration if the work meets expectations. The goal is to build a YouTube channel with consistent, high-quality content. The work will include: - End-to-end video production: research, scripting, AI visuals/animation, voiceover, editing, sound design, captions, color correction, thumbnail creation, and final 4K export. - Historical research and accuracy: use credible sources, fact-check key claims, and flag uncertainty rather than inventing details. - YouTube publishing and channel support: upload videos, add titles/descriptions/thumbnails/captions, schedule releases, apply correct disclosures, and check the final upload. - Source and asset management: maintain a clear record of research sources, archival material, licenses, AI-generated assets, and project files. - IP and ownership agreement: all original commissioned work and deliverables are assigned to me upon payment with rights to edit, republish, monetize, translate, license, and reuse. - Third-party rights and licensing: freelancer is responsible for ensuring any stock materials (e.g., archive footage/music/fonts), AI outputs or subcontracted work can legally be used commercially. - Confidentiality and account security: protect unreleased material, channel information/credentials/business details; use secure delegated access where possible. - Deliverables and file handover: final videos plus editable project files (source assets/scripts/captions/thumbnails/audio/prompts/research/reference sheets). - Payment milestones and revisions: agreed rate/delivery stages/turnaround times/revision limits/approval points. - Quality control and corrections: freelancer must check factual accuracy/captions/audio/visual consistency/export quality/fix errors they introduced. - Termination and handover: clear process for ending the relationship/transferring all files/removing account access/handing over unfinished work. - Independent contractor agreement: covers responsibilities/liability/confidentiality/IP/governing law/limits on subcontracting or spending without approval. Additional Notes: - An initial discussion session will be required to align on expectations, workflow processes, and desired output. Example videos I have produced myself will be provided during this session as references. - A trial is required: freelancers will need to produce the first 30 seconds or 1 minute of an episode to demonstrate their capability before proceeding with the full video. - Oversight will be provided on scripts/assets during initial stages. Once the freelancer gets it right consistently over time they may manage production independently. The key priorities are historical accuracy, strong storytelling, realistic visuals, consistency in quality across episodes, professional presentation. The final result should feel closer to a high-quality television or premium YouTube history documentary than generic AI-generated content. If a viewer can learn something meaningful in under five minutes and the finished episode looks polished enough to broadcast or upload professionally on YouTube channels aimed at broad audiences interested in history documentaries—this project has succeeded. When applying: please include examples of relevant documentary work (history/military), AI-video production samples if available (or similar short-form editing work), along with the AI/editing tools you normally use.
40740911.decision: Проект требует полного видеопроизводства (research, scripting, visuals, voiceover, editing, color correction, thumbnails, 4K export) — это не просто генерация контента, а professional video production workflow. Профиль предлагает только ИИ-генерацию контента (тексты, картинки без людей, озвучка, шортсы) за $100–$80. Видеомонтаж, цветокоррекция, экспорт в 4K, работа со звуком на профессиональном уровне — это услуги видеомонтажера/режиссёра, которых я не предоставляю. Хотя озвучка и генерация шортсов есть в меню, полный production pipeline с этим объёмом и качеством выходит за границы компетенции (делаю только готовые шортсы для своих проектов, не на заказ). Отказываемся.

40739709.title: Lezioni su Autodesk Fusion 360: Workflow PCB e Stampa 3D in Italiano
40739709.description: Cerco un esperto di Autodesk Fusion 360 che possa fornire lezioni in lingua italiana sul workflow completo, dalla progettazione dello schema elettronico PCB alla stampa 3D e viceversa. L'obiettivo è imparare a integrare il design PCB con la stampa 3D, comprendendo ogni fase del processo. Inizialmente, desidero organizzare alcune lezioni introduttive per valutare il formatore più idoneo alle mie esigenze, con la possibilità di proseguire man mano in base ai progressi.
40739709.decision: Заказ требует преподавания и обучения (lessons/lezioni) в Autodesk Fusion 360, что находится вне моего профиля. Я разработчица Python-автоматизаций, а не преподаватель CAD/дизайна. Услуга не входит в мой список (сайты, дизайн, мобильные приложения и обучение — это не моё). Хотя заказчик упоминает интеграцию PCB с 3D-печатью, это требует экспертизы в самом Fusion 360, а не в автоматизации процессов через код.

40741301.title: Especialista en CRM Go High Level (GHL) y Automatizaciones
40741301.description: ¡En Asecor Academy buscamos Especialista Técnico en GoHighLevel (GHL) & Automatizaciones! En Asecor Academy seguimos optimizando e innovando en nuestro ecosistema digital y buscamos a un/a Especialista Técnico en GoHighLevel (GHL) con perfil analítico, resolutivo y orientado a resultados. No buscamos únicamente a un ejecutor de tareas, sino a un técnico con pensamiento estratégico capaz de proponer soluciones eficaces, diagnosticar integraciones, estructurar flujos complejos y asegurar que la tecnología trabaje a favor de la operación. - ¿Cuál será tu misión? Serás responsable de diseñar, optimizar y mantener la arquitectura técnica en GHL, conectar automatizaciones avanzadas con herramientas externas (Make/n8n) e implementar tracking de alta precisión (Meta CAPI). - Responsabilidades clave • Estructuración en GHL: Diseñar y mantener Workflows, Triggers, Pipelines, Oportunidades, campos personalizados y etiquetas avanzadas. • Integraciones y Ecosistema: Construir integraciones fluidas entre GHL, Make, n8n y servicios externos vía Webhooks y APIs REST. • Tracking & CAPI: Configurar y validar eventos de Meta Conversion API (CAPI) desde GHL/Make con deduplicación exacta de datos y hashing. • Lógica Condicional: Implementar campos booleanos y lógica de control para garantizar un flujo limpio de datos y leads. • Control de Calidad: Realizar pruebas de integración (Test Events) rigurosas antes de pasar automatizaciones a producción. • Optimización Proactiva: Proponer mejoras constantes en la arquitectura técnica de la empresa. - Requisitos indispensables • Dominio avanzado de GoHighLevel (GHL): Workflows, subcuentas, pipelines, CAPI y administración de contactos. • Dominio de herramientas de integración: Make (Integromat) y/o n8n. • Conocimiento en Meta Ads & Tracking: Implementación de Meta CAPI (Server-Side), Pixel, deduplicación y mapeo de eventos. • Fundamentos técnicos: Manejo fluido de JSON, Webhooks, endpoints de APIs REST y campos booleanos. • Idiomas: Español y/o Inglés fluido (hablado y escrito) para interpretar requerimientos e integraciones técnicas. • Habilidades blandas: Alta autonomía, capacidad crítica de resolución de problemas, atención al detalle y estricto cumplimiento de cronogramas. - Puntos extra / Deseable (No obligatorio) • Experiencia integrando pasarelas de pago complejas (ej. PayPal Orders API v2, JS SDK, pasarelas locales) con lógica de autopago. • Creación de landings dinámicas. • Diseño de flujos automatizados de conciliación de cobros e integración con bases de datos operativas. Condiciones de contratación • Modalidad: Freelance por proyecto / Horas de soporte recurrente según requerimientos del ecosistema de la empresa. • Seguridad: Firma de Acuerdo de Confidencialidad (NDA) y contrato de prestación de servicios. • Continuidad: Disponibilidad para trabajar en diversos proyectos continuos en GHL según demanda de la empresa. - ¿Cómo postular? Si cuentas con el perfil, envía tu CV y tu propuesta respondiendo brevemente: 1. ¿Qué experiencia tienes integrando GoHighLevel y Meta? 2. ¿Qué filtros o controles aplicas en tus automatizaciones para evitar que un mismo cliente active el mismo evento dos veces por error? 3. Adjunta ejemplos o una breve descripción de arquitecturas de automatización / APIs que hayas diseñado previamente.
40741301.decision: Заказ требует специализацию на GoHighLevel (GHL) и Make/n8n, которые я не использую в своей работе. Я разработчица на Python и создаю автоматизации через Python-скрипты, API и Telegram-боты, а не через платформы визуального программирования. Клиент явно ищет специалиста именно по GHL/Make/n8n с их инструментами и архитектурой. Предложить Python-решение вместо GHL было бы нечестно перед клиентом, так как это совсем другой подход и экосистема. Отказываюсь вежливо.

40741269.title: Especialista en Meta Ads + CRM GoHighLevel + WordPress para empresa fotovoltaica

40741203.title: AI-Powered TikTok Shop Setup
40741203.description: I need an expert to jumpstart my TikTok shop for health and beauty products using AI. Requirements: - AI-generated videos on product tutorials, customer testimonials, and promotional offers. - Daily video posts. - Automated scheduling and posting.
