Looking for someone who can streamline this process and engage potential customers effectively.
40741203.decision: Заказ требует ежедневной генерации видео с людьми (customer testimonials, product tutorials) и публикации на TikTok. По профилю я делаю ИИ-генерацию контента и автопостинг, но генерировать видео с людьми (даже через ИИ) нельзя — это запрещено правилами шариата и платформ. Кроме того, TikTok Shop — это не простая рассылка по расписанию, а управление витриной товаров, что выходит за рамки моих услуг (это ближе к SMM-ведению и дизайну).

40741071.title: AI Visual Storyteller for Philosophical YouTube Channel
40741071.description: AI Video Editor / Visual Storyteller for Long-Term YouTube Channel We are looking for a talented AI video editor / visual storyteller for a long-term YouTube project about thought-provoking ideas, human behavior, life, time, memory, technology, society and the strange things people accept as normal without questioning them. Our goal is to create videos that make viewers think: “I had never thought about it that way.” WHAT WE PROVIDE • Complete script • Final Spanish HUMAN voice-over • Narrative structure • Creative direction • Visual references when necessary You do NOT need to write scripts or generate narration. YOUR JOB Transform our narration into an engaging and visually coherent 6–8 minute 1080p YouTube video using an efficient combination of: • AI-generated images/video • Royalty-free footage when appropriate • Subtle animation/camera movement • Music and light sound design • Simple, tasteful editing You may use Kling, Veo, Seedance, Runway, Midjourney, Flux, Premiere, CapCut or other tools you prefer. We are not looking for complicated filmmaking. We are looking for intelligent visual storytelling. MAIN CREATIVE REFERENCE Pursuit of Wonder: https://www.youtube.com/@PursuitofWonder This is the closest reference for the intellectual and emotional experience we want: curiosity, storytelling, philosophical depth and complex ideas made human. We are NOT trying to copy this channel. We want to develop our own identity. Additional visual/production references: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GMDuNZXvVoI https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0Ha0DfWrsxA IMPORTANT — NOT A DARK PSYCHOLOGY CHANNEL The references above show production quality, pacing and atmosphere, but we do NOT want a repetitive dark aesthetic. Our visual identity is not darkness. Our visual identity is curiosity. The visual language should change with each idea: warm and nostalgic, clean and modern, strange, beautiful, surreal, uncomfortable, contemplative or dark when the subject actually requires it. VISUAL DIFFERENTIATION We want conceptual visual storytelling, not literal illustration. If the narration talks about time, you do not always need to show a clock. If it talks about loneliness, you do not always need to show a sad person. If it talks about money, you do not always need to show cash. Look for visual metaphors. We especially like ordinary situations containing one unexpected or slightly surreal element — something familiar that makes the viewer look twice. Each episode should ideally contain at least one memorable “hero visual” representing its central idea. Think less like a stock-footage editor and more like a visual storyteller. WE DO NOT WANT • Generic motivational videos • Random stock footage matched literally to words • One-click automated AI videos • Repetitive dark-psychology imagery • Robotic AI Spanish narration • Excessive effects or transitions • The same visual template in every episode FIRST PROJECT One paid 6–8 minute test video. If the collaboration works well, we expect approximately 8–12 videos per month, so efficient production and competitive recurring pricing are important. WHEN APPLYING Start your proposal with “OBVIOUS VIDEO” so we know you read the description. Please include: 1. Only 1–2 portfolio examples closest to our references. 2. Which AI/video tools you personally use. 3. Briefly explain how you would produce this type of video efficiently. 4. Your price for the first 6–8 minute paid test. 5. Your best price per video for 8 videos/month. 6. Your best price per video for 12 videos/month. 7. Your country/location. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to create a very short visual sample using the same voice-over so we can compare creative approaches. We value visual taste, reliability, efficiency and long-term pricing more than complicated editing.
40741071.decision: Основной продукт — видеомонтаж и создание визуального контента для YouTube. В профиле предложена услуга 'ИИ-генерация контента (тексты, картинки без людей, озвучка, шортсы)', но она подразумевает генерацию шортсов (короткие видео), а не полнометражный монтаж 6–8 минутных видеоэпизодов с использованием профессиональных видеоредакторов (Premiere, CapCut, Runway и т.д.). Заказчик ищет видеоредактора/visual storyteller'а, умеющего работать с множеством инструментов (Kling, Veo, Midjourney, Premiere и др.) и создавать сложные повествовательные видео с концептуальным подходом. Это выходит за рамки Python-автоматизаций, на которых специализируется разработчица. Хотя можно было бы использовать Python для оркестрации генерации изображений через API, основной вызов — это не программирование, а творческий видеомонтаж и visual storytelling, что требует видеопроизводства, а не разработки ИИ-автоматизаций.

40741069.title: Monetize Existing AI Influencer Quickly
40741069.description: I already run an AI-generated influencer account on Fanvue, Instagram and TikTok, posting a steady mix of short-form videos and curated images. The follower base is growing but revenue is still negligible, so my focus for the next four weeks is clear: convert attention into paid subscriptions and brand income. Here is what I want to accomplish during that timeframe—feel free to suggest the best sequence or extra tactics if you see gaps: • Refine positioning and tone so the virtual persona feels consistent across all three platforms while gently funnelling fans toward Fanvue’s paid tier. • Design a 30-day content calendar (videos + images) that balances viral reach pieces with exclusive, pay-walled teasers. • Set up or optimise revenue levers—Fanvue pricing tiers, bundle offers, limited drops, shout-out packages, affiliate links—tracking everything in basic dashboards. • Launch and monitor targeted growth pushes on Instagram Reels and TikTok (native ads, stitch/duet challenges, collabs with micro-creators). • Provide weekly KPI snapshots: follower growth, engagement %, CTR to Fanvue, paid conversion rate and net revenue. Acceptance criteria 1. At least one Fanvue tier shows >5 % conversion from social traffic. 2. Overall monthly net revenue exceeds current baseline by a noticeable margin I can reinvest (I’ll share the baseline privately). 3. Simple analytics sheet delivered so I can continue tracking after the engagement ends. You’ll have full access to existing content libraries, account insights and brand guidelines the moment we agree on the plan. Timing is tight—everything needs to roll out and start showing traction within a month—so efficiency and clear communication are a must.
40741069.decision: Проект требует SMM-ведение вручную, дизайн контента, стратегию маркетинга и рекламные кампании. Это не входит в мой профиль. Я делаю автоматизацию на Python: боты, парсеры, генерацию контента через ИИ, постинг по расписанию. Но здесь нужен именно человеческий менеджмент: позиционирование персоны, работа с микроинфлюэнсерами, запуск и мониторинг таргетированной рекламы, еженедельная аналитика с интерпретацией. Это SMM и маркетинг-консалтинг, не код.

40741400.title: Product Photographer + AI Image Specialist – Security Screens & Doors (Brisbane / Gold Coast / Sunshine Coast) – Start 5 Oct
40741400.description: Title: Product Photographer + AI Image Specialist – Security Screens & Doors (Brisbane / Gold Coast / Sunshine Coast) – Start 5 Oct About us We're an established Brisbane manufacturer of security screens and doors with more than 25 years in the industry. We're preparing a major product launch and need a standout set of images that show our products for what they are: precision-engineered, exceptionally strong, and good-looking on any home. What we need We're looking for a product photographer who can also use AI tools and 3D visualisation to turn a studio shoot into a full launch image library. You'll shoot on-site at our facility in Acacia Ridge, Brisbane, then take the images to the next level in post-production. The deliverables are: Hero product shots: Full-product images on clean backgrounds, lit to bring out the finish, frame, and mesh detail. Close-ups and detail shots: Corners, joins, locks, hinges, mesh retention, and frame profiles. These are the details that show quality. Internal and cutaway views: Images that look down inside the product and show how it's built and why it's strong. Exploded 3D views: Using our technical drawings, create exploded and assembly-style 3D images that show how every component fits together. Installed-on-home imagery: Composite and AI-enhanced images that show our products fitted to real Australian homes. Some images will also be projected at large scale onto a house facade, so they need to be high-resolution and projection-ready. AI enhancement: Use AI tools to lift lighting, backgrounds, and presentation so the images really pop. Every image must stay true to the real product, with no invented features or inaccurate details. Timeline (firm) Applications close: Sunday 4 October Hire confirmed: Monday 5 October Photo shoot: Week of 5 October All final images delivered: Within 1–2 weeks of hire (no later than Monday 19 October) You'll be a strong fit if you have: A portfolio of commercial product photography, ideally building products, hardware, furniture, or industrial or technical products Proven skill with AI image tools (e.g. Photoshop Generative Fill, Firefly, Midjourney, Magnific, or similar) 3D visualisation or rendering experience (e.g. Blender, KeyShot, Fusion 360, or similar) and the ability to work from technical drawings Your own studio lighting and equipment for an on-site shoot A base in Brisbane, the Gold Coast, or the Sunshine Coast, and availability to shoot in Acacia Ridge next week The ability to meet a tight deadline without compromising quality. What we provide Products on-site, technical drawings, full access to our facility and team, and fast feedback so there are no delays. Rights All final images, renders, and source files become the property of our business for unrestricted commercial use. To apply, please include: Links to 3–5 relevant product or technical photography examples At least one example of AI-enhanced or 3D-rendered work Your availability for a shoot during the week of 5 October Your fixed price for the full package, or itemised pricing The software and AI tools you use Applications without portfolio links won't be considered. Budget: $4000 to $8000
40741400.decision: Проект требует услуг, которые я не предоставляю: профессиональная фотография продукции на месте клиента, студийное освещение, работа с физическими предметами, 3D-моделирование и рендеринг (Blender, KeyShot, Fusion 360). Мой профиль охватывает только ИИ-генерацию контента (тексты, озвучка, шортсы) и Python-автоматизацию, но не физическую съёмку, дизайн и 3D-работы. Это выходит за рамки моих услуг.

40741330.title: Seeking Business Development Partners for Software & AI

What We Provide Selected partners receive access to: MergeX portfolio and case studies Service information and sales material Technical support during discovery Solution/scoping support Proposal preparation Engineering team support Client delivery handled by MergeX Ideal Candidate You may be a strong fit if you have: Existing B2B relationships or business networks Experience selling software/technology services Experience in B2B sales or business development Relationships with founders, CEOs, CTOs, CIOs, COOs or business owners Existing agency or consulting relationships Strong outbound sales experience Access to US, UK, European, UAE/GCC or other international markets Existing networks are highly valuable but they are not mandatory. We are open to experienced sales professionals independent business developers consultants agency owners and entrepreneurial rainmakers. Important We are not looking for bulk lead lists or scraped contact databases. 40742485.title: AI Character Content Creator – Consistent, Photorealistic Images & Short-Form Videos
40742485.description: I’m looking for someone experienced with AI image and video generation to create ongoing content for an existing adult male AI character I have already developed. The character is a young adult college student with a handsome, attractive, masculine appearance. His persona and content are meant to feel aspirational, lifestyle-oriented, slightly provocative, and social-media friendly. The most important requirement is maintaining the same exact character identity, face, body proportions, and general appearance across all content. Just as importantly, the final content needs to be extremely realistic and high quality. I am not looking for the generic, overly polished, obviously AI-generated content that is everywhere online now. The images and videos should look as close as possible to content captured with a real iPhone, mirrorless camera, or by an actual social-media creator. Content Needed The majority of the content will consist of: - Short-form vertical videos suitable for TikTok, Instagram Reels, etc. - Lifestyle and social-media-style images - SFW content for public social platforms - More provocative / suggestive content - Adult-only / NSFW image content where appropriate The character should appear natural, attractive, and believable rather than artificial or obviously AI-generated. Examples of content could include everyday college/lifestyle situations, fitness, swimming or beach content, masculine activities, travel, casual social-media moments, attractive outfits, swimwear, shirtless content, and other scenarios that fit the character's persona. Some content should be more polished, while other content should intentionally feel like casual content that someone might naturally post to TikTok, Instagram, Snapchat, etc. Photorealism & Quality This is one of the most important parts of the project. I am specifically trying to avoid the typical signs of low-quality AI content: waxy skin, overly perfect lighting, strange anatomy, plastic-looking faces, distorted hands, inconsistent facial features, unrealistic muscles, unnatural backgrounds, excessive sharpening, bad depth of field, or strange video movement. The content should have the small imperfections and visual characteristics that make real photography and video believable. That includes things such as: - Natural skin texture, pores, facial hair, and imperfections - Realistic hair and body hair - Correct anatomy, hands, fingers, teeth, eyes, and body proportions - Natural lighting and shadows - Realistic fabric, water, reflections, environments, and backgrounds - Proper camera depth and perspective - Natural motion blur - Realistic phone-camera or camera-lens behavior - Subtle facial expressions rather than exaggerated AI expressions - Consistent body shape and facial structure between generations - Realistic movement and physics in video - No obvious AI artifacts or visual inconsistencies For casual social-media content, I actually prefer something that feels authentically photographed rather than artificially perfect. Slightly imperfect framing, realistic lighting, natural poses, believable environments, and normal phone-camera characteristics are often better than something that looks like a heavily retouched advertisement. The goal should be that, at first glance, the average viewer would assume they are looking at a real person and real social-media content. Character Consistency This is extremely important. I already have the character and reference material, so I am not looking to create a new character from scratch. You must be able to consistently reproduce: - The same face - The same hairstyle - The same approximate body type - The same age appearance - The same skin tone and physical characteristics - The same overall aesthetic and personality The character cannot look like a slightly different person every time a new image or video is generated. Experience with LoRAs, character models, reference-image workflows, face consistency, ControlNet, IP-Adapter, C

40742294.title: AI-Powered Verification Copilot Development
40742294.description: We want to develop an *AI-powered Verification Copilot for GSCS INTERNATIONAL* to assist qualified verifiers throughout the complete SLCP/FSLM verification process on Worldly. ### Core Concept This is *not a general chatbot and not an autonomous verifier*. > *AI prepares. AI checks. AI alerts. Verifier decides.* ### How It Will Work The verifier selects the *country and verification/assessment period. The Copilot then supports and checks the **entire verification across all applicable FSLM questions*, not only a fixed number of questions. For each question and across the verification as a whole, the AI will: * Suggest appropriate responses based on GSCS methodology and available evidence * Apply applicable country laws and regulations * Check mandatory and unanswered questions * Identify potential flags * Check evidence against responses * Identify contradictions and inconsistencies between questions * Cross-check worker, management and document information * Identify potential legal conflicts * Highlight areas requiring verifier attention * Draft verification comments where required * Perform a complete final verification-readiness check ### GSCS Knowledge Base GSCS will provide question-by-question: * Accurate/inaccurate examples * Other response options * Verification guidance * Evidence expectations * Flagging logic * Explanations * Approved QA/historical examples This will form the *GSCS Verification Knowledge Base*. ### Country Legal Intelligence The Copilot must be *country-specific and version-controlled*. For example, selecting *Bangladesh* will load the applicable Bangladesh requirements covering labour, wages, working hours, leave, employment, OHS and other relevant legislation. The legal database should contain: * Law/regulation * Section/article * Requirement * Effective date/version * Source * Related FSLM questions The AI must not invent laws or legal references. ### Full Verification Review The most important requirement is that the Copilot must understand the *verification as one complete system*, rather than treating each question independently. It should identify relationships and inconsistencies across the entire verification, such as: *Question Evidence Interview Other Questions Country Law Flags Final Verification* ### Human Control The verifier can *accept, edit, reject or override* every AI recommendation. The AI must never: * Make the final verification decision * Automatically approve/reject a facility * Automatically finalize a flag * Invent evidence or laws * Override the verifier * Automatically submit the verification ### Initial Prototype The first prototype should demonstrate a complete end-to-end verification workflow: *Country Selection → Full FSLM Verification → GSCS Knowledge → Country Legal Overlay → AI Assistance → Continuous Cross-Checking → Flag Alerts → Verifier Review/Edit → Final AI Quality Check* The architecture should be designed from the beginning to support *multiple countries and future changes to FSLM requirements*. ### Final Vision The Copilot should feel like an *experienced senior SLCP/FSLM verification expert sitting beside the verifier*, continuously reviewing the entire verification, identifying gaps, inconsistencies, legal issues and potential flags. The AI assists throughout. *The verifier remains fully responsible for the final decision.*
40742294.decision: Проект требует разработки сложной системы с собственным интерфейсом (UI для выбора страны, отображения вопросов верификации, редактирования рекомендаций AI, управления флагами и комментариями), интеграцией с внешней платформой Worldly, управлением большой базой знаний GSCS и базой законодательства по странам. Это выходит за рамки моих услуг: я делаю Python-автоматизации (боты, парсеры, интеграции API, генерацию контента), но не разрабатываю приложения с собственным пользовательским интерфейсом и не беру проекты, которые требуют фронтенда и архитектуры, намного более сложной, чем моя текущая специализация. 40743067.title: AI Instagram Automation for Viral Reposting
40743067.description: I want to build an AI-powered Instagram automation agent where I manually provide competitor Instagram account URLs or usernames. The agent should find newly published Reels, download the videos, and repost them to my Instagram account **exactly as they are, without editing, cropping, or modifying the videos**. ### Key Features * **Manual Account Input:** I will manually provide competitor Instagram usernames or profile URLs. * **Fresh Reel Detection:** Find newly published Reels from the last 4–10 hours. * **Automatic Video Download:** Download the original video files for content I own or have permission to reuse. * **Unedited Reposting:** Upload the exact same video without changing its content, format, or appearance. * **Viral Content Detection:** Analyze available views, engagement, topics, and posting patterns to identify potentially viral content. * **Automated Scheduling:** Schedule approved videos and publish them to my Instagram account automatically. * **Caption and Hashtags:** Retain the original caption and hashtags where authorized, with an option to customize them. * **Dashboard:** Manage competitor accounts, view detected Reels, select videos, and track scheduled and published posts. * **Performance Tracking:** Monitor available views, reach, likes, shares, and engagement. ### Goal Build an end-to-end Instagram automation agent that monitors only the accounts I manually provide, detects fresh Reels, downloads authorized videos without editing them, and automates scheduling and publishing with minimal manual effort. ### Please Provide * Recommended technology stack and AI tools. * Complete automation workflow. * Instagram API and integration requirements. * Examples of similar automation projects.
40743067.decision: Проект нарушает правила: 1) Парсинг и скачивание видео с чужих аккаунтов Instagram без явного согласия собственников — это нарушение авторских прав и условий платформы (даже если клиент говорит о «своих» видео, механика описана как мониторинг конкурентов). 2) Автоматическое репостирование контента конкурентов на свой аккаунт без изменений — это плагиат и нарушение Instagram Terms of Service, за которое банят аккаунты. 3) Это попадает в категорию 'спам-рассылки, обход блокировок платформ', что в профиле прямо запрещено. Даже если клиент уверен, что у него есть права, риск для его аккаунта и наша репутация — слишком высоки.

Generate and integrate AI assets using tools like Flow, Higgsfield, ElevenLabs, and HeyGen (e.g., custom avatars, voice cloning, AI-generated b-roll). 40743025.decision: Этот проект требует видеомонтажа и работы в Adobe Premiere Pro / After Effects, чего я не делаю. Я разрабатываю Python-автоматизации, а не видеоредактор. Кроме того, заказчик просит портфолио с примерами видеомонтажа, которого у меня нет — я работаю с ИИ-генерацией контента (тексты, озвучка, шортсы целиком), но не с редактурой существующих видео в премьере.

40742865.title: Experienced PHP Developer with AI Expertise Needed

Send us your profile and portfolio via DM. We are looking for someone who can develop independently, understand existing systems, integrate AI effectively, and build production-ready solutions.
40742865.decision: Проект требует опытного PHP-разработчика с 5+ годами опыта. Я работаю только на Python и не имею портфолио PHP-проектов. Моя специализация — Python-автоматизации (боты, парсеры, ИИ-агенты), а не веб-приложения на PHP. Это вне моего профиля услуг.

40743361.title: Organize & Upload AI Project Files
40743361.description: I have a set of online resources—mainly text-based assets such as PDF, DOC and HTML documents, together with XML and JSON data—that must be downloaded one-by-one, tagged, and placed into a clean folder hierarchy before being uploaded to the Google Drive link I will share. If you already handle meticulous data curation of mixed file types, send a portfolio link or short case study demonstrating similar download-organise-upload tasks. I will only review proposals that include this evidence of prior work. Pls state the actual amount you will do the job for we have about 200 docs
40743361.decision: Заказ требует ручной работы с файлами (скачивание, переименование, сортировка по папкам, загрузка в Google Drive), а не автоматизацию. Это не входит в услуги профиля: я делаю скрипты и боты, которые автоматизируют процессы, а не выполняю ручные задачи по организации данных. Кроме того, клиент требует портфолио с примерами похожей работы, которых у меня нет в профиле.

40743322.title: AI Game Asset Artist Needed – Video Game Assets & Skins
40743322.description: AI Game Asset Artist Needed – Video Game Assets Looking for someone experienced with AI image generation/editing to complete assets for an upcoming video game. Это не входит в услуги профиля (сайты, дизайн, мобильные приложения, контент).

40743254.title: Female PA with AI Skills Needed in Trivandrum India location
40743254.description: I’m looking for a reliable female personal assistant based in or ready to relocate to Trivandrum kerala to take full ownership of my day-to-day calendar. Your main responsibility will be keeping my schedule organised—confirming meetings, blocking travel time, sending reminders—while also serving as the first point of contact for clients who call or drop by the office. A friendly phone manner, quick-thinking problem-solving, and the ability to anticipate conflicts before they arise are the qualities I value most. This is an on-site role, so you should be comfortable working from Trivandrum during standard business hours with occasional flexibility when urgent changes pop up. AI skills are required for this role. If you’re organised, poised, and enjoy keeping everything (and everyone) running on time, I’d love to hear how you can help streamline my week.
40743254.decision: Это заказ на личного помощника (PA) с физическим присутствием в офисе в Тривандруме. Основная работа — управление календарём, приём звонков, общение с клиентами лично. Here is what I have in mind: • You handle the full AI-driven face creation—face-swap, lip-sync and expression matching—so the spokesperson appears to be delivering the script I will supply. • The finished piece should feel like a polished commercial: attention-grabbing opening, concise product benefits, a clear call-to-action, branded lower thirds and end-frame. • Length: around 45–60 seconds is ideal for paid ads and landing pages. • Final deliverables: 1080p (and, if possible, 4K) MP4, plus the working project files from whichever platform you prefer—Runway, Synthesia, D-ID, After Effects, etc.—so we can produce variants later. Seamless facial realism and lip-sync accuracy are non-negotiable; viewers must believe the spokesperson actually recorded this. If you have previous AI face projects, please share a link so I can see the quality. I’m ready to get started as soon as I find the right match.
40742340.decision: Проект требует создание видео с ИИ-лицом человека (face-swap, lip-sync). В профиле я делаю: генерацию контента (текст, картинки БЕЗ людей, озвучка, шортсы). Видео с искусственно созданным/улучшенным лицом реального человека — это запрещено (пункт «Чего я не делаю»: «Картинки и видео с людьми, сгенерированные ИИ»). Отказываемся.

40743738.title: Spark Email Rule Automation
40743738.description: I have 15 separate mailboxes already connected to Spark. Around 6,500 messages are sitting in them and everything is mixed together. What I need is a clean, rule-driven structure so I can see only what matters the moment it arrives. Here is the workflow I’d like you to complete: • Create a new “Important” folder in every one of the 15 accounts. • Build Spark rules that move or label messages according to two main criteria: the sender’s address and keywords that appear in the subject line. • Apply those same rules retroactively to the entire backlog so all 6,500 existing emails are sorted right away. • Flag anything that meets those sender- or keyword-based rules as Important. Once the rules are tested in Spark and the mailboxes look clean, send me the rule set (export file or clearly written steps). With that I’ll replicate the setup inside cPanel myself. Your deliverable is therefore: 1. Live, working rules in Spark across 15 accounts. 2. An export or documented list of those rules so I can re-create them elsewhere. 3. A brief note confirming the total messages caught by each rule so I can double-check accuracy. Please make sure you are confident working directly in Spark, comfortable handling large batches of messages, and detail-oriented when it comes to rule logic. If something in the criteria looks ambiguous, let me know before running the full batch; I prefer one clear round of clarification instead of a messy inbox later.
40743738.decision: Проект требует прямой работы с интерфейсом Spark (облачный почтовый клиент), а не создание автоматизации на Python. Я делаю ИИ-автоматизации на Python — парсеры, боты, интеграции API. Работа с UI-сценариями в приложении Spark (создание папок, ручное тестирование правил, проверка на 6500 сообщений) — это не код и не API-интеграция, это административная работа в облачном сервисе. Spark не предоставляет открытый API для программного создания правил фильтрации в масштабе. Проект находится вне моего профиля услуг.

AI PROCESSING & MANUAL EDITING After selecting an image: • Process locally using the AI model • Detect the foreground • Remove the background • Generate transparent PNG/cutout • Show preview Manual correction tools: • Eraser brush • Restore brush • Brush-size control • Zoom • Pan • Undo • Redo The app should be optimized for normal and mid-range Android phones. Target AI processing time is approximately 2 seconds for typical images where device hardware allows. This is a performance target. 4. MAIN CANVAS STUDIO The user can create promotional designs from the cutout. BACKGROUNDS Solid colors: • White • Black • Custom color Gradients: • Linear • Radial • Custom colors Bundled offline backgrounds: • Marble • Wood • Concrete • Studio backgrounds • Simple textures All built-in backgrounds must work offline. 6. DROP SHADOW / GLOW Provide controls for: • Shadow opacity • Blur • X/Y offset • Shadow color • Optional glow 7. TEXT EDITOR Users can add multiple text layers. Features: • Font selection • Font size • Color • Bold/normal • Alignment • Letter spacing • Line spacing • Background box • Stroke/outline • Shadow • Move • Scale • Rotate Include approximately 10–15 properly licensed fonts. 8. E-COMMERCE STICKERS Include a local sticker/badge library. Examples: • 50% OFF • SALE • NEW • BEST SELLER • FREE SHIPPING • LIMITED OFFER • NEW ARRIVAL • PRICE TAG • Star ratings All assets must be commercially licensed or created for this project. 9. EXPORT Export locally as: • PNG • JPEG/JPG PNG should support transparency. Images must save to the Android Gallery using appropriate modern Android storage/MediaStore methods. 10. LOCAL PROJECT SAVING Users must be able to save unfinished designs and reopen them later. Projects should preserve: • Original image • Cutout • Background • Text • Stickers • Positions • Scale • Rotation • Shadows • Canvas dimensions • Other editing settings No cloud account should be required for normal editing/project storage. 11. GOOGLE ADMOB Integrate Google AdMob according to current policies. Banner: Display appropriately without blocking editing controls. Interstitial: Can be shown after suitable actions such as exporting. Do not show excessive/disruptive ads. Rewarded Ad:
40744402.decision: Заказ требует разработки мобильного приложения для Android/Flutter с встроенным ML-моделью для удаления фона, интерактивным редактором изображений, canvas-элементами и monetization. Это выходит за рамки моих услуг: я разработчица ИИ-автоматизаций на Python (боты, парсеры, генерация контента), а не мобильных приложений. Проект требует опыта в Android/Flutter, TensorFlow Lite, интерактивной графике и Google Play Billing — специализация, которой у меня нет. Я честно не могу взяться за это.

40744325.title: Python CAD Automation for 2D Drawings
40744325.description: I am looking for a freelancer to complete a Python-based automated workflow that generates 2D engineering drawings from STEP (.step / .stp) files. The solution needs to cover the following geometries and features: pipes (round, rectangular, oval, stadium), bars (H-bar, T-bar, L-bar, I-bar, O-bar, C-bar, Z-bar), holes, notches. --- the code is about 80% done, we need someone to finish the job as the former freelancer became unavailable --- Scope The solution should: Generate an arbitrary number of valid STEP files including geometries and features as described above Generate standard 2D engineering drawings following the ISO standard for engineering drawings: https://de.slideshare.net/slideshow/introduction-of-technical-drawing-standard/128049466#26 Create orthographic projections (front/top/side) Front side needs to be the one with the most features, ie the T of a T-bar Add dimensions where applicable Include a title/information block Export drawings to PDF The drawings need to enable manufacture of that part without additional information Technical Requirements Python must be used, the work must be done in our company gitlab The code must be built assuming python usage, no shell script collections etc are valid Only free or open-source software/libraries may be used The workflow must run locally (no paid cloud services) The most important elements must have automated test coverage You are required to review the drawings yourself and mitigate issues that are readily apparent without our feedback Deliverables STEP files used as source material Python source code Setup instructions Dependency list Example generated drawings/PDFs Documentation explaining how to run the workflow Important Manual drawing creation is not acceptable You are expected to gather sample STEP files yourself as the real data is confidential. The workflow should process STEP files automatically Please describe your proposed technical approach when applying
40744325.decision: Проект требует разработки специализированного инженерного ПО для работы с CAD-форматами (STEP), генерации чертежей по ISO-стандартам и создания PDF с размерами и проекциями. Это не входит в мои услуги: я не делаю сложные приложения с нестандартными требованиями, специальными библиотеками и инженерной логикой. Проект требует глубокой экспертизы в CAD-системах и геометрии, плюс 21+ день работы. Заказчик также просит техническое описание подхода — это признак, что нужен специализированный разработчик CAD-систем, не автоматизатор.

40744247.title: AI Video Effects Enhancement
40744247.description: I have raw footage that needs to look striking, polished, and on-brand through AI-powered video editing. 40744247.decision: Проект требует видеомонтажа и работы с видеоэффектами в Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve или Runway ML. Это не входит в мои услуги — я разрабатываю автоматизации на Python (боты, парсеры, генерация контента, интеграции). Видеомонтаж, даже с AI-инструментами, — это работа видеографа, а не разработчица автоматизаций. Отклик был бы нечестен перед заказчиком.

40744223.title: Automated Ant Colony Monitoring & Content Generation
40744223.description: Python / Computer Vision Developer for Multi-Camera Raspberry Pi 5 & Windows Dashboard System Project Overview We are looking for an experienced Python and Computer Vision developer to build an automated, scalable ant colony monitoring and content generation system. The architecture consists of multiple independent Raspberry Pi 5 stations (each monitoring one colony) capturing continuous multi-camera video, running local YOLOv8 AI object tracking, and syncing highlight clips to a central Windows PC hosting a local web dashboard. The edge architecture must be completely modular: you will build one master Raspberry Pi application that can be cloned onto multiple independent Raspberry Pi 5 units. Each Pi will run the exact same codebase, with its specific behavior (bitrates, camera indices, padding, schedule) dictated entirely by a local JSON configuration file. Hardware Environment Edge Compute (Per Station) Compute: Raspberry Pi 5 (8GB) running Raspberry Pi OS (Bookworm 64-bit). AI Hardware: Raspberry Pi AI HAT+ (Hailo-8 / 8L) or CPU-fallback TFLite. Storage: External USB SSD mounted at /media/ssd/footage/. Cameras (3 Simultaneous Streams per Pi): cam0 (CSI): Arducam IMX219 NoIR (24/7 IR night vision) cam1 (CSI): Arducam IMX519 (Outworld feed) cam2 (USB): Standard UVC Camera (/dev/videoX) Central Server Server: Windows PC on the local network with SMB/CIFS file sharing enabled and dual 8TB storage drives. Detailed Software Deliverables 1. Modular Edge Application (Raspberry Pi 5) A. Dynamic Configuration (colony_config.json) The code must never contain hardcoded paths, IPs, or camera ports. All variables must be pulled from this local file, allowing cloning of the Pi SD card for new colonies by simply updating this file: colony_id, species name, and central PC backup IP address. Camera port mappings, locked FPS, bitrates (e.g., 4M or 6M), and locked auto-exposure/white balance. Upload modes (highlights_only vs full_footage), clip padding in seconds, and local retention hours. Staggered network sync start times and network bandwidth limits (kbps). B. Parallel Stream Recorder Daemon (record.py) A Python daemon managed by systemd (antcam.service). Asynchronously captures 2x CSI + 1x USB camera streams using Python multiprocessing without dropping frames. Features a non-blocking shared memory or temporary snapshot hook (/tmp/live_frame_camX.jpg) updated continuously so the AI script can sample frames without triggering a "Device Busy" camera lock. C. AI Detection & Event Tracking Engine (ai_tracker.py) Inspects shared frame buffers using YOLOv8-nano (exported to HailoRT or TFLite for hardware acceleration). Detects classes: worker, queen, brood, and major. Logs timestamped counts, spatial coordinates, and activity spikes (e.g., foraging departures) into a local SQLite database (antcam.db). Thumbnail Harvester: Automatically saves high-confidence detection frames (e.g., Queen + 10 workers in clear focus) to a /media/ssd/thumbnails/ folder for YouTube use. Database Maintenance: Runs an automated weekly VACUUM and index optimization routine to keep antcam.db fast and lightweight. D. Highlight Clipper & Timeline Marker Export (extract_highlights.py) Scans antcam.db for activity spikes above a baseline threshold. Uses FFmpeg to extract lossless, trimmed MP4 highlight clips based on the padding variables in colony_config.json. Generates a daily .csv or .edl timeline marker file formatted for DaVinci Resolve, containing precise timecodes of peak activity. E. Fail-Safe Network Sync (nightly_backup.sh) Bandwidth-Capped Sync: Executes via cron. Uses rsync --bwlimit to push footage, highlight clips, and databases to the Windows PC without saturating the local network. Verified Purge: Verifies file integrity (checksum/size) on the Windows share before purging local Pi footage older than the configured retention window (e.g., 48 hours). Disk Space Emergency Loop: If the Pi's local SSD free space drops below 10%, the script must halt raw continu
40744223.decision: Проект выходит за границы услуг профиля. Проект требует: (1) глубокого опыта с Raspberry Pi OS, systemd, rpicam-apps и Picamera2 на уровне системной разработки; (2) оптимизации YOLOv8 и HailoRT/TFLite для железа Pi 5, включая параллельную запись трёх камер без потери кадров; (3) проектирования архитектуры обработки видео с общей памятью и снимком-буферами; (4) настройки FFmpeg, rsync и SMB/CIFS для надёжной сетевой синхронизации между несколькими Pi и Windows; (5) веб-панели наблюдения с интеграцией DaVinci Resolve и схемой onboarding новых станций. 40745962.title: Postgrad AI Paper Research Support
40745962.description: I’m preparing a postgraduate research paper in Computer Vision based on an existing university Capstone project titled “A Vision-Based Sleep Posture Recognition System.” I will provide the original project, university assessment requirements, formatting template, and supporting materials. I need a highly experienced academic researcher, not a general content writer. The work requires a rigorous literature review, critical analysis of the existing project and its results, and high-quality academic writing and editing suitable for a conference-style paper. All references must be genuine, verifiable, peer-reviewed academic sources, preferably recent IEEE, Elsevier, Springer, or reputable conference/journal publications, with proper IEEE referencing. Requirements: • Strong Computer Vision / Deep Learning research background • Critical literature review and technical analysis • Academic-quality writing and editing • Strict adherence to my university template and requirements • No fabricated references, data, or results • No generative AI for writing or rewriting academic prose • Final Turnitin Similarity Report required • Approximately 4–6 double-column pages Please share your academic qualifications, published Computer Vision research/Google Scholar or ORCID profile, and relevant previous work before bidding.
40745962.decision: Заказ требует написание академической работы с литературным обзором, критическим анализом и редактурой. Это не входит в мои услуги — я разработчица ИИ-автоматизаций на Python (боты, парсеры, генераторы контента, интеграции). Заказчик ищет опытного академического исследователя с публикациями в Computer Vision, а не разработчика. Кроме того, в профиле указано: не генерируем тексты ИИ для написания академической прозы (заказчик явно это запретил), и я не могу предоставить поддельные квалификации или публикации.

40745825.title: React AI-Powered Tool Development
40745825.description: I’m building a modern, responsive AI-powered web tool that relies on React for the UI and a Python/FastAPI backend connected to Supabase/PostgreSQL. Core functionality centers on three AI capabilities—natural language processing, image recognition, and predictive analytics—exposed through well-structured APIs. The scope includes: • Frontend: component-driven React interface with TypeScript, state management, and full mobile responsiveness. • Backend: FastAPI services, authentication (JWT or Supabase Auth), role-based access, and real-time endpoints. • Database: relational modelling in PostgreSQL, Supabase edge functions, and row-level security. • AI integration: orchestrating LLM or vision endpoints (OpenAI, Anthropic, or custom models) and wrapping them in reusable service classes. • UX extras: admin dashboard, user settings, detailed analytics, and accessible error handling. • DevOps: automated testing, CI/CD, containerised deployment (Docker + Fly.io/Vercel/Render), and environment management. Deliverables will be: 1. Source code repository with clean commits and README. 2. Deployed staging site and production build. 3. API documentation (OpenAPI/Swagger) and brief user guide. 4. Test suite covering major user flows and AI endpoints. Acceptance criteria: the app must process text, images, and data to return relevant NLP summaries, classification results, and predictive metrics inside the React dashboard at <300 ms average latency on cached queries, pass all tests, and deploy without manual intervention.
40745825.decision: Проект требует полнофункциональную разработку React-приложения (фронтенд, UI/UX, компоненты, state management), что выходит за рамки услуг автоматизаций на Python. Хотя бэкенд на FastAPI — в моей компетенции, основной deliverable это веб-приложение, а не автоматизация. Кроме того, проект включает DevOps (Docker, CI/CD, деплой на Fly.io/Vercel/Render), тестирование и архитектуру системы — это разработка, а не автоматизация. Профиль покрывает: интеграции с API, ИИ-агентов, парсеры и боты на Python, но не веб-приложения.

40746495.title: AI-Driven IT Services Site
40746495.description: I need a clean, modern website that positions my company as a specialist in automation, AI solutions, and intelligent agents. The site’s core job is to present our IT services clearly, build trust with prospects, and generate qualified enquiries. Scope • Design a responsive, fast-loading interface that looks equally sharp on desktop and mobile. • Build roughly five to seven pages—Home, Services, Use Cases, About, Blog, and Contact—with room to expand. • Highlight our automation, AI, and agent-based offerings through concise copy blocks, visuals, and case-study sections. • Add a friction-free contact route (form, calendar link, or chatbot) so visitors can reach us in one click. • Ensure basic on-page SEO, Google Analytics integration, and structured data where relevant. • Provide a simple CMS (WordPress, Webflow, or another mainstream platform you recommend) so I can edit text and images without code. Deliverables 1. Wireframes & final UI mock-ups (Figma, Adobe XD, or equivalent) 2. Fully developed, responsive site deployed to my hosting 3. Source files, theme or code repository, and a short hand-over guide 4. One round of post-launch tweaks (content or minor layout adjustments) within 14 days Acceptance Criteria • Pages load in <2 seconds on GTmetrix desktop test • Mobile Lighthouse score ≥ 90 • All contact methods tested and working • CMS access confirmed with edit rights If you’ve shipped similar AI or automation-focused sites, send a link; seeing live examples speeds up selection.
40746495.decision: Проект требует дизайна и разработки сайта — это не входит в мой профиль. Я делаю ИИ-автоматизации на Python (боты, парсеры, генерацию контента, интеграции), а не веб-дизайн, вёрстку и CMS-администрирование. Это два разных направления.

40746775.title: Expert UI/UX & 3D Web Designer (WebGL / Three.js / Spline) for AI Companion Startup
40746775.description: We are an ambitious, stealth-mode AI startup building a deeply personalized, empathetic AI career and life companion. We are looking for an exceptional, high-end UI/UX Designer to completely transform our web application into a stunning, fully immersive 3D experience. Our goal is to make the user feel like they are interacting with a living, breathing digital entity—not just a chatbot. We want the entire user journey, from the landing page to the chat interface, to feel dynamic, fluid, and human. If you are inspired by the scroll-triggered, cinematic 3D animations of Apple product pages (like the iPhone landing pages), you are exactly who we are looking for. What You Will Be Doing: End-to-End 3D UI/UX Design: Design a complete, cohesive user journey from the homepage to the core conversational interface using high-end 3D visual language. Scroll-Driven Animations: Design deeply engaging, scroll-jacking animations (Apple-style) where 3D elements dynamically shift, rotate, and reveal content as the user scrolls. Humanizing the AI: Design an abstract, dynamic 3D avatar or visual representation of the "AI Companion" that feels empathetic, warm, and responsive to user input. Prototyping & Handoff: Deliver high-fidelity, interactive prototypes and work closely with our engineering team to ensure the 3D assets (WebGL, Three.js, Spline, or R3F) translate perfectly into our Next.js frontend. What We Are Looking For: Mastery of 3D Web Tools: Expert experience using tools like Spline, Blender, Three.js, React Three Fiber (R3F), or WebGL. Top-Tier UI/UX Sensibilities: A portfolio demonstrating premium, modern, "glassmorphism," or cinematic dark-mode aesthetics. Animation Expertise: Proven ability to create scroll-triggered web animations (GSAP, Framer Motion). Empathy in Design: The ability to translate abstract human emotions (trust, empathy, vulnerability) into visual styling and micro-animations. Project Scope: Landing Page: A breathtaking, scroll-animated 3D homepage introducing the AI companion. Onboarding Flow: A dynamic, gamified setup process where the AI learns about the user. Main Chat Interface: A highly polished chat environment featuring subtle 3D background elements, dynamic emotional indicators, and premium typography. How to Apply: Please begin your proposal with the word "COMPANION" so we know you read the full description. Crucial: You must include links to previous work or live websites you have designed that feature heavy 3D elements and scroll-driven animations. Proposals without relevant 3D/Apple-style web portfolios will not be considered.
40746775.decision: Это проект UI/UX дизайна и 3D веб-разработки (WebGL, Three.js, Spline). Это не автоматизация на Python. Хотя я могу интегрировать API и боты, основная работа здесь — дизайн интерфейса и фронтенд (Next.js + 3D графика), что находится вне моего профиля. Я делаю автоматизации: боты, парсеры, ИИ-агенты, постинг — не сайты и не дизайн.

40746701.title: GoHighLevel Instagram Automation Setup
40746701.description: Our team engages daily on Instagram and now wants to run the heavy lifting through GoHighLevel. The goal is straightforward: lift follower engagement by letting smart workflows handle routine interactions while we focus on creative content. We publish a healthy mix of photos, videos and stories, so the automations must work seamlessly across all formats. Here is what I need built and fully tested: • Post scheduling: an evergreen calendar plus one-off campaign slots, triggered from our content board and posting at optimal engagement times. • Auto-reply to comments: keyword-based, sentiment-aware responses that feel personal, with fall-back rules sending anything uncertain to a human inbox. • DM automation: welcome sequences for new followers, quick-reply flows for common inquiries, and a re-engagement drip for inactive followers. All workflows have to be created inside GoHighLevel, connected to our existing Instagram Business account and documented so we can tweak copy later on. I’ll provide access, branding assets and the message templates; you wire everything together, run test cases and show analytics confirming the triggers fire correctly.
40746701.decision: Заказ требует работы именно в GoHighLevel (платформе no-code), а я работаю только на Python. Клиент просит создать workflows внутри GoHighLevel и интеграцию с Instagram Business через эту платформу. Это не соответствует моему профилю — я не работаю с n8n, Make, Zapier и подобными визуальными конструкторами. На Python можно было бы сделать парсер или бота, но суть заказа — настройка именно GoHighLevel, что вне моих услуг.

40746685.title: CRM Setup & Automation for Digital Traffiq
40746685.description: Freelancer Required for One-Time CRM Setup & Automation Company: Digital Traffiq (India) Project Type: One-Time Setup (Fixed Price) About Us Digital Traffiq is a digital marketing and business automation company offering AI-powered marketing, CRM and automation solutions. We provide Funnel Traffiq, our all-in-one marketing, sales and business management platform. Project Overview We are looking for an experienced freelancer to complete the one-time setup and configuration of Funnel Traffiq, including CRM, marketing automation, WhatsApp integration, lead management and essential business integrations. Scope of Work ● CRM Setup: Configure CRM, sales pipelines, lead management, tags, custom fields and dashboards. ● Lead Capture: Set up lead forms, landing pages and automatic lead synchronization. ● WhatsApp API: Integrate WhatsApp Business API, chatbot, automated messages, lead qualification and follow-ups. ● Marketing Automation: Configure CRM workflows, lead nurturing, notifications and automated follow-ups. ● Email Setup: Configure SMTP, business email, templates and email automation. ● Meta Integration: Connect Facebook, Instagram, Meta Lead Ads and auto-replies, where supported. ● Website Integration: Set up website chat widget, domain, DNS and landing page integrations. ● Analytics: Configure Google Analytics 4, Meta Pixel and conversion tracking. ● Policy Pages: Create Privacy Policy, Refund Policy and Terms & Conditions pages using approved content. ● Testing & Handover: Test all integrations, resolve setup issues and provide documentation and a walkthrough. Required Skills ● CRM setup and implementation ● Marketing automation and sales funnels ● WhatsApp Business API and chatbot integration ● Email and SMTP configuration ● Meta Ads and Google Analytics integration ● Website, domain and DNS configuration Experience with Funnel Traffiq or its underlying CRM platform is preferred. Project Requirements ● One-time setup with a fixed budget. ● Complete configuration, testing and troubleshooting. ● All accounts and assets must remain under Digital Traffiq's ownership. ● Provide documentation and a final handover. We are looking for a skilled freelancer who can deliver a fully configured, tested and business-ready onetime setup.
40746685.decision: Проект выходит за границы моих услуг. Основная работа — это настройка и конфигурация платформы Funnel Traffiq (CRM, маркетинг-автоматизация, веб-интеграции, аналитика, политики и страницы). Это требует глубокого знания специфической платформы, дизайна пользовательского интерфейса, создания страниц политики и конфигурации множества сторонних сервисов. Я работаю на Python и создаю Python-скрипты для автоматизации — это не то же самое, что настройка и администрирование готовой SaaS-платформы. Хотя WhatsApp API и интеграции — мои услуги, основной объём работы здесь — это не программирование, а конфигурация платформы, что вне моего профиля.

40746677.title: AI-Powered E-commerce Website Build
40746677.description: I’m starting from a clean slate and need a fully working e-commerce site that marries a modern, responsive frontend with a Python-driven backend and integrated machine-learning intelligence. The heart of the platform will be three AI/ML capabilities: detailed data analysis of customer behaviour, on-the-fly sales prediction, and a personalised recommendation engine that learns from every interaction to boost conversions. On the web side, I expect a slick UI that renders flawlessly on mobile and desktop, secure user authentication, payment handling, and an admin dashboard that surfaces key metrics through interactive charts. The backend should expose well-documented REST or GraphQL APIs, connect to either SQL or MongoDB (your call), and remain easily deployable on a standard cloud stack. I’m framework-agnostic, so pick Flask, Django or any Python toolchain you feel suits the job best, as long as it stays maintainable and well-structured. Deliverables I need from you: • Complete, production-ready source code for the website, backend services, and ML modules • A clear setup guide with environment requirements and deployment commands • In-code comments and standalone documentation that explain architecture, model training, and API endpoints • Seed data plus instructions so I can demo the recommendation and prediction features immediately after installation • A brief hand-off session (video or written) outlining how to retrain models and roll out future updates I’ll judge the work on code quality, UI polish, security best practices, and—most importantly—the accuracy and responsiveness of the ML components. If you have previous showpieces that blend Python, JavaScript, HTML5/CSS3, and machine learning, I’d love to see them when you apply.
40746677.decision: Это не совпадает с моими услугами. Заказчик просит полноценный e-commerce сайт с фронтенд-разработкой (слик UI, HTML5/CSS3, responsive дизайн), что выходит за рамки моего профиля. Я делаю ИИ-автоматизации на Python (боты, парсеры, генерацию контента, интеграции), а не веб-приложения. Сайт с ML-рекомендациями, системой аутентификации, платёжным шлюзом и админ-панелью — это веб-приложение, а не автоматизация. Это вне моих услуг.

40746551.title: Zoho CRM Appointment Booking Automation
40746551.description: I'm seeking a developer to automate the appointment booking process for therapists. The solution should integrate with Zoho CRM and Razorpay for payments. Key requirements include: - Seamless appointment booking flow - Integration with Zoho CRM - Razorpay payment integration - Automated receipt generation Ideal skills and experience: - Experience with Zoho CRM - Familiarity with Razorpay integration - Strong background in automation and workflow optimization - Previous experience in developing booking systems
40746551.decision: Проект требует интеграцию с Zoho CRM и Razorpay (платежи), что входит в наши услуги. Однако бюджет 1500–12500 INR (примерно $18–150 USD) слишком низкий. Даже нижняя граница нашего абсолютного минимума — $20 USD. При таком бюджете мы не сможем сделать качественную интеграцию CRM + платежи + автоматизацию, которая займёт минимум 7–14 дней работы. Риск того, что заказчик не согласится на нашу минимальную цену ($20–56 USD за части интеграции) слишком высок, учитывая его бюджет. Отклик приведёт к отказу и потере времени.

40746504.title: AI Platform Architecture Consultation
40746504.description: We are building a new AI powered sourcing and RFP platform, with development planned for Q1 2027. Before development begins, we want to connect with experienced AI developers for paid consulting to help us make smart decisions around AI architecture, workflows, integrations, scalability, and product development. This is not a job posting. We are looking for experienced developers who can provide practical advice as we prepare the product for development. If we work well together, there may also be an opportunity to hire you or your team for the actual development in 2027. Interested? Send us a short introduction with your experience and areas of expertise.
40746504.decision: Проект — это консультирование по архитектуре AI-платформы, а не разработка конкретной автоматизации. В профиле нет услуги 'консультирование' или 'архитектурный аудит'. Работаю только на готовый результат (бот, парсер, интеграцию, генератор контента и т.п.), а не на совет. Кроме того, бюджет 10–30 USD за консультацию слишком низкий для такого уровня работы. Вежливо отказываемся.

40747457.title: Sleek AI Logo Design
40747457.description: I need a fresh logo for my AI-focused company that immediately conveys trust and reliability while feeling modern and sleek. The mark should look just as strong on a dark app header as it does printed on stationery, so clean geometry, balanced spacing, and a crisp type choice are important. Please base the concept on these core ideas: • Trust & reliability come first—think confident shapes, stable symmetry, and a professional but not cold palette. • A contemporary aesthetic—smooth lines, minimalist detail, and a tech-forward feel that can scale from favicon to billboard. Deliverables I’ll need: 1. Primary logo in vector (AI, SVG) and high-res PNG. 2. Reversed/light version for dark backgrounds. 3. Monochrome version. 4. Quick brand sheet showing colors and typography. If you have experience crafting marks for tech or SaaS brands and can show comparable work, let’s talk timelines and your creative process.
40747457.decision: Это дизайн логотипа — не входит в мой профиль услуг. Я разработчица Python-автоматизаций, не графический дизайнер. Логотипы, брендинг, дизайн — это не моё.

40747349.title: AI-Powered Chat and Media Generation App
40747349.description: Project Title: AI Chat, Image and Video Generation Web App I am looking for an experienced full-stack developer to build and improve a professional AI-powered web application. Required features: - AI chat functionality. - AI image generation. - AI video generation. - Modern, mobile-friendly and responsive UI. - User registration, login and dashboard. - Option to use basic features without signing up, where technically feasible. - Generation history and saved content. - Indian pricing in ₹ and a credit-based payment system. - Razorpay payment gateway integration. - Admin panel to manage users, credits, pricing and usage. - Secure backend, database and API integration. - Deployment, testing and bug fixing. Preferred technology: Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, PostgreSQL and Prisma. Deliverables: Complete working source code, deployment, documentation and support for fixing launch issues. Please provide your portfolio, estimated project cost, timeline and details of any third-party AI API costs before starting work.
40747349.decision: Это полнофункциональное веб-приложение с фронтенд, БД, админ-панелью и платежной системой. Я делаю Python-автоматизации (боты, парсеры, ИИ-агенты, интеграции), а не сайты и веб-приложения. Проект требует full-stack разработку на Next.js — это вне моего профиля.

40747894.title: Asia-Pacific Student Housing CRM Research
40747894.description: I need a concise, data-driven study that maps out which CRMs and marketing channels are currently used by student accommodation providers across the Asia-Pacific region. The scope covers universities, private landlords, large student-housing companies, and independent PBSA operators. The core metrics I care about are price efficiency and number of users on each platform, so please drill deep into subscription tiers, licensing models, and active user counts where available. Alongside those figures, include performance indicators that show how effective each CRM is in capturing leads and converting bookings—open rates, response times, or any other measurable results you can source. For context and additional colour, a brief look at integration options and support quality will be useful, but it should stay secondary to the cost-versus-user analysis. Marketing channels—email, paid search, social, agent networks, partnerships, etc.—should be documented for each provider so I can see how the CRM fits into their wider funnel. Deliverables • An Excel or Google Sheets comparison matrix listing every CRM identified, its pricing structure, user count estimates, key features, and noted marketing channels for each accommodation provider. • A short narrative report (8-10 pages) summarising trends, standout tools, and any clear ROI patterns you uncover. • All sources cited or hyper-linked for verification. Please base findings on publicly verifiable data, reputable industry reports, provider interviews or surveys, and include the date of every data point. I will consider the research complete once the matrix is fully populated, the report is delivered, and spot-checks on two randomly selected figures match their cited sources.
40747894.decision: Это исследовательский проект, не автоматизация. Требует анализа рынка, сбора данных вручную, написания отчёта — это не входит в услуги разработчицы (Python-автоматизация, боты, парсеры, интеграции). Даже если использовать парсер для сбора данных, основная работа — исследование, интерпретация, составление отчёта вручную — за пределами профиля.

40747869.title: Boost Online School Enrollments
40747869.description: I run an online school and I’m ready to ramp up enrollments. The priority is clear: every marketing dollar must translate into new students. Here’s what I need: a full-funnel campaign that we launch and iterate across social media, search engines, and email. On the social side, think Facebook, Instagram, and perhaps TikTok if it helps us reach primary and secondary school students—my core demographic. For search, a mix of Google Ads, keyword-driven landing pages, and retargeting will be essential. Email should nurture interested parents and learners, so list segmentation and persuasive sequences (Mailchimp or similar) will be part of the workflow. I will supply existing course details, brand assets, and past performance data. You’ll turn that into: • A channel-specific strategy outlining objectives, KPIs, and timelines • Compelling ad copy, creative concepts, and landing page direction • End-to-end setup and launch inside the chosen platforms • Weekly performance snapshots and a concise monthly report with next-step recommendations A/B testing, pixel/tag implementation, and clear attribution are non-negotiable so we can see exactly how many enrollments each channel drives. If this sounds like a campaign you can own from strategy through optimization, let’s talk.
40747869.decision: Заказ требует услуг, которых я не предоставляю: SMM-ведение (создание стратегии и управление рекламой в соцсетях), настройка Google Ads и Facebook Ads, создание и оптимизацию лендингов, управление email-маркетингом через Mailchimp, A/B-тестирование и аналитику кампаний. Это работа маркетолога и специалиста по performance-маркетингу, а не разработчика ИИ-автоматизаций. Я делаю только технические автоматизации на Python (боты, парсеры, интеграции, генерацию контента).

40747857.title: AI Hindu Festival Promo Video
40747857.description: I need an AI-generated promotional video for a large Hindu religious event in Bangalore, featuring over 100,000 devotees. The video should be festive and lively, capturing: - Rituals and ceremonies - Devotees and crowd activities - Cultural performances (dance and music) - 100s of Nadaswaram artists performing - 1000+ musicians singing in a 3 tiered stage - 100s of Indian classical dancers dancing on a different stage - 1000s of Brahmin priests performing 'homa' in numerous 'homa-kunda' - 100,000+ devotees, comprising of children, men, women, old to very old citizens attending - Devotees coming in buses from some gates - 8 to 10 mins video - Video captured in the perspective of a drone which flies in from a LARGER than life grand entrance. - First visuals of the entrance - Second visuals of the Nadaswaram artists playing classical songs - Third visual of children, old men and women getting down from 100s of buses. All cheerful, excited and happy - Fourth visual of the massively huge grand hall where 100,000 devotees are seated and are chanting sloka - Fifth visual of the 3 tiered grand stage where 1000s of musicians are singing songs - Final visual of the main stage where several dignitaries are seated and enjoying the event. - At each stage, use Elevenlabs or similar to generate corresponding voice overs in English, Kannada, Hindi and Tamil Ideal skills and experience: - Proficiency in AI video creation - Experience with large crowd events - Strong understanding of cultural and religious nuances - Ability to create engaging, festive content Candidates will be shortlisted based on: 1. Prior proven experience with executing similar Hindu religious events 2. Showcasing samples of prior work 3. Create a demo video of, say 20 seconds with a sub set of requirements mentioned here Looking for a dynamic representation of this grand event.
40747857.decision: Проект требует создание видео с людьми, сгенерированными ИИ (100,000+ преданных, танцоры, музыканты, священники и т.д.). Согласно профилю, я не делаю «Картинки и видео с людьми, сгенерированные ИИ» — это запрещено. Кроме того, основная задача (создание полнофункционального промо-видео 8-10 минут с множеством сложных визуальных элементов, синхронизацией голоса на четырёх языках и режиссурой сцен) выходит за рамки моих услуг. Я специализируюсь на Python-автоматизации и боты, а не на видеопродакшене или AI-видеостудии.

40747821.title: Rapid AI Reels Content Creation
40747821.description: I need three engaging vertical reels (9:16) delivered every single day for my social channels. You’ll receive a brief or raw footage each morning and I expect polished, scroll-stopping edits back within 24 hours—faster is even better. Your workflow should already include AI helpers such as CapCut templates, Adobe Premiere Pro’s Sensei features, Runway, Descript, or similar tools so you can turn around smart cuts, auto-captions, and dynamic motion graphics without sacrificing quality. You’ll be free to mix trending audio, bold typography, and quick transitions as long as everything stays brand-safe and copyright-cleared. I’ll supply topics, brand guidelines, and any long-form source video; you handle concept refinement, editing, text overlays, music, and export in platform-ready resolutions for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and Facebook. Consistency matters—colour grade, font treatment, and pacing should feel cohesive across the feed—yet each clip still needs a fresh hook that lands within the first two seconds. Deliverables each day: • 3 finished MP4 reels, optimised and named per platform • Matching caption text and 3–5 relevant hashtags • Project files (so future tweaks are painless) A quick sample or portfolio link showing similar AI-accelerated edits will help me lock this in fast. If you can keep up the daily rhythm without slipping on creativity or quality, we can turn this into a long-term collaboration starting immediately.
40747821.decision: Проект требует ежедневного создания видеороликов с дизайном, монтажом и творческой работой — это не входит в мой профиль услуг. 40748305.title: AI Video Specialist Needed to Create a 5-Minute VR180 Experience for Meta Quest 3

Examples showing character consistency across multiple shots. 4. Your proposed workflow and software. 5. Whether your final output will be stereoscopic or monoscopic VR180. 6. Maximum output resolution. 7. How you will maintain the same characters throughout the project. 8. How you will create the full 180-degree environment around the viewer. 9. 40748305.decision: Этот проект требует специализированную работу с VR180-видео, стереоскопической генерацией, панорамной проекцией и VR-тестированием на Meta Quest 3. Это выходит за рамки моих услуг. 40748245.title: Zoho Creator Purchase Intelligence Agent with AI
40748245.description: I want to turn Zoho Creator into an AI-powered assistant that shortens the gap between incoming enquiries and a confirmed purchase order. The agent then sends an internal notification to both Sales and Purchase, pre-fills a draft containing customer-facing benefits for every suggested item, and routes it through an approval workflow. По правилам профиля: не выдумываю опыт и не обещаю то, в чём не уверен.

40748243.title: Email Marketing Setup & Deliverability Expert Needed – Complete Automation & Inbox Setup
40748243.description: We are looking for an experienced Email Marketing & Deliverability Expert to set up our complete email marketing system from scratch. 40748896.title: Headless Proxy Voting Automation Script
40748896.description: I need a small headless script that casts a single vote on https://scapelikes.com/game/fallen-marches, then immediately swaps to the next proxy in a list so that every IP is used only once within the 12-hour cooldown. Workflow • Read a plain text file that contains one HTTP proxy per line (ip:port:user:pass). • For each proxy, spin up a headless browser session, route traffic through that proxy, load the page, press “Vote for this Game”, tick the Cloudflare checkbox and hit “Cast my Vote”. • Detect whether the vote was accepted (page confirmation or changed button state). If it fails for any reason—timeout, Cloudflare block, element not found—drop the session, log the proxy as failed and continue with the next one (no retries on that IP). Key points to keep in mind • All proxies are HTTP. • Operation must be fully unattended; no manual captcha solving. • The runtime needs to be lightweight enough to handle thousands of proxies in sequence. Randomising user-agents and adding small delays between actions to mimic human behaviour is welcome if it improves reliability. Deliverables 1. Well-commented source code (Python + Selenium, Node + Puppeteer, or a similarly common stack). 2. Simple log output summarising votes cast, failures and total run time. 3. Quick start instructions so I can drop in my own proxy list and launch the job immediately. If you have prior experience bypassing Cloudflare on headless browsers, please mention it when you submit.
40748896.decision: Проект нарушает правила профиля. Это автоматизированное голосование через прокси с целью обхода ограничений платформы (cooldown, IP-блокировка, Cloudflare). Это эквивалентно спам-рассылкам, накрутке и обходу блокировок — запрещено правилом 'Спам-рассылки, накрутка подписчиков/отзывов, фермы ботов, обход блокировок платформ'. Кроме того, проект направлен на манипуляцию голосованием в игре, что нарушает условия сервиса и является обманом (харам). Не откликаемся.

40748699.title: Create AI platform Based for software App Development Platform

40749104.title: AI-Based Data Extraction from Documents
40749104.description: Project Title AI Model / OCR Automation to Extract Data from PNG, JPEG & PDF and Populate Excel Sheets Project Description I am looking for an experienced AI/ML developer or Python developer who can develop a tool/model that can automatically extract required data from PNG, JPEG, scanned documents, and PDF files and enter the extracted information into a predefined Excel template. The main challenge is that **the source documents will not always have the same format or layout**. Data may appear at different positions, under different headings, or in different table formats. The system should therefore be able to **understand the context/title/heading of the information**, identify the required value, and place it in the correct cell/column of the Excel sheet. Example Workflow **Input:** - PNG/JPEG images of test reports, bore logs, laboratory reports, etc. - Scanned or digital PDF documents - Different formats/layouts from different sources **Processing:** The AI should: 1. Read and understand the document. 2. Identify relevant headings/titles and associated values. 3. Extract the required information even if its position changes between documents. 4. Handle tables and scanned documents using OCR where required. 5. Map the extracted information to the appropriate Excel column based on the **heading/context**, rather than simply relying on fixed coordinates. 6. Apply predefined conversion/calculation rules where required. 7. Populate the existing Excel template without disturbing its formatting, formulas, logos, borders, colours, etc. **Output:** A completed Excel file with the extracted data accurately entered into the appropriate cells. ### Important Requirement I do **not** want a simple OCR tool that extracts text based only on fixed positions. For example, if one report contains: > Bulk Density – 1.97 g/cc and another report contains: > Natural Bulk Density: 2.01 g/cc the system should understand that both refer to **Bulk Density** and place the corresponding value in the correct Excel field. Similarly, the location/order of **SPT N-value, soil classification, density, fines percentage, depth, test results, etc.** may vary between documents. The system should be capable of handling these variations using **AI/NLP/LLM-based document understanding, OCR, table extraction, or a suitable combination of technologies**. ### Excel Requirements The tool should be able to: - Work with existing Excel templates. - Identify the correct worksheet. - Populate specific fields/columns. - Preserve existing formatting. - Preserve formulas and merged cells. - Avoid changing logos, borders, colours, and page layout. - Create/copy/rename worksheets where required. - Apply predefined data-entry and calculation rules. - Generate the final completed Excel workbook. ### Preferred Technologies I am open to the developer's recommendation, but experience with the following would be preferred: - Python - OCR - OpenAI/LLM APIs or other AI models - Document AI - Computer Vision - PDF/Table extraction - Pandas - OpenPyXL - Azure Document Intelligence / Google Document AI / AWS Textract or similar - RAG/LLM-based document understanding - Machine Learning model fine-tuning, if required ### Important I will provide **sample PNG/JPEG/PDF files along with the corresponding correctly completed Excel files** as examples. The developer should use these examples to understand the required mapping and develop a system that can generalize to **new documents with different formats**. Accuracy is very important because this will be used for **engineering/geotechnical investigation data**, where incorrect extraction or mapping can lead to incorrect analysis. ### Deliverables 1. Working Python code/application. 2. AI/OCR/document-processing pipeline. 3. Excel automation. 4. Ability to process multiple files in batch. 5. Proper mapping of extracted data to the Excel template. 6. Error/exception handling for missing or unclear data. 7. Source-document → Excel field mappin
40749104.decision: Заказ требует разработки сложной ML-системы с fine-tuning моделей, Computer Vision и RAG/LLM-пайплайна для понимания контекста документов с вариативными форматами. Это выходит за рамки услуг в профиле (простые боты, парсеры, автопостинг, базовая интеграция с API). Хотя я работаю на Python, такой проект требует специальной ML-экспертизы, обучения моделей на примерах заказчика и итеративной разработки, которая не укладывается в стандартные сроки (5–7 дней) и цены профиля. Это скорее работа ML-специалиста на месяцы, а не автоматизация готовыми инструментами.
