Consistent pacing and emotional delivery throughout the book. Technical Requirements Deliver clean masters that meet Audible/ACX standards (44.1 kHz, MP3 192 kbps or higher, RMS between −18 dB and −23 dB, peaks below −3 dB). Minor natural breaths are acceptable, but clicks, pops, and any artificial artifacts must be removed.Deliverables One finished, fully edited file for the entire book Consistent opening and closing credits, synopsis, introduction, conclusion, bonus chapter, and legal information — all in accordance with the text in the file I will provide — must be included inside this single audiobook file A brief pronunciation guide if any names or technical terms raise questions Before producing the full book, please send a one-page test reading so we can confirm pacing, tone, and overall quality. Once approved, proceed with the work.Your name must not be mentioned in the book. All rights to any version of the work, including the audiobook, will belong exclusively to me, and you will not claim any payments, percentages, or other demands beyond the one-time payment on this service where we found each other.If you have previous examples of AI-narrated audiobooks, I would appreciate links or short demos.
40780266.decision: Проект требует профессиональную обработку и мастеринг аудиофайлов (нормализация, удаление артефактов, соответствие стандартам Audible/ACX), что выходит за рамки моих услуг. Я делаю ИИ-генерацию контента (озвучка, шортсы), но не занимаюсь профессиональным аудио-мастерингом, постпродакшеном и техническими стандартами студийного качества. Это специализированная услуга звукорежиссера/звукооператора, а не разработчика автоматизаций на Python.

40780183.title: Chrome Extension for Website Automation
40780183.description: I need a lightweight Chrome extension that can consistently automate repetitive actions on a specific web platform. The core requirement is simple: once the extension is installed, it should detect selected buttons or links on the page and trigger them programmatically in the exact order and timing I define. All interactions must respect the page’s existing JavaScript and HTML structure, so no server-side changes are expected—just pure front-end automation through the Chrome Extension APIs. Here is the flow I have in mind: • When the user lands on the target page, the extension injects a content script that identifies the buttons or links I specify (by ID, class name, or CSS selector). • A configurable set of rules—ideally editable from a small options page—dictates when and how those elements are clicked (e.g., immediately on load, after X seconds, or on a hotkey press). • A visual indicator in the browser toolbar should confirm that the automation is active. Technology stack: vanilla JavaScript, HTML, and CSS are sufficient; if using a light framework such as jQuery or a build tool like Webpack helps keep the code tidy, feel free to include it. The final package must follow Google’s manifest v3 guidelines so it passes the Chrome Web Store review. Deliverables 1. Source code (well-commented) and packed .zip /.crx ready for manual installation. 2. Short README detailing setup, configuration, and how to extend selectors or timings. 3. A brief video or GIF demo showing the extension clicking the designated buttons/links in action. Acceptance criteria: • The extension consistently automates only the elements I whitelist, with no unintended clicks. • It runs error-free on the latest Chrome version across Windows, macOS, and Linux. • Code quality is clear enough that I can tweak selectors or timing rules without digging through complex logic. I can provide the exact page URL and button selectors once we start. Let me know if any part of the workflow needs clarification, and include a rough timeline for initial delivery with your response.
40780183.decision: Проект требует разработку Chrome-расширения (browser extension), которая выходит за границы профессиональных услуг. Профиль покрывает Python-автоматизацию, Telegram-боты, парсеры и ИИ-агенты. Chrome-расширение — это фронтенд-приложение на JavaScript/HTML/CSS, требующая знания Chrome Web Store API, манифеста v3, упаковки и публикации. Хотя расширение технически может интегрироваться с Python-бэком, основная доставка — это desktop/browser-приложение, которое не входит в спектр услуг (наравне с мобильными приложениями и сайтами). Кроме того, клиент просит видео-демо, что требует видеомонтажа и может выходить за рамки чистой разработки. Отказываемся вежливо, предлагая альтернативу на Python, если результат для него важнее конкретной технологии.
